translation: 最後に吐いたのはいつですか？

english: How often do you have a bowel movement?
transliteration: HAI-behn wah doh-noh koo-rai noh HIN-doo dehs-kah?
translation: 排便はどのくらいの頻度ですか？

english: Have your bowel habits changed recently?
transliteration: sai-KIN, BEHN-tsoo nee hehn-kah gah ah-ree-mah-shee-tah-kah?
translation: 最近、便通に変化がありましたか？

english: When was your last bowel movement?
transliteration: sai-goh nee BEHN gah deh-tah noh wah ee-ts-kah dehs-kah?
translation: 最後に便が出たのはいつですか？

english: Is your stool hard or soft?
transliteration: BEHN wah kah-tah-ee dehs-kah, soh-reh-toh-moh yah-wah-rah-kah-ee dehs-kah?
translation: 便は硬いですか、それとも柔らかいですか？

english: Is your stool watery or loose?
transliteration: BEHN wah mee-zuh-ppoh-ee dehs-kah, soh-reh-toh-moh yah-wah-rah-kah-ee dehs-kah?
translation: 便は水っぽいですか、それとも軟らかいですか？

english: Is your stool black or tar-like?
transliteration: BEHN wah koo-roh-ee dehs-kah, soh-reh-toh-moh TAH-roo noh yoo dehs-kah?
translation: 便は黒いですか、それともタールのようですか？

english: Have you noticed red blood in your stool?
transliteration: BEHN nee ah-kah-ee chee gah mah-jee-tt-eh ee-roo koh-toh nee kee-zoo-kee-mah-shee-tah-kah?
translation: 便に赤い血が混じっていることに気づきましたか？

english: Is there mucus in your stool?
transliteration: BEHN nee neh-nyeh-koo gah mah-jee-tt-eh ee-mahs-kah?
translation: 便に粘液が混じっていますか？

english: Is your stool pale or clay-coloured?
transliteration: BEHN wah shee-roh-ppoh-ee dehs-kah, soh-reh-toh-moh neh-nyeh-ts-chee noh yoo nah eh-ree-mahs-kah?
translation: 便は白っぽいですか、それとも粘土のような色ですか？

english: Is your stool greasy or difficult to flush?
transliteration: BEHN wah ah-brah-ppoh-ee dehs-kah, mah-tah wah NAH-gah-shee nee-koo-ee dehs-kah?
translation: 便は脂っぽいですか、または流しにくいですか？

english: Do you feel you have completely emptied your bowels?
transliteration: BEHN gah zehn-boo deh-tah KAHN-jee gah shee-mahs-kah?
translation: 便が全部出た感じがしますか？

english: Do you have difficulty controlling your bowel movements?
transliteration: HAI-behn oh jee-bohn deh kohn-TOH-roh-roo noh gah mush-kah-shee-ee dehs-kah?
translation: 便通を自分でコントロールしにくいですか？

english: Do you have diarrhea?
transliteration: geh-ree oh shee-teh ee-mahs-kah?
translation: 下痢をしていますか？

english: How many loose stools have you had today?
transliteration: kyoh-oh wah nahn-kai nahn-behn gah ah-ree-mah-shee-tah-kah?
translation: 今日は軟便が何回ありましたか？

english: How long have you had diarrhea?
transliteration: geh-ree wah doh-noh koo-rai ts-zoo-ee-teh ee-mahs-kah?
translation: 下痢はどのくらい続いていますか？

english: Do you have cramps before passing stool?
transliteration: BEHN oh dah-soo mae nee oh-nah-kah gah keh-ee-rehn soo-roo yoo nee ee-tah-mee-mahs-kah?
translation: 便を出す前にお腹がけいれんするように痛みますか？

english: Do you feel an urgent need to use the toilet?
transliteration: ee-soh-ee-deh TOH-ree nee ee-kah-ee-koo nah-ree-mahs-kah?
translation: 急いでトイレに行きたくなりますか？

english: Are you constipated?
transliteration: behhn-pee dehs-kah?
translation: 便秘ですか？

english: Do you strain when passing stool?
transliteration: BEHN oh dah-soo toh-kee nee ts-yoh-koo ee-kee-mee-mahs-kah?
translation: 便を出すときに強くいきみますか？

english: Have you passed gas today?
transliteration: kyoh-oh wah oh-nah-rah gah deh-mah-shee-tah-kah?
translation: 今日はおならが出ましたか？

english: Are you taking laxatives or stool softeners?
transliteration: geh-zai yah BEHN oh yah-wah-rah-kah-koo soo-roo koo-soo-ree oh ts-kah-tt-eh ee-mahs-kah?
translation: 下剤や便を柔らかくする薬を使っていますか？

english: Has anyone around you also had diarrhea?
transliteration: mah-wah-ree noh hee-toh nee-moh geh-ree oh shee-tah hee-toh wah ee-mahs-kah?
translation: 周りの人にも下痢をした人はいますか？

english: Do you have heartburn or burning in your chest?
transliteration: muhn-yah-keh yah muhhn gah yah-keh-roo yoo nah KAHN-jee gah ah-ree-mahs-kah?
translation: 胸やけや胸が焼けるような感じがありますか？

english: Do you have acid coming up into your throat?
transliteration: ee-sahn gah noh-doh mah-deh ah-gah-tt-eh koo-roo KAHN-jee gah ah-ree-mahs-kah?
translation: 胃酸が喉まで上がってくる感じがありますか？

english: Do you have a sour taste in your mouth?
transliteration: koo-chee noh nah-kah gah su-ppoh-ee KAHN-jee gah shee-mahs-kah?
translation: 口の中が酸っぱい感じがしますか？

english: Do you burp frequently?
transliteration: geh-ppoo gah yoh-koo deh-mahs-kah?
translation: げっぷがよく出ますか？

english: Do you have trouble swallowing food?
transliteration: tah-beh-moh-noh oh noh-mee-ko-meen-oo-ee dehs-kah?
translation: 食べ物を飲み込みにくいですか？

english: Is swallowing painful?
transliteration: noh-mee-ko-moo toh ee-tah-mee-mahs-kah?
translation: 飲み込むと痛みますか？

english: Is it harder to swallow solids or liquids?
transliteration: koh-keh-ee-tsoo-moo toh eh-kee-tai deh-wah, doh-chee-rah gah noh-mee-ko-meen-oo-ee dehs-kah?
translation: 固形物と液体では、どちらが飲み込みにくいですか？

english: Does food ever feel stuck in your chest?
transliteration: tah-beh-moh-noh gah muhhn nee ts-kah-eh-roo KAHN-jee gah soo-roo koh-toh wah ah-ree-mahs-kah?
translation: 食べ物が胸につかえる感じがすることはありますか？

english: Do you cough or choke when swallowing?
transliteration: noh-mee-ko-moo toh-kee nee, seh-kee-kohn-dah-ree moo-seh-tah-ree shee-mahs-kah?
translation: 飲み込むときに、せき込んだりむせたりしますか？

english: Do you feel full after eating only a small amount?
transliteration: soo-koh-shee tah-beh-tah dah-keh deh mahn-fuh-koo nee nah-ree-mahs-kah?
translation: 少し食べただけで満腹になりますか？

english: Does your abdomen feel bloated or swollen?
transliteration: oh-nah-kah gah hah-ttah-ree, fuh-koo-rah-nde-eh ee-mahs-kah?
translation: お腹が張ったり、膨らんだりしていますか？

english: Are you passing more gas than usual?
transliteration: ee-ts-moh yoo-ree oh-nah-rah gah oh-oh-koo deh-mahs-kah?
translation: いつもよりおならが多く出ますか？

english: Have you lost your appetite?
transliteration: shoh-koo-yoh-koo gah nah-koo nah-ree-mah-shee-tah-kah?
translation: 食欲がなくなりましたか？

english: Have you lost weight without trying?
transliteration: toh-koo nee nah-nee-moh shee-teh ee-nah-ee noh nee, tah-ee-joo gah heh-ree-mah-shee-tah-kah?
translation: 特に何もしていないのに体重が減りましたか？

english: Have you gained weight unexpectedly?
transliteration: oh-moh-ee ah-tah-roo ree-yoo gah nah-ee noh nee, tah-ee-joo gah foo-eh-mah-shee-tah-kah?
translation: 思い当たる理由がないのに体重が増えましたか？

english: Have you changed your diet recently?
transliteration: sai-KIN, shoh-koo-jee noh nah-yoh-oh kah-eh-mah-shee-tah-kah?
translation: 最近、食事の内容を変えましたか？

english: Do you avoid any foods because of symptoms?
transliteration: shoh-joh gah deh-roo tah-meh nee, sah-keh-teh ee-roo tah-beh-moh-noh wah ah-ree-mahs-kah?
translation: 症状が出るために、避けている食べ物はありますか？

english: How much water do you drink each day?
transliteration: MAI-nee-chee, mee-zoo oh doh-noh koo-rai noh-mih-mahs-kah?
translation: 毎日、水をどのくらい飲みますか？

english: When did you last eat or drink?
transliteration: sai-goh nee tah-beh-tah-ree noh-nde-tah-ree shee-tah noh wah ee-ts-kah dehs-kah?
translation: 最後に食べたり飲んだりしたのはいつですか？

english: Have you ever had liver disease or hepatitis?
transliteration: KAN-zoh noh byoh-kee yah KAHN-ehn nee nah-tah koh-toh hah ah-ree-mahs-kah?
translation: 肝臓の病気や肝炎になったことはありますか？

english: Have your eyes or skin turned yellow?
transliteration: meh yah hah-dah gah kee-iroo-koo nah-ree-mah-shee-tah-kah?
translation: 目や皮膚が黄色くなりましたか？

english: Is your urine darker than usual?
transliteration: nyoh noh ee-roh gah ee-ts-moh yoh-ree koh-ee dehs-kah?
translation: 尿の色がいつもより濃いですか？

english: Do you have itching all over your body?
transliteration: kah-rah-dah zehn-TAI nee kah-yoo-mee gah ah-ree-mahs-kah?
translation: 体全体にかゆみがありますか？

english: Have you had gallstones?
transliteration: tahn-seh-kee gah deh-kee-tah koh-toh hah ah-ree-mahs-kah?
translation: 胆石ができたことはありますか？

english: Have you had your gallbladder removed?
transliteration: tahn-noh-oh oh teh-shoo-ts-shee-tah koh-toh hah ah-ree-mahs-kah?
translation: 胆のうを摘出したことはありますか？

english: Have you ever had pancreatitis?
transliteration: soo-ee-ehn nee nah-tah koh-toh hah ah-ree-mahs-kah?
translation: 膵炎になったことはありますか？

english: Have you noticed swelling in your abdomen or legs?
transliteration: oh-nah-kah yah ah-shee nee moo-koo-mee gah ah-ree-mahs-kah?
translation: お腹や脚にむくみがありますか？

english: Do you bruise or bleed easily?
transliteration: ah-zah gah deh-yah-soo-kah-ttah-ree, shoo-kkeh-ts oo-yah-soo-kah-ttah-ree shee-mahs-kah?
translation: あざができやすかったり、出血しやすかったりしますか？

english: Do you have pain around your anus?
transliteration: koh-mon noh mah-wah-ree nee ee-tah-mee gah ah-ree-mahs-kah?
translation: 肛門の周りに痛みがありますか？

english: Do you have hemorrhoids or piles?
transliteration: jee gah ah-ree-mahs-kah?
translation: 痔がありますか？

english: Do you notice blood on the toilet paper?
transliteration: toh-ee-reh-tt-oh peh-ppah nee chee gah ts-koo koh-toh gah ah-ree-mahs-kah?
translation: トイレットペーパーに血がつくことがありますか？

english: Do you have itching around your anus?
transliteration: koh-mon noh mah-wah-ree nee kah-yoo-mee gah ah-ree-mahs-kah?
translation: 肛門の周りにかゆみがありますか？

english: Have you noticed a lump near your anus?
transliteration: koh-mon noh chee-kah-koo nee shee-koh-ree gah ah-ree-mahs-kah?
translation: 肛門の近くにしこりがありますか？

english: Is there any discharge from your anus?
transliteration: koh-mon kah-rah nah-nee-kah fuhn-pee-ts-moo gah deh-mahs-kah?
translation: 肛門から何か分泌物が出ますか？

english: Do you have pain when passing stool?
transliteration: BEHN oh dah-soo toh-kee nee ee-tah-mee-mahs-kah?
translation: 便を出すときに痛みますか？

english: Have you ever had an ulcer in your stomach?
transliteration: ee-KAI-yoh nee nah-tah koh-toh hah ah-ree-mahs-kah?
translation: 胃潰瘍になったことはありますか？

english: Have you been diagnosed with Crohn's disease or ulcerative colitis?
transliteration: koo-ROH-ehn byoh mah-tah wah kah-ee-yoh-seh dah-ee-choh-ehn toh sheen-dahn sah-reh-tah koh-toh hah ah-ree-mahs-kah?
translation: クローン病または潰瘍性大腸炎と診断されたことはありますか？

english: Have you ever had irritable bowel syndrome?
transliteration: kah-BEEN-seh choh-oh-goon shoh-oh-koh-goon nee nah-tah koh-toh hah ah-ree-mahs-kah?
translation: 過敏性腸症候群になったことはありますか？

english: Have you had surgery on your abdomen?
transliteration: oh-nah-kah noh shoo-joot-soo oh oo-keh-tah koh-toh hah ah-ree-mahs-kah?
translation: お腹の手術を受けたことはありますか？

english: Have you had your appendix removed?
transliteration: choo-oh-sheh oh toh-ttah koh-toh hah ah-ree-mahs-kah?
translation: 虫垂を取ったことはありますか？

english: Has anyone in your family had bowel or stomach cancer?
transliteration: goh-kah-zok-oo nee dah-ee-choh-ehn yah ee-GAHN nee nah-tah hee-toh wah ee-mahs-kah?
translation: ご家族に大腸がんや胃がんになった人はいますか？

english: Have you had a colonoscopy before?
transliteration: ee-zehn, dah-ee-choh nah-ee-shee-kyoh keh-nsah oh oo-keh-tah koh-toh hah ah-ree-mahs-kah?
translation: 以前、大腸内視鏡検査を受けたことはありますか？

english: Do you have any food allergies or intolerances?
transliteration: shoh-koo-moh-too ah-ruh-REH-jee yah, tah-beh-moh-noh gah kah-rah-dah nee ah-wah-nah-ee koh-toh wah ah-ree-mahs-kah?
translation: 食物アレルギーや、食べ物が体に合わないことはありますか？

english: Have you travelled recently?
transliteration: sai-KIN, ryoh-KOH oh shee-mah-shee-tah-kah?
translation: 最近、旅行をしましたか？

english: Have you eaten any food that may have been spoiled?
transliteration: ee-tahn-deh ee-tah kah-moh-sheh-reh-nai tah-beh-moh-noh oh tah-beh-mah-shee-tah-kah?
translation: 傷んでいたかもしれない食べ物を食べましたか？

english: What medicines do you take regularly?
transliteration: foo-dahn, doh-noh yoo nah koo-soo-ree oh noh-mee-mahs-kah?
translation: 普段、どのような薬を飲んでいますか？

english: Do you take ibuprofen, naproxen, or aspirin?
transliteration: ee-boo-proh-fehn, nah-proh-kehn, mah-tah wah ah-soo-pee-rehn oh noh-nde ee-mahs-kah?
translation: イブプロフェン、ナプロキセン、またはアスピリンを飲んでいますか？

english: Do you take blood thinners?
transliteration: keh-ts-yoo oh sah-rah-sah-rah nee soo-roo koo-soo-ree oh noh-nde ee-mahs-kah?
translation: 血液をサラサラにする薬を飲んでいますか？

english: Have you taken antibiotics recently?
transliteration: sai-KIN, koh-soh-zai oh noh-mee-mah-shee-tah-kah?
translation: 最近、抗生物質を飲みましたか？

english: Have you started any new medicine or supplement?
transliteration: ah-tah-rah-shee-ee koo-soo-ree yah sah-ppoo-reh-mehn-toh oh ts-kah-ee-hah-jeh-mah-shee-tah-kah?
translation: 新しい薬やサプリメントを使い始めましたか？

english: Do you drink alcohol?
transliteration: oh-sah-keh oh noh-mee-mahs-kah?
translation: お酒を飲みますか？

english: How much alcohol do you usually drink in a week?
transliteration: foo-dahn, ee-ss-shoo-kahn nee doh-noh koo-rai oh-sah-keh oh noh-mee-mahs-kah?
translation: 普段、1週間にどのくらいお酒を飲みますか？

english: Have you ever had problems because of alcohol?
transliteration: oh-sah-keh gah geh-ehn deh koh-mah-ttah koh-toh wah ah-ree-mahs-kah?
translation: お酒が原因で困ったことはありますか？

english: Is your abdominal pain severe right now?
transliteration: ee-mah, oh-nah-kah noh ee-tah-mee wah hee-doh-ee dehs-kah?
translation: 今、お腹の痛みはひどいですか？

english: Is your abdomen hard or very tender to touch?
transliteration: oh-nah-kah gah kah-tah-koo nah-tt-eh ee-mahs-kah? sah-wah-roo toh toh-teh-moh ee-tah-mee-mahs-kah?
translation: お腹が硬くなっていますか？触るととても痛みますか？

english: Have you fainted or felt very dizzy?
transliteration: kee oh oo-shi-nah-ttah-ree, hee-doh-koo meh-mah-ee gah shee-tah-ree shee-mah-shee-tah-kah?
translation: 気を失ったり、ひどくめまいがしたりしましたか？

english: Are you vomiting blood?
transliteration: chee oh hah-ee-teh ee-mahs-kah?
translation: 血を吐いていますか？

english: Are you passing black, tarry stool?
transliteration: koo-roh-koo-teh TAH-roo noh yoo nah BEHN gah deh-teh ee-mahs-kah?
translation: 黒くてタールのような便が出ていますか？

english: Are you passing a large amount of blood in your stool?
transliteration: BEHN nee TAI-ryoh noh chee gah mah-jee-tt-eh ee-mahs-kah?
translation: 便に大量の血が混じっていますか？

english: Are you unable to pass stool or gas?
transliteration: BEHN moh oh-nah-rah moh dah-seh-nai joh-tai dehs-kah?
translation: 便もおならも出せない状態ですか？

english: Have you stopped passing urine or are you urinating much less?
transliteration: nyoh gah deh-nah-koo nah-ttah-ree, nyoh noh ryoh gah kah-nah-ree heh-ttah-ree shee-mah-shee-tah-kah?
translation: 尿が出なくなったり、尿の量がかなり減ったりしましたか？

english: Do you have fever with severe abdominal pain?
transliteration: hee-doh-ee fuh-koo-ts-oo toh hah-ts-neh-ts gah ah-ree-mahs-kah?
translation: ひどい腹痛と発熱がありますか？

english: Is there any chance you could be pregnant?
transliteration: neen-shin shee-teh ee-roo kah-noh-seh-ee wah ah-ree-mahs-kah?
translation: 妊娠している可能性はありますか？

english: Please lie down on your back.
transliteration: ah-oh-moo-keh nee neh-teh koo-dah-sai.
translation: 仰向けに寝てください。

english: Please bend your knees slightly.
transliteration: hee-zah oh soo-koh-shee mah-geh-teh koo-dah-sai.
translation: 膝を少し曲げてください。

english: Please lift your shirt so I can examine your abdomen.
transliteration: oh-nah-kah oh sheen-sah deh-kee-roo yoo nee, shah-tsu oh ah-geh-teh koo-dah-sai.
translation: お腹を診察できるように、シャツを上げてください。

english: I am going to listen to your abdomen.
transliteration: oh-nah-kah noh oh-toh oh kee-kee-mahs.
translation: お腹の音を聞きます。

english: I am going to press gently on your abdomen.
transliteration: oh-nah-kah oh soh-tt-oh oh-soo-sheh-mahs.
translation: お腹をそっと押します。

english: Tell me if it hurts when I press here.
transliteration: koh-koh oh oh-shi-tah toh-kee nee ee-tah-kah-ttah-rah oh-shee-eh-teh koo-dah-sai.
translation: ここを押したときに痛かったら教えてください。

english: Does it hurt more when I let go?
transliteration: teh oh hah-nah-soo toh-kee noh hoh-oh gah ee-tah-ee dehs-kah?
translation: 手を離すときのほうが痛いですか？

english: Please take a deep breath.
transliteration: shinn-koh-koo-koo ee-kee oh shee-teh koo-dah-sai.
translation: 深呼吸してください。

english: I may need to examine your rectum, and I will explain why first.
transliteration: chee-choh-koo noh sheen-sah gah hee-ts-yooh nee nah-roo bah-ee gah ah-ree-mahs. mah-zoo, soh-noh ree-yoo oh goh-sheh-mee-shee-mahs.
translation: 直腸の診察が必要になる場合があります。まず、その理由をご説明します。

english: We would like to do some blood tests.
transliteration: keh-ts-yoo-kehn-sah oh shee-tah-ee toh oh-moh-ee-mahs.
translation: 血液検査をしたいと思います。

english: We need a stool sample.
transliteration: BEHN noh kehhn-tai gah hee-ts-yooh dehs.
translation: 便の検体が必要です。

english: Please collect a stool sample in this container.
transliteration: koh-noh yoo-kee nee BEHN noh kehhn-tai oh toh-tt-eh koo-dah-sai.
translation: この容器に便の検体を採ってください。

english: We may need an ultrasound of your abdomen.
transliteration: oh-nah-kah noh choh-oh-nahm-pah keh-nsah gah hee-ts-yooh nee nah-roo bah-ee gah ah-ree-mahs.
translation: お腹の超音波検査が必要になる場合があります。

english: We may need a CT scan of your abdomen.
transliteration: oh-nah-kah noh see-TEE keh-nsah gah hee-ts-yooh nee nah-roo bah-ee gah ah-ree-mahs.
translation: お腹のCT検査が必要になる場合があります。

english: A gastroscopy uses a small camera to look inside your food pipe and stomach.
transliteration: ee-kah-meh-rah keh-nsah deh wah, chee-sai kah-meh-rah deh shoh-koo-doh toh ee noh nah-kah oh mee-mahs.
translation: 胃カメラ検査では、小さなカメラで食道と胃の中を見ます。

english: A colonoscopy uses a camera to look inside your large intestine.
transliteration: dah-ee-choh nah-ee-shee-kyoh keh-nsah deh wah, kah-meh-rah deh dah-ee-choh noh nah-kah oh mee-mahs.
translation: 大腸内視鏡検査では、カメラで大腸の中を見ます。

english: You may need to take bowel preparation before the colonoscopy.
transliteration: dah-ee-choh nah-ee-shee-kyoh keh-nsah noh mae nee, choh-oh oh kee-reh-ee nee soo-roo koo-soo-ree oh noh-moo hee-ts-yooh gah ah-roo kah-moh shee-reh-mah-sehn.
translation: 大腸内視鏡検査の前に、腸をきれいにする薬を飲む必要があるかもしれません。

english: You may need to avoid eating or drinking before the procedure.
transliteration: shoh-chi noh mae nee, tah-beh-tah-ree noh-nde-tah-ree shee-nah-ee yoo nee soo-roo hee-ts-yooh gah ah-roo kah-moh shee-reh-mah-sehn.
translation: 処置の前に、食べたり飲んだりしないようにする必要があるかもしれません。

english: We will explain the risks and ask for your consent before the procedure.
transliteration: shoh-chi noh mae nee, ree-skoo oh goh-sheh-mee-shee, doh-ee oh ee-tah-dah-kee-mahs.

english: Do your urinary symptoms change around your period?
transliteration: gek-ke-i no zen-go de, ha-i-NYO-o no sho-o-JO-o ni hen-KA ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 月経の前後で、排尿の症状に変化がありますか？

english: Have you had any pregnancies or deliveries?
transliteration: nin-shin ya shussan o kei-ken shi-ta ko-to ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 妊娠や出産を経験したことがありますか？

english: Have you had surgery in your pelvis?
transliteration: ko-tsu-ban no shu-JU-tsu o u-ke-ta ko-to ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 骨盤の手術を受けたことがありますか？

english: Do you currently have a urinary catheter?
transliteration: gen-ZAI, nyo-o-do-o ka-te-e-te-ru o i-re-te i-MAS-ka?
translation: 現在、尿道カテーテルを入れていますか？

english: When was your catheter last changed?
transliteration: ka-te-e-te-ru o sa-i-GO ni ko-o-kan shi-ta no wa I-tsu des-ka?
translation: カテーテルを最後に交換したのはいつですか？

english: Is urine draining into the bag normally?
transliteration: nyo-o wa fukuro ni tsu-ne-do-o-ri na-ga-re-te i-MAS-ka?
translation: 尿は袋に通常どおり流れていますか？

english: Is there pain or leakage around the catheter?
transliteration: ka-te-e-te-ru no ma-wa-ri ni i-TA-mi ya nyo-o mo-re wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: カテーテルの周りに痛みや尿漏れはありますか？

english: Have you noticed blood or clots in the catheter bag?
transliteration: ka-te-e-te-ru no bag-gu ni chi ya chi no ka-ta-ma-ri ga hait-te i-ru ko-to ni ki-zu-ki-MAS-ta-ka?
translation: カテーテルのバッグに血や血のかたまりが入っていることに気づきましたか？

english: Has the catheter stopped draining?
transliteration: ka-te-e-te-ru ka-ra nyo-o ga de-na-ku nat-ta des-ka?
translation: カテーテルから尿が出なくなりましたか？

english: Do you use a catheter yourself to empty your bladder?
transliteration: go-ji-shin de ka-te-e-te-ru o tsukat-te bo-o-ko-o no nyo-o o da-shi-te i-MAS-ka?
translation: ご自分でカテーテルを使って膀胱の尿を出していますか？

english: Have you had urinary tract infections before?
transliteration: ko-re ma-de ni nyo-o-ro kan-sen-sho-o ni ka-kat-ta ko-to wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: これまでに尿路感染症にかかったことはありますか？

english: Have you had any surgery on your kidneys or bladder?
transliteration: jin-zo-o ya bo-o-ko-o no shu-JU-tsu o u-ke-ta ko-to wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 腎臓や膀胱の手術を受けたことはありますか？

english: Have you ever had surgery on your prostate?
transliteration: zen-ri-tsu-sen no shu-JU-tsu o u-ke-ta ko-to wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 前立腺の手術を受けたことはありますか？

english: Have you had cancer of the kidney, bladder, or prostate?
transliteration: jin-zo-o, bo-o-ko-o, ma-ta-wa zen-ri-tsu-sen no gan ni ka-kat-ta ko-to wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 腎臓、膀胱、または前立腺のがんにかかったことはありますか？

english: Does anyone in your family have kidney disease?
transliteration: go-ka-ZO-ku ni jin-zo-o no byo-o-ki ga a-ru ka-ta wa i-MAS-ka?
translation: ご家族に腎臓の病気がある方はいますか？

english: Does anyone in your family have kidney stones?
transliteration: go-ka-ZO-ku ni jin-zo-o ke-sshi ga a-ru ka-ta wa i-MAS-ka?
translation: ご家族に腎臓結石がある方はいますか？

english: Does anyone in your family have prostate cancer?
transliteration: go-ka-ZO-ku ni zen-ri-tsu-sen gan no ka-ta wa i-MAS-ka?
translation: ご家族に前立腺がんの方はいますか？

english: Do you smoke or have you smoked in the past?
transliteration: i-ma ta-ba-ko o sut-te i-MAS-ka, ma-ta-wa i-ZEN sut-te i-MAS-ta-ka?
translation: 今たばこを吸っていますか、または以前吸っていましたか？

english: What medicines are you currently taking?
transliteration: gen-ZAI, do-no yo-o-na o-ku-su-ri o non-de i-MAS-ka?
translation: 現在、どのようなお薬を飲んでいますか？

english: Have you started any new medicine recently?
transliteration: sa-i-KIN, a-ta-ra-shi-i ku-su-ri o no-mi-ha-ji-me-MAS-ta-ka?
translation: 最近、新しい薬を飲み始めましたか？

english: Are you taking antibiotics for a urinary infection?
transliteration: nyo-o-ro kan-sen-sho-o no ta-me ni ko-o-se-i-bus-shi-tsu o non-de i-MAS-ka?
translation: 尿路感染症のために抗生物質を飲んでいますか？

english: How many days have you taken the antibiotic?
transliteration: ko-o-se-i-bus-shi-tsu o NAN-ni-chi-kan no-mi-MAS-ta-ka?
translation: 抗生物質を何日間飲みましたか？

english: Do you take medicines for your prostate?
transliteration: zen-ri-tsu-sen no ku-su-ri o non-de i-MAS-ka?
translation: 前立腺の薬を飲んでいますか？

english: Do you take medicine to help with erections?
transliteration: bok-ki o ta-su-ke-ru ku-su-ri o non-de i-MAS-ka?
translation: 勃起を助ける薬を飲んでいますか？

english: Do you take painkillers such as ibuprofen regularly?
transliteration: i-bu-pu-ro-fen na-do no i-TA-mi-do-me o te-i-ki-te-ki ni non-de i-MAS-ka?
translation: イブプロフェンなどの痛み止めを定期的に飲んでいますか？

english: Do you have any medication allergies?
transliteration: ku-su-ri de a-re-ru-gii ga de-ta ko-to wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 薬でアレルギーが出たことはありますか？

english: Are you completely unable to pass urine?
transliteration: mat-ta-ku nyo-o ga de-na-i jo-o-ta-i des-ka?
translation: まったく尿が出ない状態ですか？

english: Do you have severe pain in a testicle that began suddenly?
transliteration: ka-ta-ho-o no ko-o-GAN ni to-TSU-zen, tsu-yo-i i-TA-mi ga de-MAS-ta-ka?
translation: 片方の睾丸に突然、強い痛みが出ましたか？

english: Do you have fever with severe back or side pain?
transliteration: ne-tsu ga a-ri, se-NA-ka ya wa-ki-ba-ra ni tsu-yo-i i-TA-mi ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 熱があり、背中や脇腹に強い痛みがありますか？

english: Are you passing large blood clots in your urine?
transliteration: nyo-o ni o-o-ki-na chi no ka-ta-ma-ri ga de-te i-MAS-ka?
translation: 尿に大きな血のかたまりが出ていますか？

english: Are you feeling faint, confused, or very unwell?
transliteration: ki ga to-o-ku na-ru, kon-ran su-ru, ma-ta-wa hi-do-ku gu-a-i ga wa-ru-i to kan-JI-MAS-ka?
translation: 気が遠くなる、混乱する、またはひどく具合が悪いと感じますか？

english: Have you had new weakness or numbness in your legs?
transliteration: sa-i-KIN, a-shi ni chi-ka-ra ga ha-i-ra-na-ku nat-ta-ri, shi-bi-re-ta-ri shi-MAS-ta-ka?
translation: 最近、脚に力が入らなくなったり、しびれたりしましたか？

english: Have you lost feeling around your groin or private parts?
transliteration: mo-mo ya in-BU no kan-KA-ku ga na-ku na-ri-MAS-ta-ka?
translation: 股や陰部の感覚がなくなりましたか？

english: Have you suddenly lost control of your bladder or bowels?
transliteration: to-TSU-zen, nyo-o ya ben o ga-MAN de-ki-na-ku nat-ta des-ka?
translation: 突然、尿や便を我慢できなくなりましたか？

english: Have you been vomiting and unable to keep fluids down?
transliteration: ha-i-te, su-i-bun o tot-te mo ha-ka-zu ni i-ra-re-na-i jo-o-ta-i des-ka?
translation: 吐いて、水分をとっても吐かずにいられない状態ですか？

english: Please lie down on your back.
transliteration: a-o-mu-ke ni ne-te ku-da-SA-i.
translation: 仰向けに寝てください。

english: I will examine your abdomen and lower back.
transliteration: o-na-ka to ko-shi o shin-SA-tsu shi-MAS.
translation: お腹と腰を診察します。

english: Please point to the area that hurts.
transliteration: i-ta-mu ba-SHO o yu-bi de shi-me-shi-te ku-da-SA-i.
translation: 痛む場所を指で示してください。

english: I will press gently on your lower abdomen.
transliteration: ka-FU-ku-bu o ya-sa-shi-ku o-shi-MAS.
translation: 下腹部を優しく押します。

english: Tell me if it hurts when I press here.
transliteration: ko-ko o o-shi-ta to-ki ni i-ta-kat-ta-ra o-shi-e-te ku-da-SA-i.
translation: ここを押したときに痛かったら教えてください。

english: I am going to tap gently on your back near the kidneys.
transliteration: jin-zo-o no a-ta-ri no se-NA-ka o ya-sa-shi-ku ta-ta-ki-MAS.
translation: 腎臓のあたりの背中を優しくたたきます。

english: I may need to examine your genital area; I will explain and ask permission first.
transliteration: in-BU o shin-SA-tsu su-ru hi-TSU-yo-o ga a-ru ka-mo shi-re-MAS-en. sa-ki ni se-tsu-me-i shi-te, kyo-KA o i-ta-da-ki-MAS.
translation: 陰部を診察する必要があるかもしれません。先に説明して、許可をいただきます。

english: Please tell me immediately if anything hurts.
transliteration: i-ta-i to-ko-ro ga a-re-ba, su-gu ni o-shi-e-te ku-da-SA-i.
translation: 痛いところがあれば、すぐに教えてください。

english: We can pause or stop the examination at any time.
transliteration: shin-SA-tsu wa i-tsu de-mo i-CHI-ji chu-u-dan shi-ta-ri, ya-me-ta-ri de-ki-MAS.
translation: 診察はいつでも一時中断したり、やめたりできます。

english: A prostate examination may be helpful; I will explain it first.
transliteration: zen-ri-tsu-sen no shin-SA-tsu o su-ru to ya-ku-da-tsu ba-a-i ga a-ri-MAS. sa-ki ni se-tsu-me-i shi-MAS.
translation: 前立腺の診察をすると役立つ場合があります。先に説明します。

english: The prostate examination may involve a gloved finger in the rectum.
transliteration: zen-ri-tsu-sen no shin-SA-tsu de wa, te-bu-ku-ro o shi-ta yu-bi o ko-o-mon ka-ra i-re-ru ko-to ga a-ri-MAS.
translation: 前立腺の診察では、手袋をした指を肛門から入れることがあります。

english: Is it okay to proceed with this examination?
transliteration: ko-no shin-SA-tsu o u-ke-te mo yo-ro-SHI-i des-ka?
translation: この診察を受けてもよろしいですか？

english: Would you like a chaperone for this examination?
transliteration: ko-no shin-SA-tsu ni tsu-ki-so-i no hi-to o ki-bo-o sa-re-MAS-ka?
translation: この診察に付き添いの人を希望されますか？

english: Please turn onto your side.
transliteration: yo-ko-mu-ki ni nat-te ku-da-SA-i.
translation: 横向きになってください。

english: Please bend your knees toward your chest.
transliteration: hi-za o mu-ne no ho-o ni ma-ge-te ku-da-SA-i.
translation: 膝を胸のほうに曲げてください。

english: I will check for swelling or tenderness in the scrotum.
transliteration: in-no-o no ha-re ya i-TA-mi o ka-ku-NIN shi-MAS.
translation: 陰嚢の腫れや痛みを確認します。

english: Please cough while I examine your groin.
transliteration: ma-ta no a-ta-ri o shin-SA-tsu shi-te i-ru a-i-da, se-ki o shi-te ku-da-SA-i.
translation: 股のあたりを診察している間、咳をしてください。

english: We need a urine sample.
transliteration: nyo-o no ken-TAI ga hi-TSU-yo-o des.
translation: 尿の検体が必要です。

english: Please collect urine in this clean container.
transliteration: ko-no sei-ke-tsu-na yo-o-ki ni nyo-o o tot-te ku-da-SA-i.
translation: この清潔な容器に尿を採ってください。

english: We will test your urine for infection and blood.
transliteration: nyo-o o shi-ra-be-te, kan-sen ya chi ga a-ru ka ka-ku-NIN shi-MAS.
translation: 尿を調べて、感染や血があるか確認します。

english: We may send the urine for a culture.
transliteration: nyo-o o bai-yo-o ken-SA ni da-su ko-to ga a-ri-MAS.
translation: 尿を培養検査に出すことがあります。

english: We would like to check your kidney function with blood tests.
transliteration: ke-tsu-e-ki ken-SA de jin-zo-o no ha-ta-ra-ki o shi-ra-be-ta-i to o-mo-i-MAS.
translation: 血液検査で腎臓の働きを調べたいと思います。

english: We may arrange an ultrasound of your kidneys and bladder.
transliteration: jin-zo-o to bo-o-ko-o no cho-o-on-pa ken-SA o te-ha-i su-ru ko-to ga a-ri-MAS.
translation: 腎臓と膀胱の超音波検査を手配することがあります。

english: We may need a CT scan to look for kidney stones.
transliteration: jin-zo-o ke-sshi o shi-ra-be-ru ta-me ni shi-i-tee ken-SA ga hi-TSU-yo-o ni na-ru ko-to ga a-ri-MAS.
translation: 腎臓結石を調べるためにCT検査が必要になることがあります。

english: We may check how much urine remains in your bladder after you urinate.
transliteration: ha-i-NYO-o go ni bo-o-ko-o ni do-re ku-RA-i nyo-o ga nokot-te i-ru ka shi-ra-be-ru ko-to ga a-ri-MAS.
translation: 排尿後に膀胱にどれくらい尿が残っているか調べることがあります。

english: We may need a camera examination of the bladder called cystoscopy.
transliteration: bo-o-ko-o-kyo-o ken-SA to i-u, ka-me-ra de bo-o-ko-o no na-ka o mi-ru ken-SA ga hi-TSU-yo-o ni na-ru ko-to ga a-ri-MAS.
translation: 膀胱鏡検査という、カメラで膀胱の中を見る検査が必要になることがあります。

english: We may need to give you antibiotics.
transliteration: ko-o-se-i-bus-shi-tsu o tsu-ka-u hi-TSU-yo-o ga a-ru ka-mo shi-re-MAS-en.
translation: 抗生物質を使う必要があるかもしれません。

english: Please take this medicine exactly as prescribed.
transliteration: ko-no ku-su-ri wa sho-ho-o-do-o-ri ni non-de ku-da-SA-i.
translation: この薬は処方どおりに飲んでください。

english: You may need a catheter to drain your bladder.
transliteration: bo-o-ko-o ka-ra nyo-o o da-su ta-me ni ka-te-e-te-ru ga hi-TSU-yo-o ni na-ru ko-to ga a-ri-MAS.
translation: 膀胱から尿を出すためにカテーテルが必要になることがあります。

english: We will explain the catheter procedure and ask for your consent.
transliteration: ka-te-e-te-ru o i-re-ru te-JUN o se-tsu-me-i shi, do-o-i o i-ta-da-ki-MAS.
translation: カテーテルを入れる手順を説明し、同意をいただきます。

english: Please keep the catheter bag below the level of your bladder.
transliteration: ka-te-e-te-ru no bag-gu wa bo-o-ko-o yo-ri hi-ku-i i-CHI ni o-i-te ku-da-SA-i.
translation: カテーテルのバッグは膀胱より低い位置に置いてください。

english: You may need to strain your urine to collect a stone.
transliteration: ke-sshi o to-ru ta-me ni, nyo-o o ko-shi-te i-ta-da-ku ko-to ga a-ri-MAS.
translation: 結石を採るために、尿をこしていただくことがあります。

english: We may refer you to a urologist.
transliteration: hi-nyo-o-ki-ka no sen-mon-i o sho-o-ka-i su-ru ko-to ga a-ri-MAS.
translation: 泌尿器科の専門医を紹介することがあります。

english: We may refer you to a kidney specialist.
transliteration: jin-zo-o no sen-mon-i o sho-o-ka-i su-ru ko-to ga a-ri-MAS.
translation: 腎臓の専門医を紹介することがあります。

english: If you cannot urinate or develop severe pain or fever, seek urgent care.
transliteration: nyo-o ga de-na-ku nat-ta-ri, tsu-yo-i i-TA-mi ya ne-tsu ga de-ta-ri shi-ta ba-a-i wa, su-gu ni i-RYO-o ki-KAN o ju-SHIN shi-te ku-da-SA-i.
translation: 尿が出なくなったり、強い痛みや熱が出たりした場合は、すぐに医療機関を受診してください。

english: Do you have any questions?
transliteration: NA-ni-ka shi-TSU-mon wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 何か質問はありますか？

english: Can you tell me which symptoms would need urgent medical attention?
transliteration: do-no yo-o-na sho-o-JO-o ga a-re-ba, su-gu ni i-RYO-o ki-KAN o ju-SHIN su-ru hi-TSU-yo-o ga a-ru ka se-tsu-me-i shi-te i-ta-da-ke-MAS-ka?
translation: どのような症状があれば、すぐに医療機関を受診する必要があるか説明していただけますか？

english: We will arrange a follow-up appointment.
transliteration: sa-i-SHIN no yo-YA-ku o te-HAI shi-MAS.
translation: 再診の予約を手配します。

english: Please return if your symptoms worsen.
transliteration: sho-o-JO-o ga a-KA-ka shi-TA-ra, ma-ta ju-SHIN shi-te ku-da-SA-i.
translation: 症状が悪化したら、また受診してください。

english: Thank you for speaking with me today.
transliteration: KYO-o wa o-HA-na-shi i-ta-da-ki, a-ri-ga-to-o go-ZA-i-MAS-ta.
translation: 今日はお話しいただき、ありがとうございました。

english: What brings you in today?
transliteration: KYO-o wa do-o sa-re-MAS-ta-ka?
translation: 今日はどうされましたか？

english: When did your symptoms start?
transliteration: sho-o-JO-o wa I-tsu ha-ji-ma-ri-MAS-ta-ka?
translation: 症状はいつ始まりましたか？

english: Have your symptoms been getting worse?
transliteration: sho-o-JO-o wa a-KA-ka shi-te i-MAS-ka?
translation: 症状は悪化していますか？

english: Do you have any other symptoms?
transliteration: ho-ka ni NA-ni-ka sho-o-JO-o wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: ほかに何か症状はありますか？

english: May I ask about your medical history?
transliteration: ko-re ma-de no byo-o-re-ki ni tsu-i-te u-ka-ga-tte mo yo-ro-SHI-i des-ka?
translation: これまでの病歴について伺ってもよろしいですか？

english: May I examine you?
transliteration: shin-SA-tsu shi-te mo yo-ro-SHI-i des-ka?
translation: 診察してもよろしいですか？

english: Would you like an interpreter?
transliteration: tsu-u-YA-ku o go-ki-bo-o des-ka?
translation: 通訳をご希望ですか？

english: Have you been diagnosed with diabetes?
transliteration: to-o-nyo-o-byo-o to shin-dan sa-re-ta ko-to wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 糖尿病と診断されたことはありますか？

english: Do you have type 1 or type 2 diabetes?
transliteration: i-CHI-ga-ta to-o-nyo-o-byo-o des-ka, so-re-to-mo ni-ga-ta to-o-nyo-o-byo-o des-ka?
translation: 1型糖尿病ですか、それとも2型糖尿病ですか？

english: How long have you had diabetes?
transliteration: to-o-nyo-o-byo-o ni nat-te do-no ku-RA-i des-ka?
translation: 糖尿病になってどれくらいですか？

english: Are you more thirsty than usual?
transliteration: i-tsu-mo yo-ri no-do ga ka-wa-ki-MAS-ka?
translation: いつもより喉が渇きますか？

english: Are you urinating more often?
transliteration: i-tsu-mo yo-ri hin-PAN ni nyo-o ga de-MAS-ka?
translation: いつもより頻繁に尿が出ますか？

english: Do you wake up at night to urinate?
transliteration: YO-ru, nyo-o o su-ru ta-me ni me ga sa-me-MAS-ka?
translation: 夜、尿をするために目が覚めますか？

english: Have you lost weight without trying?
transliteration: to-ku ni NA-ni mo shi-te i-na-i no ni tai-JU ga he-ri-MAS-ta-ka?
translation: 特に何もしていないのに体重が減りましたか？

english: Do you feel more hungry than usual?
transliteration: i-tsu-mo yo-ri o-na-ka ga su-ki-MAS-ka?
translation: いつもよりお腹が空きますか？

english: Have you noticed blurred vision?
transliteration: shi-KAI ga bo-ya-ke-ru ko-to ni ki-zu-ki-MAS-ta-ka?
translation: 視界がぼやけることに気づきましたか？

english: Do you feel unusually tired?
transliteration: i-tsu-mo yo-ri tsu-ka-re ya-su-i des-ka?
translation: いつもより疲れやすいですか？

english: Have you had frequent infections?
transliteration: kan-sen-sho-o ni nan-do mo ka-ka-ri-MAS-ta-ka?
translation: 感染症に何度もかかりましたか？

english: Do your wounds take a long time to heal?
transliteration: ki-zu ga na-o-ru no ni ji-kan ga ka-ka-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 傷が治るのに時間がかかりますか？

english: Do you check your blood sugar at home?
transliteration: ji-TA-ku de ket-to-o-chi o ha-kat-te i-MAS-ka?
translation: 自宅で血糖値を測っていますか？

english: How often do you check your blood sugar?
transliteration: do-no ku-RA-i no hin-DO de ket-to-o-chi o ha-kat-te i-MAS-ka?
translation: どのくらいの頻度で血糖値を測っていますか？

english: What was your last blood sugar reading?
transliteration: sa-i-GO ni ha-kat-ta ket-to-o-chi wa i-ku-tsu desh-ta-ka?
translation: 最後に測った血糖値はいくつでしたか？

english: Do you use a continuous glucose monitor?

transliteration: teh gah foor-eh-teh ee-roo kah kah-koo-nee shee-teh ee-mahs
translation: 手が震えているか確認しています。

english: Please tilt your head back slightly.
transliteration: ah-tah-mah oh soo-koh-shee oh-koh-nee kah-tah-mekh-teh koo-dah-sah-ee
translation: 頭を少し後ろに傾けてください。

english: Please swallow while I examine your neck.
transliteration: koo-bee oh sheen-sah-tsu shee-teh ee-roo ah-ee-dah-nee, tsu-bah oh noh-mee-kohn-deh koo-dah-sah-ee
translation: 首を診察している間に、つばを飲み込んでください。

english: I am going to feel your thyroid gland.
transliteration: koh-joh-sehn-nee foo-reh-teh kah-koo-neemahs
translation: 甲状腺に触れて確認します。

english: Please follow my finger with your eyes.
transliteration: meh deh wah-tah-shee noh yoo-bee oh oh-ee-kah-keh-teh koo-dah-sah-ee
translation: 目で私の指を追ってください。

english: I am going to examine your feet for sores.
transliteration: ah-shee-nee kee-zu gah nah-ee kah kah-koo-neemahs
translation: 足に傷がないか診察します。

english: Please tell me when you feel this touch.
transliteration: koh-noh kahn-shoh gah wah-kah-tah-rah oh-shee-eh-teh koo-dah-sah-ee
translation: この感触がわかったら教えてください。

english: I am going to check your reflexes.
transliteration: hehn-shah oh kah-koo-neemahs
translation: 反射を確認します。

english: We need a blood test to check your thyroid hormones.
transliteration: koh-joh-sehn hoh-mohn oh shee-rah-beh-roo tah-meh-nee, keh-tsu-eh-kee kehhn-sah gah hee-tsu-yoh deh-soo
translation: 甲状腺ホルモンを調べるために、血液検査が必要です。

english: We will check your HbA1c to assess your average blood sugar.
transliteration: hehn-keen-tah-kee nah keh-toh-chee oh shee-rah-beh-roo tah-meh-nee, eh-chee-bee-ehh eh-ee seh-kee oh hah-kah-ree-mahs
translation: 平均的な血糖値を調べるために、HbA1cを測ります。

english: We need to check your kidney function.
transliteration: jeen-zoh noh kee-noh oh shee-rah-beh-roo hee-tsu-yoh gah ah-ree-mahs
translation: 腎臓の機能を調べる必要があります。

english: We will check your cholesterol.
transliteration: koh-reh-soh-teh-roo-chee oh shee-rah-beh-mahs
translation: コレステロール値を調べます。

english: We need a urine sample.
transliteration: nyoh-kee kehhn-tah-ee gah hee-tsu-yoh deh-soo
translation: 尿検体が必要です。

english: You may need an ultrasound of your thyroid.
transliteration: koh-joh-sehn noh choh-on-pah kehhn-sah gah hee-tsu-yoh nee nah-roo kah-moh shee-reh-mah-sehn
translation: 甲状腺の超音波検査が必要になるかもしれません。

english: We may need a bone density scan.
transliteration: koh-tsu mee-tsu-doh kehhn-sah gah hee-tsu-yoh nee nah-roo kah-moh shee-reh-mah-sehn
translation: 骨密度検査が必要になるかもしれません。

english: Please follow the fasting instructions for this test.
transliteration: koh-noh kehhn-sah noh mah-eh wah, shee-gee doh-ree shoh-koo-jee oh hee-kah-eh-teh koo-dah-sah-ee
translation: この検査の前は、指示どおり食事を控えてください。

english: We will review your medications together.
transliteration: koo-soo-ree oh ee-shoh-nee kah-koo-neemahs
translation: 薬を一緒に確認します。

english: Please take this medicine as prescribed.
transliteration: shoh-hoh-sah-reh-tah doh-ree-nee koh-noh koo-soo-ree oh nohhn-deh koo-dah-sah-ee
translation: 処方されたとおりにこの薬を飲んでください。

english: Do not change your insulin dose without guidance.
transliteration: shee-gee oh oo-keh-zoo-nee eehn-soo-reen noh ryoh oh kah-eh-nah-ee deh koo-dah-sah-ee
translation: 指示を受けずにインスリンの量を変えないでください。

english: Do not stop long-term steroids suddenly without medical advice.
transliteration: ee-shee-nee soh-dahn seh-zoo-nee, choh-kee-rah yoo-koo tsook-ah-ee-teh-ee-roo soot-eh-roh-ee-doh-koo-soo-ree oh kyoo-nee yah-meh-nah-ee deh koo-dah-sah-ee
translation: 医師に相談せずに、長期間使っているステロイド薬を急にやめないでください。

english: We can arrange a visit with a diabetes educator.
transliteration: toh-nyoh-byoh-ryoh-yoh shee-doh-shee toh noh mehhn-dahn oh teh-hah-ee deh-kee-mahs
translation: 糖尿病療養指導士との面談を手配できます。

english: Please bring your medicines and glucose readings next time.
transliteration: jee-kah-ee wah koo-soo-ree toh keh-toh-chee noh kee-roh-koo oh moh-teh-kee-teh koo-dah-sah-ee
translation: 次回は薬と血糖値の記録を持ってきてください。

english: We will discuss a plan that works for you.
transliteration: ah-nah-tah-nee ah-tah-shitah keh-ee-kah-nee tsu-ee-tah keh-kee-kah-koo oh hah-nah-shee-mahs
translation: あなたに合った計画について話し合います。

english: Are you very drowsy or confused?
transliteration: hee-doh-koo neh-moo-kah-tah-ree, ah-tah-mah gah kahn-rahhn shee-tah-ree shee-teh ee-mahs-kah
translation: ひどく眠かったり、頭が混乱したりしていますか？

english: Are you vomiting and unable to keep fluids down?
transliteration: hah-ee-teh shee-ma-ee, soo-ee-bun oh toh-teh-moh hah-ee-zoo-nee ee-rah-reh-nah-ee jyoh-tah-ee deh-soo-kah
translation: 吐いてしまい、水分を取っても吐かずにいられない状態ですか？

english: Do you have severe weakness or fainting?
transliteration: hee-doh-koo cheek-ah-rah gah hah-ee-rah-nah-kah-tah-ree, kee oh oo-shi-nah-tah-ree shee-teh ee-mahs-kah
translation: ひどく力が入らなかったり、気を失ったりしていますか？

english: Seek urgent medical help if you become confused or faint.
transliteration: ah-tah-mah gah kahn-rahhn shee-tah-ree, kee oh oo-shi-nah-tah-ree shee-tah bah-ee-wah, soo-goo-nee ee-ryoh-kee-kahn oh joo-shin shee-teh koo-dah-sah-ee
translation: 頭が混乱したり、気を失ったりした場合は、すぐに医療機関を受診してください。

english: When is your next follow-up appointment?
transliteration: tsu-gee noh keh-ah-soo kahn-sah-tsu noh yoo-yakoo wah ee-tsu deh-soo-kah
translation: 次の経過観察の予約はいつですか？

english: Do you have any questions about the plan?
transliteration: keh-kah-koo-nee tsu-ee-teh nah-nee kah shih-tsu-mon wah ah-ree-mahs-kah
translation: 計画について何か質問はありますか？

english: What would you like help with today?
transliteration: kyoh wah doh-noh-yoh nah koh-toh deh oh-teh-tsu-dah-ee deh-kee-mahs-kah
translation: 今日はどのようなことでお手伝いできますか？

english: How have you been feeling lately?
transliteration: sah-ee-keen, kee-moh-chee wah ee-kah-gah deh-soo-kah
translation: 最近、気分はいかがですか？

english: Is it okay if I ask some personal questions?
transliteration: koh-jin-teh-kee nah koh-toh oh ee-koo-tsu-kah oh-kee-kee shee-teh moh yoh-roh-shee-ee deh-soo-kah
translation: 個人的なことをいくつか質問してもよろしいですか？

english: You can tell me if a question feels uncomfortable.
transliteration: kah-tah-eh-nee-koo-ee shee-tsu-mon gah ah-reh-bah, oh-shee-eh-teh koo-dah-sah-ee
translation: 答えにくい質問があれば、教えてください。

english: I will listen without judging you.
transliteration: ah-nah-tah oh hee-hee-hah seh-zoo-nee oh-hahn-ah-shee oh kee-kee-mahs
translation: あなたを批判せずにお話を聞きます。

english: Would you prefer to speak with an interpreter?
transliteration: tsu-yakoo noh kah-tah toh hah-nah-soo koh-toh oh goh-kee-boh deh-soo-kah
translation: 通訳の方と話すことをご希望ですか？

english: I will explain the limits of confidentiality.
transliteration: hee-mee-tsu oh mah-moh-roo koh-toh-nee doh-yoh nah gehn-kah-ee gah ah-roo kah, goh seh-meh-ee shee-mahs
translation: 秘密を守ることにどのような限界があるか、ご説明します。

english: Is there anything important you want me to know?
transliteration: wah-tah-shee-nee shee-teh oh-ee-teh hoh-shee-ee tah-ee-seh-tsu nah koh-toh wah ah-ree-mahs-kah
translation: 私に知っておいてほしい大切なことはありますか？

english: When did these feelings or symptoms begin?
transliteration: koh-noh kee-moh-chee yah shoh-jyoh wah ee-tsu hah-jee-mah-ree-mah-shee-tah-kah
translation: この気持ちや症状はいつ始まりましたか？

english: Did anything happen around the time they started?
transliteration: hah-jee-mah-tah koh-roh-nee nah-nee kah ah-ree-mah-shee-tah-kah
translation: 始まった頃に何かありましたか？

english: Have things been getting better or worse?
transliteration: yoh-koo nah-teh ee-mahs-kah, soh-reh-toh-moh wah-roo-koo nah-teh ee-mahs-kah
translation: 良くなっていますか、それとも悪くなっていますか？

english: How often do you feel this way?
transliteration: doh-noh koo-rah-ee noh hehn-doo deh koh-noh-yoh-nee kahn-jee-mahs-kah
translation: どのくらいの頻度でこのように感じますか？

english: How much is this affecting your daily life?
transliteration: nee-chee-joh-seh-ee-kah-tsu-nee doh-noh koo-rah-ee eh-kyoh shee-teh ee-mahs-kah
translation: 日常生活にどのくらい影響していますか？

english: Are you able to go to work or school?
transliteration: shee-goh-toh yah gahkk-koh-nee ee-keh-teh ee-mahs-kah
translation: 仕事や学校に行けていますか？

english: Are you managing your usual responsibilities?
transliteration: ee-tsu-moh noh yah-koo-wah-ree yah seh-kee-nee oh hah-tah-seh-teh ee-mahs-kah
translation: いつもの役割や責任を果たせていますか？

english: What has helped you cope so far?
transliteration: koh-reh-mah-deh, tah-ee-shoh soo-roo noh-nee yah-koo-dah-tah koh-toh wah ah-roo-ee-mahs-kah
translation: これまで、対処するのに役立ったことはありますか？

english: Have you been feeling sad or down?
transliteration: kah-nah-shee-ee kee-moh-chee yah oh-chee-kohn-dah kee-moh-chee gah tsook-ee-teh ee-mahs-kah
translation: 悲しい気持ちや落ち込んだ気持ちが続いていますか？

english: Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy?
transliteration: ee-zan wah tah-noh-shee-meh-teh ee-tah koh-toh-nee kyoh-mee gah nah-koo nah-ree-mah-shee-tah-kah
translation: 以前は楽しめていたことに興味がなくなりましたか？

english: Do you feel hopeless about the future?
transliteration: shoh-rah-ee-nee kee-tah-ee gah moh-teh-nah-ee toh kahn-jee-mahs-kah
translation: 将来に希望が持てないと感じますか？

english: Do you feel guilty or worthless?
transliteration: zai-ah-koo-kan oh kahn-jee-tah-ree, jee-boon-nee wah kah-chee gah nah-ee toh oh-moh-tah-ree shee-mahs-kah
translation: 罪悪感を感じたり、自分には価値がないと思ったりしますか？

english: Do you cry more often than usual?
transliteration: ee-tsu-moh-yoh-ree yoh-koo nah-kee-mahs-kah
translation: いつもよりよく泣きますか？

english: Has your energy been low?
transliteration: eh-neh-roo-gee gah deh-nah-ee toh kahn-jee-mahs-kah
translation: エネルギーが出ないと感じますか？

english: Is it hard to concentrate or make decisions?
transliteration: shoo-chyoo shee-tah-ree, keh-tsu-dahn shee-tah-ree soo-roo noh gah mehhn-doh deh-soo-kah
translation: 集中したり、決断したりするのが難しいですか？

english: Have you noticed changes in your appetite?
transliteration: shoh-yokoo-nee hehn-kah gah ah-ree-mah-shee-tah-kah
translation: 食欲に変化がありましたか？

english: Have you noticed any changes in your weight?
transliteration: tah-ee-jyoo-nee hehn-kah gah ah-ree-mah-shee-tah-kah
translation: 体重に変化がありましたか？

english: Do you often feel worried or anxious?
transliteration: sheen-pah-ee shee-tah-ree, foo-ahhn-nee nah-tah-ree soo-roo koh-toh gah yoh-koo ah-ree-mahs-kah
translation: 心配したり、不安になったりすることがよくありますか？

english: Is it difficult to control your worries?
transliteration: sheen-pah-ee oh oh-sah-eh-roo noh gah mehhn-doh deh-soo-kah
translation: 心配を抑えるのが難しいですか？

english: Do you feel restless or on edge?
transliteration: soh-wah-soh-wah shee-tah-ree, oh-chee-tsu-kah-nah-kah-tah-ree shee-mahs-kah
translation: そわそわしたり、落ち着かなかったりしますか？

english: Do you have sudden episodes of intense fear?
transliteration: toh-tsu-zehn, tsuy-ee kyoh-foo oh kahn-jee-roo koh-toh gah ah-ree-mahs-kah
translation: 突然、強い恐怖を感じることがありますか？

english: During these episodes, does your heart race?
transliteration: soh-noh toh-kee, sheen-zoh gah doh-kee-doh-kee shee-mahs-kah
translation: そのとき、心臓がどきどきしますか？

english: Do you feel short of breath when anxious?
transliteration: foo-ahhn-nee nah-roo toh, ee-kee-goo-roo-shee-koo nah-ree-mahs-kah
translation: 不安になると、息苦しくなりますか？

english: Do you avoid places because you fear having a panic attack?
transliteration: pah-neek-koo-hahkk-tsu gah oh-kee-roo noh gah koh-wah-koo-teh, bah-shoh oh seh-geh-koo koh-toh gah ah-roo-ee-mahs-kah
translation: パニック発作が起きるのが怖くて、場所を避けることがありますか？

english: Do unwanted thoughts keep coming into your mind?
transliteration: noh-zohn-deh-ee-nah-ee kahn-gah-eh gah, nahn-doh moh ah-tah-mah-nee foo-kah-bee-mahs-kah
translation: 望んでいない考えが、何度も頭に浮かびますか？

english: Do you feel you must repeat certain actions?
transliteration: toh-koo-teh-ee noh koh-oh doh-ree-koh-sah-nah-ee toh-ee-rah-reh-nah-ee kahn-jee-mahs-kah
translation: 特定の行動を繰り返さずにはいられないと感じますか？

english: How many hours do you sleep each night?
transliteration: mah-ee-bahn, nahn-jee-kahn koo-rah-ee neh-mahs-kah
translation: 毎晩、何時間くらい眠りますか？

english: Is it difficult to fall asleep?
transliteration: neh-tsu-koo noh gah mehhn-doh deh-soo-kah
translation: 寝つくのが難しいですか？

english: Do you wake up often during the night?
transliteration: yoh-nah-koo-nee nahn-doh moh meh gah sah-meh-mahs-kah
translation: 夜中に何度も目が覚めますか？

english: Do you wake up earlier than you want to?
transliteration: oh-kee-tah-ee jee-kahn yoh-ree hah-yah-koo meh gah sah-meh-mahs-kah
translation: 起きたい時間より早く目が覚めますか？

english: Do you feel rested in the morning?
transliteration: ah-sah, yoh-koo neh-reh-tah toh kahn-jee-mahs-kah
translation: 朝、よく眠れたと感じますか？

english: Do you have nightmares?
transliteration: ah-koo-moo oh mee-mahs-kah
translation: 悪夢を見ますか？

english: Have you been sleeping much more than usual?
transliteration: ee-tsu-moh-yoh-ree zooht-toh nah-gah-koo neh-teh ee-mahs-kah
translation: いつもよりずっと長く眠っていますか？

english: Do you feel tired during the day?
transliteration: nee-chyoo, tsu-kah-reh oh kahn-jee-mahs-kah
translation: 日中、疲れを感じますか？

english: Have there been times when you felt unusually energetic or excited?
transliteration: ee-tsu-moh toh chee-gah-oo, toh-teh-moh gen-kee dah-tah-ree kee-moh-chee gah tah-kah-mah-tah-ree shee-tah jee-kee wah ah-roo-ee-mahs-kah
translation: いつもと違って、とても元気だったり気分が高まったりした時期はありますか？

english: Have you needed much less sleep without feeling tired?
transliteration: tsu-kah-reh oh kahn-jeh-zoo-nee, soo-ee-ming-jahn gah kah-nah-ree shee-koo nah-koo-teh moh dah-ee-joh-boo dah-tah koh-toh wah ah-roo-ee-mahs-kah
translation: 疲れを感じずに、睡眠時間がかなり少なくても大丈夫だったことはありますか？

english: Have others said you were talking unusually fast?
transliteration: hee-toh-kah-rah, ee-tsu-moh toh chee-gah-oo hah-nah-soo noh gah toh-teh-moh hah-yah-ee toh ee-wah-reh-tah koh-toh gah ah-roo-ee-mahs-kah
translation: 人から、いつもと違って話すのがとても速いと言われたことがありますか？

english: Have your thoughts been racing?
transliteration: kahng-gah-eh gah tsu-gee-tsu-gee toh ukahn-deh yah-mah-rah-nah-ee koh-toh gah ah-roo-ee-mahs-kah
translation: 考えが次々と浮かんで止まらないことがありますか？

english: Have you felt unusually confident or powerful?
transliteration: ee-tsu-moh toh chee-gah-oo, jee-boon-nee tsuy-ee jee-shin gah ah-tah-tah-ree, oh-khee-nah cheek-ah-rah gah ah-roo toh kahn-jee-tah-ree shee-mah-shee-tah-kah
translation: いつもと違って、自分に強い自信があったり、大きな力があると感じたりしましたか？

english: Have you spent more money than you intended?
transliteration: tsu-kah-oo tsu-moh-ree dah-tah gah-koo tsu-kah-tah koh-toh gah ah-roo-ee-mahs-kah
translation: 使うつもりだった金額より多く使ったことがありますか？

english: Have you taken unusual risks during these periods?
transliteration: koh-oh shee-tah jee-kee-nee, ee-tsu-moh toh chee-gah-oo kee-ken nah koh-doh oh toh-tah koh-toh gah ah-roo-ee-mahs-kah
translation: こうした時期に、いつもと違う危険な行動を取ったことがありますか？

english: How long did these periods last?
transliteration: koh-oh shee-tah jee-kee wah doh-noh koo-rah-ee tsu-zoo-kee-mah-shee-tah-kah
translation: こうした時期はどのくらい続きましたか？

english: Have you heard voices that others cannot hear?
transliteration: hoh-kah noh hee-toh-nee wah kee-koh-eh-nah-ee koh-eh gah kee-koh-eh-tah koh-toh gah ah-roo-ee-mahs-kah
translation: ほかの人には聞こえない声が聞こえたことがありますか？

english: Have you seen things that others cannot see?
transliteration: hoh-kah noh hee-toh-nee wah mee-eh-nah-ee moh-noh gah mee-eh-tah koh-toh gah ah-roo-ee-mahs-kah
translation: ほかの人には見えないものが見えたことがありますか？

english: Do you feel that someone is watching or following you?
transliteration: dah-reh-kah-nee mee-hah-rah-reh-tah-ree, ah-toh oh tsu-keh-rah-reh-tah-ree shee-teh-ee-roo toh kahn-jee-mahs-kah
translation: 誰かに見張られたり、後をつけられたりしていると感じますか？

english: Do you feel that someone wants to harm you?
transliteration: dah-reh-kah gah ah-nah-tah-nee gah-ee oh kah-ee-yoh toh shee-teh-ee-roo toh kahn-jee-mahs-kah
translation: 誰かがあなたに危害を加えようとしていると感じますか？

english: Do you feel your thoughts are being controlled?
transliteration: jee-boon noh kahn-gah-eh gah dah-reh-kah-nee ay-soh-roh sah-reh-teh-ee-roo toh kahn-jee-mahs-kah
translation: 自分の考えが誰かに操られていると感じますか？

english: Do the voices ever tell you to do something?
transliteration: koh-eh gah nah-nee kah oh soo-roh yoh nee shee-jay soo-roo koh-toh gah ah-roo-ee-mahs-kah
translation: 声が何かをするように指示することがありますか？

english: What do you think these experiences mean?
transliteration: koh-oh shee-tah teh-ee-kehn-nee wah doh-noh-yoh nah ee-mee gah ah-roo toh oh-moh-ee-mahs-kah
translation: こうした体験には、どのような意味があると思いますか？

english: Do these experiences frighten you?
transliteration: koh-oh shee-tah teh-ee-kehn oh koh-wah-ee toh kahn-jee-mahs-kah
translation: こうした体験を怖いと感じますか？

english: Sometimes when people feel overwhelmed, they think about death. Has that happened to you?
transliteration: kee-moh-chee gah eepp-pah-ee eepp-pah-ee-nee nah-roo toh, shee noh koh-toh-nee tsu-ee-teh kahn-gah-eh-roo koh-toh gah ah-ree-mahs. ah-nah-tah-nee-moh soh-oh-ee-oo koh-toh gah ah-ree-mah-shee-tah-kah
translation: 気持ちがいっぱいいっぱいになると、死について考えることがあります。あなたにもそういうことがありましたか？

english: Have you wished you could go to sleep and not wake up?
transliteration: neh-moo-nee tsu-ee-teh, soh-noh-mah meh gah sah-meh-nah-kah-reh-bah ee-ee noh-nee toh oh-moh-tah koh-toh gah ah-roo-ee-mahs-kah
translation: 眠りについて、そのまま目が覚めなければいいのにと思ったことがありますか？

english: Have you had thoughts of ending your life?
transliteration: jee-boon noh ee-noh-chee oh tsu-tah-tsu koh-toh oh kahn-gah-eh-tah koh-toh gah ah-roo-ee-mahs-kah
translation: 自分の命を絶つことを考えたことがありますか？

english: Are you having those thoughts right now?
transliteration: ee-mah, soh-noh yoh nah kahn-gah-eh gah ah-roo-ee-mahs-kah
translation: 今、そのような考えがありますか？

english: Have you thought about how you might do it?
transliteration: doh-noh-yoh-nee jehk-kohh soo-roo kah kahn-gah-eh-tah koh-toh gah ah-roo-ee-mahs-kah
translation: どのように実行するか考えたことがありますか？

english: Have you made a plan to end your life?
transliteration: jee-boon noh ee-noh-chee oh tsu-tah-tsu keh-kah-koo oh tah-teh-tah koh-toh gah ah-roo-ee-mahs-kah
translation: 自分の命を絶つ計画を立てたことがありますか？

english: Do you have access to anything you might use to hurt yourself?
transliteration: jee-boon oh kee-tsu-teh-roo tah-meh-nee tsu-kah-oo kah-moh shee-reh-nah-ee moh-noh oh, teh-nee deh-kee-roo jyoh-tah-ee deh-soo-kah
translation: 自分を傷つけるために使うかもしれないものを、手にできる状態ですか？

english: Have you ever tried to end your life before?
transliteration: ee-zan, jee-boon noh ee-noh-chee oh tsu-tah-tsu toh shee-tah koh-toh gah ah-roo-ee-mahs-kah
translation: 以前、自分の命を絶とうとしたことがありますか？

english: Have you ever hurt yourself on purpose?
transliteration: jee-boon oh kee-tsu-teh-roo tsu-moh-ree deh, jee-sah-ee-nee kee-tsu-teh-tah koh-toh gah ah-roo-ee-mahs-kah
translation: 自分を傷つけるつもりで、実際に傷つけたことがありますか？

english: What has helped you stay safe so far?
transliteration: koh-reh-mah-deh ahn-zehn oh tah-moh-tsu noh-nee yah-koo-dah-tah koh-toh wah ah-roo-ee-mahs-kah
translation: これまで安全を保つのに役立ったことはありますか？

english: Is there someone you trust whom we can contact?
transliteration: rehhn-rah-koo shee-teh-moh ee-ee, shih-rai deh-kee-roo hee-toh wah ee-mahs-kah
translation: 連絡してもよい、信頼できる人はいますか？

english: I am concerned about your safety and want to help you stay safe.
transliteration: ah-nah-tah noh ahn-zehn oh sheen-pah-ee shee-teh ee-mahs. ahn-zehn oh tah-moh-teh-roo yoh-nee, oh-teh-tsu-dah-ee shee-tah-ee deh-soo
translation: あなたの安全を心配しています。安全を保てるよう、お手伝いしたいです。

english: Do you feel safe where you live?
transliteration: ee-mah soo-n-deh-ee-roo bah-shoh deh ahn-zehn dah toh kahn-jee-mahs-kah
translation: 今住んでいる場所で安全だと感じますか？

english: Has anyone threatened or hurt you?
transliteration: dah-reh-kah-nee, doh-shi-tah-ree kee-tsu-keh-rah-reh-tah koh-toh gah ah-roo-ee-mahs-kah
translation: 誰かに脅されたり、傷つけられたりしたことがありますか？

english: Are you afraid of anyone at home?
transliteration: ee-eh-nee ee-roo toh-kee, dah-reh-kah oh koh-wah-ee toh kahn-jee-mahs-kah
translation: 家にいるとき、誰かを怖いと感じますか？

english: Have you had thoughts of hurting someone else?
transliteration: dah-reh-kah oh kee-tsu-tsu-keh-tah-ee toh oh-moh-tah koh-toh gah ah-roo-ee-mahs-kah
translation: 誰かを傷つけたいと思ったことがありますか？

english: Is there a particular person you are thinking about hurting?
transliteration: kee-tsu-tsu-keh-tah-ee toh oh-moh-tah-ee teh-ee-shoh nah hee-toh wah ee-mahs-kah
translation: 傷つけたいと思っている特定の人はいますか？

english: Do you have a plan to hurt anyone?
transliteration: dah-reh-kah oh kee-tsu-tsu-keh-roo keh-kah-koo gah ah-roo-ee-mahs-kah
translation: 誰かを傷つける計画がありますか？

english: Are there children or other vulnerable people at home?
transliteration: ee-eh-nee koh-do-moh yah, hoh-kah-nee toh-koo-beh-tsu nah hah-ee-ryoh gah hee-tsu-yoh nah hee-toh wah ee-mahs-kah
translation: 家に子どもや、ほかに特別な配慮が必要な人はいますか？

english: Have you experienced something frightening or traumatic?
transliteration: koh-wah-ee oh-moh-ee oh shee-tah-ree, koh-koh-roh-nee foo-kah-ee kee-zu oh oh-oh yoh nah teh-ee-kehn oh shee-tah koh-toh gah ah-roo-ee-mahs-kah
translation: 怖い思いをしたり、心に深い傷を負うような体験をしたことがありますか？

english: You do not have to share details before you are ready.
transliteration: hah-nah-soo joon-bee gah deh-kee-roo mah-deh, koo-wah-shee-ee koh-toh oh hah-nah-soo hee-tsu-yoh wah ah-ree-mah-sehn
translation: 話す準備ができるまで、詳しいことを話す必要はありません。

english: Do memories of that experience come back unexpectedly?
transliteration: soh-noh teh-ee-kehn noh kee-oh-koo gah, oh-moh-ee-gah-keh-zoo nee yo-mee-gah-eh-roo koh-toh gah ah-roo-ee-mahs-kah
translation: その体験の記憶が、思いがけずよみがえることがありますか？

english: Do you have nightmares about what happened?
transliteration: oh-koh-tah koh-toh-nee tsu-ee-teh ah-koo-moo oh mee-roo koh-toh gah ah-roo-ee-mahs-kah
translation: 起きたことについて悪夢を見ることがありますか？

english: Do you avoid reminders of what happened?
transliteration: oh-koh-tah koh-toh oh oh-moh-ee-dah-say-roo moh-noh oh sah-keh-teh ee-mahs-kah
translation: 起きたことを思い出させるものを避けていますか？

english: Do you feel constantly on guard or unsafe?
transliteration: ee-tsu-moh keh-ee-kah-ee shee-teh-ee-tah-ree, ahn-zehn deh nah-ee toh kahn-jee-tah-ree shee-mahs-kah
translation: いつも警戒していたり、安全でないと感じたりしますか？

english: Do you sometimes feel disconnected from yourself or your surroundings?
transliteration: jee-boon-jee-shin yah mah-wah-ree noh jyoh-kyoh kah-rah kee-ree-hah-nah-reh-tah yoh-nee kahn-jee-roo koh-toh gah ah-roo-ee-mahs-kah
translation: 自分自身や周りの状況から切り離されたように感じることがありますか？

english: Do you drink alcohol?
transliteration: oh-sah-kay oh nohhn-deh ee-mahs-kah
translation: お酒を飲みますか？

english: How often and how much do you drink?
transliteration: do-no ku-RAI-no hin-DO-de, do-re-ku-RAI o-SA-ke-o no-mi-MAS-ka?
translation: どのくらいの頻度で、どれくらいお酒を飲みますか？

english: Have you wanted to cut down on drinking?
transliteration: o-SA-ke-o no-mu RYO-o he-RA-shi-tai to O-mo-tta ko-to-wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: お酒を飲む量を減らしたいと思ったことはありますか？

english: Has anyone expressed concern about your drinking?
transliteration: a-na-TA-no o-SA-ke-no no-mi-KA-ta-o shin-PAI-shi-te-i-ru hi-to-wa i-MAS-ka?
translation: あなたのお酒の飲み方を心配している人はいますか？

english: Do you use cannabis?
transliteration: tai-MA-o tsu-ka-tte-i-MAS-ka?
translation: 大麻を使っていますか？

english: Do you use cocaine, opioids, or other drugs?
transliteration: ko-KAI-n, o-pi-OI-do, ma-ta-wa ho-ka-no ya-ku-BUTS-o tsu-ka-tte-i-MAS-ka?
translation: コカイン、オピオイド、またはほかの薬物を使っていますか？

english: Have you ever injected drugs?
transliteration: ya-ku-BUTS-o chu-sha-shi-ta ko-to-wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 薬物を注射したことはありますか？

english: When did you last use alcohol or other substances?
transliteration: SAI-go-ni o-SA-ke-ya ho-ka-no ya-ku-BUTS-o tsu-ka-tta-no-wa i-tsu-de-SU-ka?
translation: 最後にお酒やほかの薬物を使ったのはいつですか？

english: Do you feel shaky or unwell when you stop using them?
transliteration: so-re-ra-o ya-me-ru-to, ka-ra-DA-ga fu-ru-e-ta-ri gu-aI-ga wa-ru-ku na-tta-ri shi-MAS-ka?
translation: それらをやめると、体が震えたり具合が悪くなったりしますか？

english: Have you ever had a seizure during withdrawal?
transliteration: ya-ku-BUTS-o ya-me-ta to-ki-ni, ke-i-ren ho-SO-o o-ko-shi-ta ko-to-wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 薬物をやめたときに、けいれん発作を起こしたことはありますか？

english: Would you like support to reduce or stop using substances?
transliteration: ya-ku-BUTS-no shi-YO-o he-ra-shi-ta-ri, ya-me-ta-ri su-ru ta-me-no shi-EN-o u-ke-tai de-SU-ka?
translation: 薬物の使用を減らしたり、やめたりするための支援を受けたいですか？

english: How do you feel about your eating habits?
transliteration: ta-be-KA-ta-ni tsu-i-te, do-no-yo-o-ni kan-JI-te-i-MAS-ka?
translation: 食べ方について、どのように感じていますか？

english: Do you worry a lot about your weight or body shape?
transliteration: tai-JU-ya tai-KEI-no ko-to-o yo-ku shin-PAI-shi-MAS-ka?
translation: 体重や体型のことをよく心配しますか？

english: Have you been skipping meals or restricting food?
transliteration: sho-KU-ji-o nu-i-ta-ri, ta-be-ru RYO-o sei-GEN-shi-ta-ri shi-te-i-MAS-ka?
translation: 食事を抜いたり、食べる量を制限したりしていますか？

english: Do you sometimes feel unable to stop eating?
transliteration: ta-be-HA-ji-me-ru-to, ya-me-ra-re-nai-to kan-JI-ru ko-to-ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 食べ始めると、やめられないと感じることがありますか？

english: Have you made yourself vomit after eating?
transliteration: ta-be-ta a-to-ni, ji-BUN-de ha-i-ta ko-to-wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 食べた後に、自分で吐いたことはありますか？

english: Have you been exercising to compensate for eating?
transliteration: ta-be-ta bun-o sho-HI-su-ru ta-me-ni un-DO shi-te-i-MAS-ka?
translation: 食べた分を消費するために運動していますか？

english: Have you had trouble paying attention?
transliteration: chu-I-o shu-CHU-su-ru-no-ga mu-zu-ka-shi-i ko-to-wa a-ri-MA-shi-ta-ka?
translation: 注意を集中するのが難しいことはありましたか？

english: Do you often forget appointments or tasks?
transliteration: ya-ku-SO-ku-ya yo-U-ji-o yo-ku wa-su-re-MAS-ka?
translation: 約束や用事をよく忘れますか？

english: Have you noticed changes in your memory?
transliteration: ki-O-ku-ni he-NKA-ga a-tta-to kan-JI-MAS-ka?
translation: 記憶に変化があったと感じますか？

english: Do you find it difficult to organize tasks?
transliteration: mo-no-go-to-o dan-DO-ri-yo-ku su-su-me-ru-no-ga mu-zu-ka-shi-i de-SU-ka?
translation: 物事を段取りよく進めるのが難しいですか？

english: Have you been feeling confused?
transliteration: kon-RAN-shi-ta-ri, a-ta-ma-ga bo-nya-ri shi-ta-ri shi-te-i-MAS-ka?
translation: 混乱したり、頭がぼんやりしたりしていますか？

english: Has anyone noticed a change in your behaviour?
transliteration: a-na-TA-no ko-O-do-ni he-NKA-ga a-tta-to ki-zu-i-ta hi-to-wa i-MAS-ka?
translation: あなたの行動に変化があったと気づいた人はいますか？

english: Can you tell me your full name?
transliteration: fu-RU-ne-e-mu-o o-shi-e-te i-ta-da-ke-MAS-ka?
translation: フルネームを教えていただけますか？

english: Can you tell me today’s date?
transliteration: kyo-o-wa nan-ga-tsu nan-ni-chi-ka o-shi-e-te i-ta-da-ke-MAS-ka?
translation: 今日は何月何日か教えていただけますか？

english: Can you tell me where we are right now?
transliteration: i-ma ko-ko-ga do-ko-ka, o-shi-e-te i-ta-da-ke-MAS-ka?
translation: 今ここがどこか、教えていただけますか？

english: I will say three words; please repeat them.
transliteration: ko-re-ka-ra mi-tsu-no ko-TO-ba-o i-i-MAS-no-de, ku-ri-ka-e-shi-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: これから3つの言葉を言いますので、繰り返してください。

english: Please try to remember those words for later.
transliteration: a-to-de o-mo-i-da-se-ru-yo-o-ni, ko-no ko-TO-ba-o o-bo-e-te o-i-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: 後で思い出せるように、この言葉を覚えておいてください。

english: Can you tell me those three words now?
transliteration: i-ma, sa-ki-ho-do-no mi-tsu-no ko-TO-ba-o i-e-MAS-ka?
translation: 今、先ほどの3つの言葉を言えますか？

english: Can you spell a word backwards?
transliteration: a-ru ko-TO-ba-o gyaku-ka-ra tsu-zu-ru ko-to-wa de-ki-MAS-ka?
translation: ある言葉を逆からつづることはできますか？

english: What do you think is causing these difficulties?
transliteration: ko-no-yo-o-na ko-ma-ri-go-to-no gen-IN-wa nan-da-to o-mo-i-MAS-ka?
translation: このような困りごとの原因は何だと思いますか？

english: How would you describe your mood today?
transliteration: kyo-o-no ki-BUN-o do-no-yo-o-ni a-ra-wa-shi-MAS-ka?
translation: 今日の気分をどのように表しますか？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Have you ever seen a psychiatrist or counsellor?
transliteration: ko-re-ma-de-ni sei-shin-KA-i-ya ka-un-se-RA-a-ni so-o-DAN-shi-ta ko-to-wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: これまでに精神科医やカウンセラーに相談したことはありますか？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Have you ever been admitted to hospital for mental health care?
transliteration: ko-ko-ro-no ken-KO-o ta-me-ni, nyu-IN-shi-ta ko-to-wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 心の健康のために、入院したことはありますか？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Has anyone in your family had mental health difficulties?
transliteration: go-ka-ZO-ku-ni, ko-ko-ro-no ken-KO-o-de ko-ma-tta ko-to-ga a-ru ka-ta-wa i-MAS-ka?
translation: ご家族に、心の健康で困ったことがある方はいますか？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Do you have any medical conditions?
transliteration: na-ni-ka ji-BYO-o-wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 何か持病はありますか？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Who do you live with?
transliteration: da-re-to is-sho-ni ku-ra-shi-te i-MAS-ka?
translation: 誰と一緒に暮らしていますか？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Who can you turn to for support?
transliteration: ko-ma-tta to-ki, da-re-ni so-o-DAN de-ki-MAS-ka?
translation: 困ったとき、誰に相談できますか？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Have you had recent financial or housing difficulties?
transliteration: sa-i-KIN, o-ka-ne-ya su-ma-i-no ko-to-de ko-ma-tta ko-to-wa a-ri-MA-shi-ta-ka?
translation: 最近、お金や住まいのことで困ったことはありましたか？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Are your relationships causing you stress?
transliteration: nin-gen-kan-KEI-ga su-to-RE-su-no gen-IN-ni na-tte-i-MAS-ka?
translation: 人間関係がストレスの原因になっていますか？

english: What medicines are you taking now?
transliteration: i-ma, do-no-yo-o-na ku-su-ri-o non-de i-MAS-ka?
translation: 今、どのような薬を飲んでいますか？

english: Do you take antidepressant medication?
transliteration: ko-o-u-tsu-YA-ku-o non-de i-MAS-ka?
translation: 抗うつ薬を飲んでいますか？

english: Do you take medicine for anxiety?
transliteration: fu-an-o o-sa-e-ru ku-su-ri-o non-de i-MAS-ka?
translation: 不安を抑える薬を飲んでいますか？

english: Do you take antipsychotic medication?
transliteration: ko-o-sei-shin-YA-ku-o non-de i-MAS-ka?
translation: 抗精神病薬を飲んでいますか？

english: Do you take a mood stabilizer?
transliteration: ki-BUN-o an-TEI-sa-se-ru ku-su-ri-o non-de i-MAS-ka?
translation: 気分を安定させる薬を飲んでいますか？

english: Do you take sleeping pills or benzodiazepines?
transliteration: su-i-min-YA-ku-ya ben-zo-di-a-ze-pin-kei-no ku-su-ri-o non-de i-MAS-ka?
translation: 睡眠薬やベンゾジアゼピン系の薬を飲んでいますか？

english: What dose do you take and how often?
transliteration: do-no-ku-RAI-no RYO-o, do-no-ku-RAI-no hin-DO-de non-de i-MAS-ka?
translation: どのくらいの量を、どのくらいの頻度で飲んでいますか？

english: How long have you been taking this medicine?
transliteration: ko-no ku-su-ri-o no-mi-ha-ji-me-te do-no-ku-RAI-ni na-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: この薬を飲み始めてどのくらいになりますか？

english: Have you missed any doses recently?
transliteration: sa-i-KIN, ku-su-ri-o no-mi-wa-su-re-ta ko-to-wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 最近、薬を飲み忘れたことはありますか？

english: Has the medicine been helping?
transliteration: ku-su-ri-wa ki-i-te i-MAS-ka?
translation: 薬は効いていますか？

english: Have you noticed any side effects?
transliteration: na-ni-ka fu-ku-sa-YO-o ni ki-zu-ki-MA-shi-ta-ka?
translation: 何か副作用に気づきましたか？

english: Have you stopped any medication recently?
transliteration: sa-i-KIN, ku-su-ri-o ya-me-ta ko-to-wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 最近、薬をやめたことはありますか？

english: What are your goals for treatment?
transliteration: chi-RYO-o-ni tsu-i-te, do-no-yo-o-na mo-KU-hyo-o-ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 治療について、どのような目標がありますか？

english: Would you be interested in talking therapy or counselling?
transliteration: shin-RI-ryo-o-ho-o-ya ka-un-se-RIN-gu-o u-ke-te-mi-tai de-SU-ka?
translation: 心理療法やカウンセリングを受けてみたいですか？

english: We can discuss medication options together.
transliteration: ku-su-ri-no sen-TA-ku-shi-ni tsu-i-te, is-sho-ni so-o-DAN de-ki-MAS.
translation: 薬の選択肢について、一緒に相談できます。

english: Some medicines take several weeks to work fully.
transliteration: ku-su-ri-ni yo-tte-wa, ju-u-BUN-ni ki-ku-ma-de-ni su-u-shu-u-KAN ka-ka-ri-MAS.
translation: 薬によっては、十分に効くまでに数週間かかります。

english: Please speak with your clinician before stopping medication.
transliteration: ku-su-ri-o ya-me-ru ma-e-ni, tan-TO-o-no i-RYO-ju-u-ji-sha-ni so-o-DAN-shi-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: 薬をやめる前に、担当の医療従事者に相談してください。

english: Would you like us to involve a trusted family member?
transliteration: shin-RAI de-ki-ru go-ka-ZO-ku-ni-mo do-o-se-ki-shi-te mo-ra-i-tai de-SU-ka?
translation: 信頼できるご家族にも同席してもらいたいですか？

english: We can make a plan for what to do if symptoms worsen.
transliteration: sho-o-JO-o-ga a-KU-ka-shi-ta to-ki-ni do-o-su-ru-ka, is-sho-ni ke-i-KA-ku-o ta-te-ra-re-MAS.
translation: 症状が悪化したときにどうするか、一緒に計画を立てられます。

english: What concerns do you have about treatment?
transliteration: chi-RYO-o-ni tsu-i-te, shin-PAI-na ko-to-wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 治療について、心配なことはありますか？

english: Do you feel safe going home today?
transliteration: kyo-o-wa an-SHIN-shi-te ie-ni ka-e-re-so-o de-SU-ka?
translation: 今日は安心して家に帰れそうですか？

english: Who could you call if you felt unsafe?
transliteration: mi-no ki-KEN-o kan-JI-ta to-ki, da-re-ni den-WA de-ki-MAS-ka?
translation: 身の危険を感じたとき、誰に電話できますか？

english: Can we identify warning signs that things are getting worse?
transliteration: jo-o-TAI-ga a-KU-ka-shi-te i-ru to-ki-no cho-o-ko-o-o is-sho-ni ka-ku-NIN de-ki-MAS-ka?
translation: 状態が悪化しているときの兆候を一緒に確認できますか？

english: If you are in immediate danger, seek emergency help.
transliteration: sa-shi-se-ma-tta ki-KEN-ga a-ru ba-a-I-wa, kyu-u-KYU-u-no ta-su-ke-o mo-to-me-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: 差し迫った危険がある場合は、救急の助けを求めてください。

english: We can arrange a follow-up appointment.
transliteration: ji-ka-i-no shin-SA-tsu-o yo-ya-ku de-ki-MAS.
translation: 次回の診察を予約できます。

english: Would you like information about local support services?
transliteration: chi-i-KI-no shi-en sa-a-BI-su-ni tsu-i-te, jo-o-ho-o-o o-shi-ri-ni na-ri-tai de-SU-ka?
translation: 地域の支援サービスについて、情報をお知りになりたいですか？

english: Is there anything else you would like to ask?
transliteration: ho-ka-ni ki-ki-tai ko-to-wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: ほかに聞きたいことはありますか？

english: I am going to ask some questions about your symptoms.
transliteration: sho-o-JO-o-ni tsu-i-te i-ku-tsu-ka shi-TSU-mon-shi-MAS.
translation: 症状についていくつか質問します。

english: When did your symptoms first begin?
transliteration: sho-o-JO-o-ga sa-i-SHO-ni ha-ji-ma-tta-no-wa i-tsu-de-SU-ka?
translation: 症状が最初に始まったのはいつですか？

english: Did the symptoms start suddenly or gradually?
transliteration: sho-o-JO-o-wa to-TSU-zen ha-ji-ma-ri-MA-shi-ta-ka, so-re-to-mo jo-jo-ni ha-ji-ma-ri-MA-shi-ta-ka?
translation: 症状は突然始まりましたか、それとも徐々に始まりましたか？

english: What were you doing when this started?
transliteration: sho-o-JO-o-ga ha-ji-ma-tta to-ki, na-ni-o shi-te i-MA-shi-ta-ka?
translation: 症状が始まったとき、何をしていましたか？

english: Are the symptoms constant or do they come and go?
transliteration: sho-o-JO-o-wa zu-tto tsu-zu-i-te i-MAS-ka, so-re-to-mo de-ta-ri ki-e-ta-ri shi-MAS-ka?
translation: 症状はずっと続いていますか、それとも出たり消えたりしますか？

english: How long does each episode last?
transliteration: sho-o-JO-o-ga de-ru ta-bi-ni, do-no-ku-RAI tsu-zu-ki-MAS-ka?
translation: 症状が出るたびに、どのくらい続きますか？

english: How many times a day or week does this happen?
transliteration: ko-re-ga o-ko-ru-no-wa, i-chi-ni-chi-ni, ma-ta-wa i-sshu-u-KAN-ni nan-ka-i-ku-RAI de-SU-ka?
translation: これが起こるのは、1日に、または1週間に何回くらいですか？

english: Are your symptoms getting better, worse, or staying the same?
transliteration: sho-o-JO-o-wa yo-ku na-tte i-MAS-ka, wa-ru-ku na-tte i-MAS-ka, so-re-to-mo ka-wa-ri-MA-sen-ka?
translation: 症状は良くなっていますか、悪くなっていますか、それとも変わりませんか？

english: Have you ever had this problem before?
transliteration: i-ZEN-ni-mo o-na-ji sho-o-JO-o-ga de-ta ko-to-wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 以前にも同じ症状が出たことはありますか？

english: Does anything make it better or worse?
transliteration: sho-o-JO-o-o yo-ku-shi-ta-ri wa-ru-ku-shi-ta-ri su-ru mo-no-wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 症状を良くしたり悪くしたりするものはありますか？

english: Please tell me immediately if you feel unwell during the examination.
transliteration: shin-SA-tsu-chu-u-ni gu-aI-ga wa-ru-ku na-tta-ra, su-gu-ni o-shi-e-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: 診察中に具合が悪くなったら、すぐに教えてください。

english: Did you suddenly develop weakness on one side of your body?
transliteration: ka-ra-DA-no ka-ta-ga-wa-ni to-TSU-zen chi-ka-ra-ga ha-i-ra-na-ku na-ri-MA-shi-ta-ka?
translation: 体の片側に突然力が入らなくなりましたか？

english: Did one side of your face suddenly droop?
transliteration: ka-o-no ka-ta-ga-wa-ga to-TSU-zen ta-re-sa-ga-ri-MA-shi-ta-ka?
translation: 顔の片側が突然垂れ下がりましたか？

english: Did you suddenly have trouble speaking?
transliteration: to-TSU-zen, ha-na-shi-ni-ku-ku na-ri-MA-shi-ta-ka?
translation: 突然、話しにくくなりましたか？

english: Did you suddenly have trouble understanding speech?
transliteration: to-TSU-zen, hi-to-no ha-na-shi-o ri-ka-i-shi-ni-ku-ku na-ri-MA-shi-ta-ka?
translation: 突然、人の話を理解しにくくなりましたか？

english: Did you suddenly lose vision in one or both eyes?
transliteration: ka-ta-me ma-ta-wa ryo-o-me-ga to-TSU-zen mi-e-na-ku na-ri-MA-shi-ta-ka?
translation: 片目または両目が突然見えなくなりましたか？

english: Did you suddenly lose your balance or coordination?
transliteration: to-TSU-zen, ba-ran-su-o ku-zu-shi-ta-ri, ka-ra-DA-no u-go-ki-o u-ma-ku cho-o-sei de-ki-na-ku na-tta-ri shi-MA-shi-ta-ka?
translation: 突然、バランスを崩したり、体の動きをうまく調整できなくなったりしましたか？

english: What time were you last completely well?
transliteration: sa-i-GO-ni ma-tta-ku mon-DAI-na-ku su-go-se-te i-ta-no-wa nan-JI-de-SU-ka?
translation: 最後にまったく問題なく過ごせていたのは何時ですか？

english: Did the symptoms go away completely?
transliteration: sho-o-JO-o-wa kan-ZEN-ni na-ku na-ri-MA-shi-ta-ka?
translation: 症状は完全になくなりましたか？

english: Did you have the worst headache of your life?
transliteration: ko-re-ma-de-de sai-A-KU-no zu-TSU-tsu-u-ga a-ri-MA-shi-ta-ka?
translation: これまでで最悪の頭痛がありましたか？

english: Did the headache reach maximum intensity within seconds or a minute?
transliteration: zu-TSU-tsu-u-no i-ta-mi-wa, su-u byo-o-ka-ra i-ppun i-NAI-ni mo-tto-mo tsu-yo-ku na-ri-MA-shi-ta-ka?
translation: 頭痛の痛みは、数秒から1分以内に最も強くなりましたか？

english: Do you have a fever with a stiff neck?
transliteration: ha-tsu-ne-tsu-to ku-bi-no ko-wa-ba-ri-ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 発熱と首のこわばりがありますか？

english: Have you had a new seizure or lost consciousness?
transliteration: a-ra-ta-ni ke-i-ren ho-SO-o o-ko-shi-ta-ri, i-shi-ki-o u-shi-na-tta-ri shi-MA-shi-ta-ka?
translation: 新たにけいれん発作を起こしたり、意識を失ったりしましたか？

english: Do you have new difficulty controlling your bladder or bowels?
transliteration: sa-i-KIN, nyo-o-ya ben-o u-ma-ku kon-TO-ro-o-ru de-ki-na-ku na-ri-MA-shi-ta-ka?
translation: 最近、尿や便をうまくコントロールできなくなりましたか？

english: Do you have numbness around your groin or buttocks?
transliteration: ma-ta-ya o-shi-ri-no ma-wa-ri-ni shi-bi-re-ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 股やお尻の周りにしびれがありますか？

english: Where exactly is your headache?
transliteration: zu-TSU-tsu-u-wa gu-TAI-te-ki-ni do-ko-ni a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 頭痛は具体的にどこにありますか？

english: Is the pain on one side or both sides of your head?
transliteration: a-ta-ma-no ka-ta-ga-wa de-SU-ka, so-re-to-mo ryo-o-ga-wa de-SU-ka?
translation: 頭の片側ですか、それとも両側ですか？

english: Does the pain spread to your neck, face, or behind your eyes?
transliteration: i-ta-mi-wa ku-bi-ya ka-o, ma-ta-wa me-no o-ku-ni hi-ro-ga-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 痛みは首や顔、または目の奥に広がりますか？

english: Is the pain throbbing, pressing, stabbing, or burning?
transliteration: i-ta-mi-wa, zu-ki-zu-ki-su-ru, o-sa-e-ra-re-ru, sa-su-yo-o-na, ma-ta-wa ya-ke-ru-yo-o-na i-ta-mi de-SU-ka?
translation: 痛みは、ズキズキする、押される、刺すような、または焼けるような痛みですか？

english: How severe is the pain from zero to ten?
transliteration: i-ta-mi-no tsu-yo-sa-o ze-ro-ka-ra ju-u-de a-ra-wa-su-to, do-no-ku-RAI de-SU-ka?
translation: 痛みの強さを0から10で表すと、どのくらいですか？

english: Does light or noise bother you during the headache?
transliteration: zu-TSU-tsu-u-ga a-ru to-ki, hi-ka-ri-ya o-to-ga ki-ni-na-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 頭痛があるとき、光や音が気になりますか？

english: Do you feel nauseated or vomit with the headache?
transliteration: zu-TSU-tsu-u-ga a-ru to-ki, ha-ki-ke-ga shi-ta-ri, ha-i-ta-ri shi-MAS-ka?
translation: 頭痛があるとき、吐き気がしたり、吐いたりしますか？

english: Do you see flashing lights or zigzag lines before the headache?
transliteration: zu-TSU-tsu-u-ga ha-ji-ma-ru ma-e-ni, hi-ka-ri-ga chi-ka-chi-ka-shi-ta-ri, ji-gu-za-gu-no sen-ga mi-e-ta-ri shi-MAS-ka?
translation: 頭痛が始まる前に、光がチカチカしたり、ジグザグの線が見えたりしますか？

english: Does physical activity make the headache worse?
transliteration: ka-ra-DA-o u-go-ka-su-to zu-TSU-tsu-u-ga a-KU-ka-shi-MAS-ka?
translation: 体を動かすと頭痛が悪化しますか？

english: Does coughing, straining, or bending make it worse?
transliteration: se-ki-o shi-ta-ri, chi-ka-ra-n-da-ri, ka-gan-da-ri su-ru-to, i-ta-mi-ga tsu-yo-ku na-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 咳をしたり、力んだり、かがんだりすると、痛みが強くなりますか？

english: Is the headache worse when lying down or standing up?
transliteration: yo-ko-ni na-tta to-ki-ya ta-chi-a-ga-tta to-ki-ni, zu-TSU-tsu-u-ga tsu-yo-ku na-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 横になったときや立ち上がったときに、頭痛が強くなりますか？

english: Does the headache wake you from sleep?
transliteration: zu-TSU-tsu-u-de me-ga sa-me-MAS-ka?
translation: 頭痛で目が覚めますか？

english: Have your headaches changed recently?
transliteration: sa-i-KIN, zu-TSU-tsu-u-ni he-NKA-wa a-ri-MA-shi-ta-ka?
translation: 最近、頭痛に変化はありましたか？

english: How many days each month do you have a headache?
transliteration: mai-tsu-ki, zu-TSU-tsu-u-ga a-ru hi-wa nan-ni-chi-ku-RAI de-SU-ka?
translation: 毎月、頭痛がある日は何日くらいですか？

english: How often do you take painkillers for headaches?
transliteration: zu-TSU-tsu-u-no ta-me-ni, do-no-ku-RAI-no hin-DO-de i-ta-mi-do-me-o non-de i-MAS-ka?
translation: 頭痛のために、どのくらいの頻度で痛み止めを飲みますか？

english: Do you feel the room spinning or do you feel faint?
transliteration: ma-wa-ri-ga gu-ru-gu-ru ma-wa-ru kan-JI-ga shi-MAS-ka? so-re-to-mo, ki-ga to-o-ku-na-ru kan-JI-ga shi-MAS-ka?
translation: 周りがぐるぐる回る感じがしますか？それとも、気が遠くなる感じがしますか？

english: Do you feel unsteady when walking?
transliteration: a-ru-ku to-ki-ni fu-ra-tsu-ki-MAS-ka?
translation: 歩くときにふらつきますか？

english: Does turning your head trigger the dizziness?
transliteration: a-ta-ma-o ma-wa-su-to, me-maI-ga o-ko-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 頭を回すと、めまいが起こりますか？

english: Does standing up trigger the dizziness?
transliteration: ta-chi-a-ga-ru-to, me-maI-ga o-ko-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 立ち上がると、めまいが起こりますか？

english: Does the dizziness last seconds, minutes, hours, or longer?
transliteration: me-maI-wa su-u byo-o, su-u-fun, su-u-ji-kan, ma-ta-wa so-re i-jo-o tsu-zu-ki-MAS-ka?
translation: めまいは数秒、数分、数時間、またはそれ以上続きますか？

english: Do you have ringing in your ears or hearing loss?
transliteration: mi-mi-na-ri-ya ki-ko-e-ni-ku-sa-wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 耳鳴りや聞こえにくさはありますか？

english: Have you fallen because of the dizziness?
transliteration: me-maI-de ko-ron-da ko-to-ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: めまいで転んだことがありますか？

english: Can you walk without assistance?
transliteration: ka-i-jo na-shi-de a-ru-ke-MAS-ka?
translation: 介助なしで歩けますか？

english: Do you feel weakness in your arms or legs?
transliteration: u-de-ya a-shi-ni chi-ka-ra-ga ha-i-ri-ni-ku-i de-SU-ka?
translation: 腕や脚に力が入りにくいですか？

english: Is one side weaker than the other?
transliteration: ka-ta-ga-wa-no ho-o-ga, mo-o ka-ta-ga-wa-yo-ri chi-ka-ra-ga ha-i-ri-ni-ku-i de-SU-ka?
translation: 片側のほうが、もう片側より力が入りにくいですか？

english: Do you have trouble lifting your arms above your head?
transliteration: u-de-o a-ta-ma-yo-ri ue-ni a-ge-ni-ku-i de-SU-ka?
translation: 腕を頭より上に上げにくいですか？

english: Do you have trouble standing up from a chair?
transliteration: i-su-ka-ra ta-chi-a-ga-ru-no-ga mu-zu-ka-shi-i de-SU-ka?
translation: 椅子から立ち上がるのが難しいですか？

english: Do you trip because your foot drags?
transliteration: a-shi-o hi-ki-zu-ri, tsu-ma-zu-ku ko-to-ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 足を引きずって、つまずくことがありますか？

english: Do you drop objects from your hands?
transliteration: te-ka-ra mo-no-o o-to-shi-te shi-ma-u ko-to-ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 手から物を落としてしまうことがありますか？

english: Does the weakness get worse with repeated activity?
transliteration: o-na-ji do-o-sa-o ku-ri-ka-e-su-to, chi-ka-ra-ga ha-i-ri-ni-ku-ku na-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 同じ動作を繰り返すと、力が入りにくくなりますか？

english: Does resting improve the weakness?
transliteration: ya-su-mu-to, chi-ka-ra-ga ha-i-ri-ni-ku-i kan-JI-wa yo-ku na-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 休むと、力が入りにくい感じはよくなりますか？

english: Have you noticed muscle twitching or cramps?
transliteration: kin-NI-ku-ga pi-ku-tsu-i-ta-ri, ke-i-ren-shi-ta-ri su-ru ko-to-ni ki-zu-ki-MA-shi-ta-ka?
translation: 筋肉がぴくついたり、けいれんしたりすることに気づきましたか？

english: Have your muscles become smaller over time?
transliteration: ji-kan-ga ta-tsu-ni tsu-re-te, kin-NI-ku-ga ya-se-te ki-MA-shi-ta-ka?
translation: 時間がたつにつれて、筋肉がやせてきましたか？

english: Do you have numbness or tingling anywhere?
transliteration: do-ko-ka-ni shi-bi-re-ya chi-ku-chi-ku-su-ru kan-JI-ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: どこかにしびれやチクチクする感じがありますか？

english: Where does the numbness begin and where does it spread?
transliteration: shi-bi-re-wa do-ko-ka-ra ha-ji-ma-ri, do-ko-ma-de hi-ro-ga-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: しびれはどこから始まり、どこまで広がりますか？

english: Is the numbness in both hands or both feet?
transliteration: ryo-o-te, ma-ta-wa ryo-o-a-shi-ni shi-bi-re-ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 両手、または両足にしびれがありますか？

english: Do you feel burning or electric-shock-like pain?
transliteration: ya-ke-ru-yo-o-na i-ta-mi-ya, den-KI-ga ha-shi-ru-yo-o-na i-ta-mi-ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 焼けるような痛みや、電気が走るような痛みがありますか？

english: Does the pain travel from your back down your leg?
transliteration: se-na-ka-ka-ra a-shi-ni ka-ke-te i-ta-mi-ga ha-shi-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 背中から脚にかけて痛みが走りますか？

english: Can you feel hot and cold normally?
transliteration: a-tsu-i mo-no-to tsu-me-ta-i mo-no-o, i-tsu-mo do-o-ri kan-JI-ra-re-MAS-ka?
translation: 熱いものと冷たいものを、いつもどおり感じられますか？

english: Does touching the skin cause unusual pain?
transliteration: hi-fu-ni fu-re-ru-to, i-tsu-mo-to chi-ga-u i-ta-mi-ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 皮膚に触れると、いつもと違う痛みがありますか？

english: Have you ever had a seizure or fit?
transliteration: ke-i-ren ho-SO-o o-ko-shi-ta ko-to-ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: けいれん発作を起こしたことがありますか？

english: Did anyone see what happened during the episode?
transliteration: ho-SO-o no to-ki-ni na-ni-ga o-ki-ta-ka, da-re-ka mi-te i-MA-shi-ta-ka?
translation: 発作のときに何が起きたか、誰か見ていましたか？

english: Did your arms or legs shake uncontrollably?
transliteration: u-de-ya a-shi-ga ji-BUN-no i-shi-to-wa kan-kei-na-ku fu-ru-e-MA-shi-ta-ka?
