translation: 腕や脚が自分の意思とは関係なく震えましたか？

english: Did you lose awareness of your surroundings?
transliteration: ma-wa-ri-no jo-o-kyo-o-ga wa-ka-ra-na-ku na-ri-MA-shi-ta-ka?
translation: 周りの状況がわからなくなりましたか？

english: Did you bite your tongue?
transliteration: shi-ta-o ka-mi-MA-shi-ta-ka?
translation: 舌をかみましたか？

english: Did you lose control of your bladder?
transliteration: nyo-o-o mo-ra-shi-MA-shi-ta-ka?
translation: 尿を漏らしましたか？

english: Were you confused or sleepy afterward?
transliteration: so-no a-to, kon-RAN-shi-ta-ri ne-mu-ku na-tta-ri shi-MA-shi-ta-ka?
translation: その後、混乱したり眠くなったりしましたか？

english: Did you notice a strange smell, feeling, or warning before the episode?
transliteration: ho-SO-o-no ma-e-ni, hen-na ni-o-i-ya kan-KA-ku, ma-ta-wa ma-e-bu-re-ga a-ri-MA-shi-ta-ka?
translation: 発作の前に、変なにおいや感覚、または前触れがありましたか？

english: How long did it take to return to normal?
transliteration: i-tsu-mo-do-o-ri-ni mo-do-ru-ma-de, do-no-ku-RAI ka-ka-ri-MA-shi-ta-ka?
translation: いつもどおりに戻るまで、どのくらいかかりましたか？

english: Have you missed any doses of your seizure medicine?
transliteration: ke-i-ren-no ku-su-ri-o no-mi-wa-su-re-ta ko-to-ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: けいれんの薬を飲み忘れたことがありますか？

english: Do your hands shake when resting or when using them?
transliteration: te-wa, ji-tto shi-te i-ru to-ki-ya tsu-ka-tte i-ru to-ki-ni fu-ru-e-MAS-ka?
translation: 手は、じっとしているときや使っているときに震えますか？

english: Does the shaking affect one hand or both?
transliteration: fu-ru-e-wa ka-ta-te de-SU-ka, so-re-to-mo ryo-o-te de-SU-ka?
translation: 震えは片手ですか、それとも両手ですか？

english: Has your handwriting become smaller?
transliteration: ji-ga i-ZEN-yo-ri chi-i-sa-ku na-ri-MA-shi-ta-ka?
translation: 字が以前より小さくなりましたか？

english: Do you feel stiff or move more slowly?
transliteration: ka-ra-DA-ga ko-wa-ba-tta-ri, u-go-ki-ga o-so-ku na-tta-ri shi-te i-MAS-ka?
translation: 体がこわばったり、動きが遅くなったりしていますか？

english: Have you had difficulty starting to walk?
transliteration: a-ru-ki-ha-ji-me-ru-no-ga mu-zu-ka-shi-i ko-to-ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 歩き始めるのが難しいことがありますか？

english: Do you freeze or feel stuck while walking?
transliteration: a-ru-i-te i-ru to-ki, a-shi-ga su-ku-n-da-ri, u-go-ke-na-ku na-tta-ri shi-MAS-ka?
translation: 歩いているとき、足がすくんだり、動けなくなったりしますか？

english: Have you noticed changes in your voice or facial expression?
transliteration: ko-e-ya hyo-o-JO-o-ni he-NKA-ga a-ri-MA-shi-ta-ka?
translation: 声や表情に変化がありましたか？

english: Have you been forgetting recent conversations or appointments?
transliteration: sa-i-KIN-no ka-i-WA-ya yo-TEI-o wa-su-re-ru ko-to-ga fu-e-MA-shi-ta-ka?
translation: 最近の会話や予定を忘れることが増えましたか？

english: Do you have trouble finding the right words?
transliteration: te-ki-SE-tsu-na ko-TO-ba-ga na-ka-na-ka de-te ko-nai ko-to-ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 適切な言葉がなかなか出てこないことがありますか？

english: Have you become lost in familiar places?
transliteration: na-re-ta ba-SHO-de mi-chi-ni ma-yo-u ko-to-ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 慣れた場所で道に迷うことがありますか？

english: Do you have difficulty managing medicines or finances?
transliteration: ku-su-ri-ya o-ka-ne-no kan-RI-ga mu-zu-ka-shi-i de-SU-ka?
translation: 薬やお金の管理が難しいですか？

english: Have you noticed changes in your mood or behaviour?
transliteration: ki-BUN-ya ko-o-DO-o-ni he-NKA-ga a-ri-MA-shi-ta-ka?
translation: 気分や行動に変化がありましたか？

english: Do you have trouble concentrating?
transliteration: shu-CHU-su-ru-no-ga mu-zu-ka-shi-i de-SU-ka?
translation: 集中するのが難しいですか？

english: Has your speech become slurred?
transliteration: ro-RE-tsu-ga ma-wa-ri-ni-ku-ku na-ri-MA-shi-ta-ka?
translation: ろれつが回りにくくなりましたか？

english: Do you have trouble swallowing food or liquids?
transliteration: ta-be-mo-no-ya no-mi-mo-no-o no-mi-ko-mi-ni-ku-i de-SU-ka?
translation: 食べ物や飲み物を飲み込みにくいですか？

english: Do you see double?
transliteration: mo-no-ga ni-ju-u-ni mi-e-MAS-ka?
translation: 物が二重に見えますか？

english: Does the double vision go away when you cover one eye?
transliteration: ka-ta-me-o o-o-u-to, ni-ju-u-ni mi-e-ru-no-wa na-ku na-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 片目を覆うと、二重に見えるのはなくなりますか？

english: Have you noticed a drooping eyelid?
transliteration: ma-bu-ta-ga sa-ga-tte ki-ta ko-to-ni ki-zu-ki-MA-shi-ta-ka?
translation: まぶたが下がってきたことに気づきましたか？

english: Do you have numbness or pain in your face?
transliteration: ka-o-ni shi-bi-re-ya i-ta-mi-ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 顔にしびれや痛みがありますか？

english: Have you noticed weakness on one side of your face?
transliteration: ka-o-no ka-ta-ga-wa-ni chi-ka-ra-ga ha-i-ri-ni-ku-i ko-to-ni ki-zu-ki-MA-shi-ta-ka?
translation: 顔の片側に力が入りにくいことに気づきましたか？

english: Have you noticed changes in your hearing?
transliteration: ki-ko-e-ka-ta-ni he-NKA-ga a-ri-MA-shi-ta-ka?
translation: 聞こえ方に変化がありましたか？

english: Do you choke or cough when swallowing?
transliteration: no-mi-ko-mu to-ki-ni, mu-se-ta-ri se-ki-ko-n-da-ri shi-MAS-ka?
translation: 飲み込むときに、むせたり咳き込んだりしますか？

english: Have you ever had a stroke or a mini-stroke?
transliteration: no-o-so-o-chu-u-ya i-chi-ka-sei no-o-kyo-ke-tsu ho-SO-o o-ko-shi-ta ko-to-ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 脳卒中や一過性脳虚血発作を起こしたことがありますか？

english: Have you ever had a head injury or concussion?
transliteration: a-ta-ma-o ke-ga-shi-ta-ri, no-o-shin-to-o o-ko-shi-ta-ri shi-ta ko-to-ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 頭をけがしたり、脳しんとうを起こしたりしたことがありますか？

english: Have you ever had meningitis or a brain infection?
transliteration: zu-i-ma-ku-en-ya no-o-no kan-sen-SHO-o ni ka-ka-tta ko-to-ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 髄膜炎や脳の感染症にかかったことがありますか？

english: Do you have diabetes, high blood pressure, or high cholesterol?
transliteration: to-o-nyo-o-BYO-o, ko-o-ketsu-ATSU, ma-ta-wa ko-resu-te-RO-o-chi-ga ta-ka-i to i-wa-re-ta ko-to-ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 糖尿病、高血圧、またはコレステロール値が高いと言われたことがありますか？

english: Does anyone in your family have migraines, seizures, or a neurological condition?
transliteration: go-ka-ZO-ku-ni, hen-zu-tsu-u-ya ke-i-ren ho-SO-o, ma-ta-wa shin-kei-no byo-o-KI-ga a-ru ka-ta-wa i-MAS-ka?
translation: ご家族に、片頭痛やけいれん発作、または神経の病気がある方はいますか？

english: What medicines do you take regularly?
transliteration: fu-DA-n, do-no-yo-o-na ku-su-ri-o non-de i-MAS-ka?
translation: 普段、どのような薬を飲んでいますか？

english: What is the name and dose of your seizure medicine?
transliteration: ke-i-ren-no ku-su-ri-no na-ma-e-to RYO-o-o o-shi-e-te i-ta-da-ke-MAS-ka?
translation: けいれんの薬の名前と量を教えていただけますか？

english: How long have you been taking this medicine?
transliteration: ko-no ku-su-ri-o no-mi-ha-ji-me-te, do-no-ku-RAI-ni na-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: この薬を飲み始めて、どのくらいになりますか？

english: Have you recently started, stopped, or changed a medicine?
transliteration: sa-i-KIN, ku-su-ri-o no-mi-ha-ji-me-ta-ri, ya-me-ta-ri, he-NKO-o-shi-ta-ri shi-MA-shi-ta-ka?
translation: 最近、薬を飲み始めたり、やめたり、変更したりしましたか？

english: Has this medicine helped your symptoms?
transliteration: ko-no ku-su-ri-de sho-o-JO-o-wa yo-ku na-ri-MA-shi-ta-ka?
translation: この薬で症状はよくなりましたか？

english: Have you noticed any side effects?
transliteration: fu-ku-sa-YO-o-ni ki-zu-ki-MA-shi-ta-ka?
translation: 副作用に気づきましたか？

english: Do you drink alcohol or use recreational drugs?
transliteration: o-SA-ke-o non-da-ri, shi-ko-o mo-KU-te-ki-no ya-ku-BUTS-o tsu-ka-tta-ri shi-MAS-ka?
translation: お酒を飲んだり、嗜好目的の薬物を使ったりしますか？

english: Can you tell me your full name?
transliteration: fu-RU-ne-e-mu-o o-shi-e-te i-ta-da-ke-MAS-ka?
translation: フルネームを教えていただけますか？

english: Can you tell me today's date?
transliteration: kyo-o-wa nan-ga-tsu nan-ni-chi-ka, o-shi-e-te i-ta-da-ke-MAS-ka?
translation: 今日は何月何日か、教えていただけますか？

english: Can you tell me where we are right now?
transliteration: i-ma ko-ko-ga do-ko-ka, o-shi-e-te i-ta-da-ke-MAS-ka?
translation: 今ここがどこか、教えていただけますか？

english: Please repeat these three words after me.
transliteration: wa-ta-shi-no a-to-ni, ko-no mi-tsu-no ko-TO-ba-o ku-ri-ka-e-shi-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: 私のあとに、この3つの言葉を繰り返してください。

english: Please remember these words; I will ask you again later.
transliteration: ko-no ko-TO-ba-o o-bo-e-te o-i-te ku-da-SAI. a-to-de mo-o i-chi-do o-ki-ki-shi-MAS.
translation: この言葉を覚えておいてください。あとでもう一度お聞きします。

english: Please name this object.
transliteration: ko-no mo-no-no na-ma-e-o i-tte ku-da-SAI.
translation: この物の名前を言ってください。

english: Please follow this two-step instruction.
transliteration: ko-no fu-ta-tsu-no shi-JI-ni shi-ta-ga-tte ku-da-SAI.
translation: この2つの指示に従ってください。

english: Please read this sentence aloud.
transliteration: ko-no bun-o ko-e-ni da-shi-te yo-n-de ku-da-SAI.
translation: この文を声に出して読んでください。

english: Please write a complete sentence.
transliteration: bun-o hi-to-tsu, sa-i-GO-ma-de ka-i-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: 文を一つ、最後まで書いてください。

english: Please copy this drawing.
transliteration: ko-no e-o ma-ne-shi-te ka-i-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: この絵をまねして描いてください。

english: I am going to check your eye movements and facial muscles.
transliteration: ko-re-ka-ra, me-no u-go-ki-to ka-o-no kin-NI-ku-o mi-MAS.
translation: これから、目の動きと顔の筋肉を診ます。

english: Please look straight ahead.
transliteration: ma-ssu-gu ma-e-o mi-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: まっすぐ前を見てください。

english: Follow my finger with your eyes without moving your head.
transliteration: a-ta-ma-o u-go-ka-sa-zu-ni, me-de wa-ta-shi-no yu-BI-o o-tte ku-da-SAI.
translation: 頭を動かさずに、目で私の指を追ってください。

english: Please cover one eye.
transliteration: ka-ta-me-o te-de o-o-tte ku-da-SAI.
translation: 片目を手で覆ってください。

english: Tell me when you can see my moving finger.
transliteration: wa-ta-shi-no u-go-ku yu-BI-ga mi-e-ta-ra, o-shi-e-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: 私の動く指が見えたら、教えてください。

english: I am going to shine a light into your eyes.
transliteration: ko-re-ka-ra, me-ni hi-ka-ri-o a-te-MAS.
translation: これから、目に光を当てます。

english: Please raise your eyebrows.
transliteration: ma-yu-o a-ge-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: 眉を上げてください。

english: Please close your eyes tightly.
transliteration: me-o gyu-tto to-ji-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: 目をぎゅっと閉じてください。

english: Please smile and show your teeth.
transliteration: wa-ra-tte, ha-o mi-se-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: 笑って、歯を見せてください。

english: Please puff out your cheeks.
transliteration: ho-o-o fu-ku-ra-ma-se-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: 頬をふくらませてください。

english: Does this feel the same on both sides of your face?
transliteration: ka-o-no ryo-o-ga-wa-de, o-na-ji-yo-o-ni kan-JI-MAS-ka?
translation: 顔の両側で、同じように感じますか？

english: Please open your mouth and say ah.
transliteration: ku-chi-o a-ke-te, aa to it-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: 口を開けて、「あー」と言ってください。

english: Please stick out your tongue.
transliteration: shi-ta-o da-shi-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: 舌を出してください。

english: Please shrug your shoulders against my hands.
transliteration: wa-ta-shi-no te-ni sa-ka-ra-u-yo-o-ni, ka-ta-o su-ku-me-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: 私の手に逆らうように、肩をすくめてください。

english: Please turn your head against my hand.
transliteration: wa-ta-shi-no te-ni sa-ka-ra-u-yo-o-ni, a-ta-ma-o ma-wa-shi-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: 私の手に逆らうように、頭を回してください。

english: Please hold both arms straight out in front of you.
transliteration: ryoh-uwan-oh mah-eh-nee maht-soo-guh noh-bah-shee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 両腕を前にまっすぐ伸ばしてください。

english: Turn your palms upward and close your eyes.
transliteration: teh-noh hah-rahm-oh ooh-eh-nee moo-keh-teh, meh-oh toh-jee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 手のひらを上に向けて、目を閉じてください。

english: Please squeeze my fingers.
transliteration: wah-tah-shee-noh yuh-bee-oh nee-gee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 私の指を握ってください。

english: Please push against my hand.
transliteration: wah-tah-shee-noh teh-oh oh-shee-kah-eh-shee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 私の手を押し返してください。

english: Please pull against my hand.
transliteration: wah-tah-shee-noh teh-oh hee-pah-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 私の手を引っ張ってください。

english: Please lift your leg off the bed.
transliteration: bed-doh-kah-rah ah-shee-oh moh-chee-ah-geh-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: ベッドから脚を持ち上げてください。

english: Please bend your knee.
transliteration: hee-zah-oh mah-geh-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 膝を曲げてください。

english: Please straighten your knee.
transliteration: hee-zah-oh noh-bah-shee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 膝を伸ばしてください。

english: Please pull your toes up toward your head.
transliteration: tsoo-mah-sah-kee-oh ah-tah-mah-noh hoh-oh-nee hee-kee-ah-geh-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: つま先を頭のほうに引き上げてください。

english: Please push your foot down like pressing a pedal.
transliteration: peh-dah-rooh-oh foo-moo yoh-oh-nee, ah-shee-oh shee-nee oh-shee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: ペダルを踏むように、足を下に押してください。

english: Please relax while I move your arm.
transliteration: oo-deh-oh oh-goo-kah-shee-mahs-noh-deh, chee-kah-rah-oh noh-ee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 腕を動かしますので、力を抜いてください。

english: Please close your eyes while I check your sensation.
transliteration: kahn-kah-koo-oh shee-rah-beh-mahs-noh-deh, meh-oh toh-jee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 感覚を調べますので、目を閉じてください。

english: Can you feel me touching you here?
transliteration: koh-koh-oh tah-woo-eh-teh-oo-noh gah wah-kah-ree-mahs-kah
translation: ここを触っているのが分かりますか？

english: Does it feel the same on the left and right?
transliteration: sah-yoo-deh kahn-jeh-kah-tah-wah oh-nah-jeh-deh-soo-kah
translation: 左右で感じ方は同じですか？

english: Tell me whether this feels sharp or dull.
transliteration: koh-reh-wah soo-ruh-doh-ee kahn-jeh-kah, nee-boo-ee kahn-jeh-kah oh shee-eh-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: これは鋭い感じか、鈍い感じか教えてください。

english: Tell me whether this feels warm or cold.
transliteration: koh-reh-wah ah-tah-tah-kai kahn-jeh-kah, tsuh-meh-tai kahn-jeh-kah oh shee-eh-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: これは温かい感じか、冷たい感じか教えてください。

english: Tell me which way I move your finger or toe.
transliteration: yoo-bee-yah tsoo-mah-sah-kee-oh doh-chee-rah-nee oh-goo-kah-shee-teh-ee-roo-kah oh shee-eh-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 指やつま先をどちらに動かしているか教えてください。

english: I am going to tap your knee gently to check your reflexes.
transliteration: hahn-shah-oh shee-rah-beh-roo tah-meh, hee-zah-oh kah-roo-koo tah-tah-kee-mahs
translation: 反射を調べるため、膝を軽く叩きます。

english: Please let your arm or leg relax.
transliteration: oo-deh-yah ah-shee-noh chee-kah-rah-oh noh-ee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 腕や脚の力を抜いてください。

english: Please touch your nose and then my finger.
transliteration: hah-nah-oh tah-tsun-deh-kah-rah, wah-tah-shee-noh yuh-bee-oh tah-tsun-deh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 鼻を触ってから、私の指を触ってください。

english: Please do that again a little faster.
transliteration: moh-ee-chee-doh, soo-koh-shee hah-yah-koo yah-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: もう一度、少し速くやってください。

english: Please tap your hands on your thighs, turning them over quickly.
transliteration: teh-noh hah-rahm-oh soo-bah-yah-koo kah-eh-shih-nah-gah-rah, moh-moh-tah-oh teh-deh tah-tah-ee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 手のひらを素早く返しながら、太ももを手で叩いてください。

english: Please slide your heel down your other shin.
transliteration: kah-kah-toh-oh hahn-tah-ee-gah-wah-noh soo-neh-nee soh-ee-teh soo-bee-rah-seh-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: かかとを反対側のすねに沿って滑らせてください。

english: Please stand with your feet together.
transliteration: ryoh-ah-shee-oh soh-roh-eh-teh tah-tteh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 両足をそろえて立ってください。

english: Please close your eyes while standing; I will stay beside you.
transliteration: tah-tteh-tah-mah meh-oh toh-jee-teh koo-dah-sigh. soh-bah-nee ee-mahs
translation: 立ったまま目を閉じてください。そばにいます。

english: Please walk across the room and back.
transliteration: heh-yah-noh moo-koh-oh-mah-deh ah-ree-ee-teh, moh-doh-tteh-kee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 部屋の向こうまで歩いて、戻ってきてください。

english: Please walk heel to toe in a straight line.
transliteration: kah-kah-toh-toh tsoo-mah-sah-kee-oh koh-tah-ee-bahn-nee tsu-keh-teh, ee-chee-reen-seen-nee ah-ree-ee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: かかととつま先を交互につけて、一直線に歩いてください。

english: Please walk on your heels.
transliteration: kah-kah-toh-deh ah-ree-ee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: かかとで歩いてください。

english: Please walk on your toes.
transliteration: tsoo-mah-sah-kee-deh ah-ree-ee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: つま先で歩いてください。

english: Please turn around and walk back.
transliteration: moo-kee-oh kah-eh-teh, moh-doh-tteh-kee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 向きを変えて、戻ってきてください。

english: We may need a CT scan of your head.
transliteration: toh-bwoh-noh see-tee-scan keh-sahng-gah hee-tsuy-yooh-nee nah-roo-kah-moh shee-reh-mah-sen
translation: 頭部のCT検査が必要になるかもしれません。

english: We may need an MRI scan of your brain or spine.
transliteration: noh-yah seh-kee-tsuy-noh MRI keh-sahng-gah hee-tsuy-yooh-nee nah-roo-kah-moh shee-reh-mah-sen
translation: 脳や脊椎のMRI検査が必要になるかもしれません。

english: An EEG records the electrical activity of your brain.
transliteration: noh-hah keh-sahng-deh-wah, noh-noh dehn-kee-teh-kee-nah kah-tsuh-doh-oh roh-koo-shee-mahs
translation: 脳波検査では、脳の電気的な活動を記録します。

english: A nerve conduction study checks how your nerves send signals.
transliteration: sheen-keh-ndoh-dehn-keh-sahng-deh-wah, sheen-keh-gah doh-noh-yoh-nee see-gnah-roo-oh tsu-tah-eh-roo-kah-oh shee-rah-beh-mahs
translation: 神経伝導検査では、神経がどのように信号を伝えるかを調べます。

english: A lumbar puncture takes a small sample of fluid from your lower back.
transliteration: kosh-ee-noh ah-tah-ree-kah-rah shoh-ryoh-noh eh-kee-tah-ee-oh sah-ee-shoo-sheh shoh-tswee-sen-see-oh oh-koh-nah-ee-mahs
translation: 腰のあたりから少量の液体を採取する腰椎穿刺を行います。

english: I will explain the benefits and risks before any procedure.
transliteration: shee-chee-noh mah-eh-nee, ree-ehn-toh ree-sook-oh goh-seh-meh-see-mahs
translation: 処置の前に、利点とリスクをご説明します。

english: Do you have any questions before we proceed?
transliteration: soo-smeh-roo mah-eh-nee, nah-nee-kah shee-tsoo-mon-wah ah-ree-mahs-kah
translation: 進める前に、何か質問はありますか？

english: We will discuss the results and next steps with you.
transliteration: keh-kah-toh koh-reh-kah-rah-noh yoh-teh-eh-nee-tsoo-ee-teh, ee-shoh-nee hah-nah-shee-ah-ee-mahs
translation: 結果と今後の予定について、一緒に話し合います。

english: Please take your medicines exactly as prescribed.
transliteration: koo-shee-ree-wah shoh-hoh-doh-ree-nee fook-yoh-oh shee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 薬は処方どおりに服用してください。

english: Do not stop seizure medicines suddenly without medical advice.
transliteration: ee-shee-nee soh-dahn-seh-zoo-nee, keh-ee-rehn-noh koo-soo-ree-oh kyoo-nee yah-meh-nah-ee-deh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 医師に相談せずに、けいれんの薬を急にやめないでください。

english: Seek emergency care for sudden weakness, trouble speaking, or a severe sudden headache.
transliteration: toh-tsu-zenn-noh dah-tsu-ryo-koo, hah-nah-shee-nee-koo-sah, mah-tah-wah toh-tsu-zenn-noh hah-geh-shee-ee-zoot-too-oh gah ah-reh-bah, kyoo-kyoo-oh jyoo-sheen shee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 突然の脱力、話しにくさ、または突然の激しい頭痛があれば、救急を受診してください。

english: We will arrange a follow-up appointment.
transliteration: sah-ee-sheen-noh yoh-yah-koo-oh teh-hyee shee-mahs
translation: 再診の予約を手配します。

english: What questions do you have for me?
transliteration: wah-tah-shee-nee kee-kee-tah-ee koh-toh-wah nahn-deh-soo-kah
translation: 私に聞きたいことは何ですか？

english: Hello. I am here to examine your eyes.
transliteration: kohn-nee-chee-wah. meh-noh sheen-sah-tsu-oh shee-mahs
translation: こんにちは。目の診察をします。

english: What brings you in today?
transliteration: kyoh-wah doh-sah-reh-mah-shee-tah-kah
translation: 今日はどうされましたか？

english: Please sit here.
transliteration: koh-chee-rah-nee oh-swah-ree koo-dah-sigh
translation: こちらにお座りください。

english: Which eye is bothering you?
transliteration: doh-chee-rah-noh meh-gah kee-nee nah-ree-mahs-kah
translation: どちらの目が気になりますか？

english: Is it one eye or both eyes?
transliteration: kah-tah-meh-dah-keh-deh-soo-kah, soh-reh-toh-moh ryoh-meh-deh-soo-kah
translation: 片目だけですか、それとも両目ですか？

english: When did the problem start?
transliteration: ee-tsu-kah-rah shoh-joh-gah hah-jih-mah-ree-mah-shee-tah-kah
translation: いつから症状が始まりましたか？

english: May I examine your eyes?
transliteration: meh-oh sheen-sah-tsu-sheh-teh-moh yoh-roh-shee-ee-deh-soo-kah
translation: 目を診察してもよろしいですか？

english: Please tell me if anything hurts.
transliteration: ee-tah-ee toh-koh-roh-gah ah-reh-bah shee-eh-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 痛いところがあれば教えてください。

english: How long has this been happening?
transliteration: doh-noh-kurigh-mah-eh-kah-rah tsoo-dzu-ee-teh-ee-mahs-kah
translation: どのくらい前から続いていますか？

english: How many days has this been happening?
transliteration: nahn-nee-chee-kahn tsoo-dzu-ee-teh-ee-mahs-kah
translation: 何日間続いていますか？

english: Did it start suddenly or gradually?
transliteration: toh-tsu-zenn hah-jih-mah-ree-mah-shee-tah-kah, soh-reh-toh-moh joh-joh-nee hah-jih-mah-ree-mah-shee-tah-kah
translation: 突然始まりましたか、それとも徐々に始まりましたか？

english: Is it constant, or does it come and go?
transliteration: zoo-ttoh tsoo-dzu-ee-teh-ee-mahs-kah, soh-reh-toh-moh deh-tah-ree-kee-eh-tah-ree shee-mahs-kah
translation: ずっと続いていますか、それとも出たり消えたりしますか？

english: How long does each episode last?
transliteration: shoh-joh-wah mah-ee-kai doh-noh-koo-rah-ee tsoo-dzu-ee-teh-ee-mahs-kah
translation: 症状は毎回どのくらい続きますか？

english: Does it last seconds, minutes, hours, or days?
transliteration: soo-oh-byooh, soo-oh-foon, soo-oh-jih-kahn, mah-tah-wah soo-oh-nee-chee tsoo-dzu-ee-teh-ee-mahs-kah
translation: 数秒、数分、数時間、または数日続きますか？

english: Is it getting better, worse, or staying the same?
transliteration: yoh-koo-nah-tteh-ee-mahs-kah, wah-roo-koo-nah-tteh-ee-mahs-kah, soh-reh-toh-moh kah-wah-ree-mah-sen-kah
translation: 良くなっていますか、悪くなっていますか、それとも変わりませんか？

english: Has this happened before?
transliteration: ee-zen-nee-moh oh-nah-jeh-koh-toh-gah ah-ree-mah-shee-tah-kah
translation: 以前にも同じことがありましたか？

english: Did you wake up with this problem?
transliteration: koh-noh shoh-joh-gah ah-roo joh-tah-ee-deh meh-gah sah-meh-mah-shee-tah-kah
translation: この症状がある状態で目が覚めましたか？

english: Did it start after an injury or procedure?
transliteration: keh-gah-yah shee-chee-noh ah-toh-nee hah-jih-mah-ree-mah-shee-tah-kah
translation: けがや処置の後に始まりましたか？

english: Has your vision changed?
transliteration: meh-noh mee-eh-kah-tah-nee kah-wah-ree-gah ah-ree-mah-shee-tah-kah
translation: 見え方に変化がありましたか？

english: Is your vision blurry?
transliteration: shee-kai-gah boh-yah-keh-mah-soo-kah
translation: 視界がぼやけますか？

english: Did you suddenly lose vision?
transliteration: toh-tsu-zenn mee-eh-nah-koo nah-ree-mah-shee-tah-kah
translation: 突然、見えなくなりましたか？

english: Did your vision return to normal?
transliteration: mee-eh-kah-tah-wah moh-toh-nee moh-doh-ree-mah-shee-tah-kah
translation: 見え方は元に戻りましたか？

english: Is your vision loss complete or partial?
transliteration: maht-tah-koo mee-eh-mah-sen-kah, soh-reh-toh-moh ee-chee-boo-dah-keh mee-eh-mah-sen-kah
translation: まったく見えませんか、それとも一部だけ見えませんか？

english: Is the centre of your vision affected?
transliteration: shee-kai-noh chee-yoo-oh gah mee-eh-nee-koo-koo nah-tteh-ee-mahs-kah
translation: 視界の中央が見えにくくなっていますか？

english: Is your side vision affected?
transliteration: shoo-heen-noh shee-kai-gah mee-eh-nee-koo-koo nah-tteh-ee-mahs-kah
translation: 周辺の視界が見えにくくなっていますか？

english: Is the top or bottom part of your vision missing?
transliteration: shee-kai-noh oo-eh-kah-shhee-tah-noh boo-been-gah kah-keh-teh-ee-mahs-kah
translation: 視界の上か下の部分が欠けていますか？

english: Do you see flashes of light?
transliteration: hee-kah-ree-gah chee-kah-chee-kah mee-eh-mahs-kah
translation: 光がチカチカ見えますか？

english: Do you see new floating spots or cobwebs?
transliteration: ah-tah-rah-shee-ee koo-roh-ee teh-n yah koo-moh-noh-shee-noh yoh-oh-nah moh-noh-gah mee-eh-mahs-kah
translation: 新しい黒い点やクモの巣のようなものが見えますか？

english: Do you see a curtain or shadow over your vision?
transliteration: shee-kai-nee kah-tehn yah kah-geh-gah kah-kah-tteh mee-eh-mahs-kah
translation: 視界にカーテンや影がかかって見えますか？

english: Do straight lines look bent or wavy?
transliteration: maht-ssoo-guh-nah seen-gah mah-gah-tah-ree, mah-tah-wah nah-mee-oh oo-tteh mee-eh-mahs-kah
translation: まっすぐな線が曲がったり、波打ったりして見えますか？

english: Do you see two images of one object?
transliteration: hee-toh-tsoo-noh moh-noh-gah nee-joo-oo-nee mee-eh-mahs-kah
translation: 1つの物が二重に見えますか？

english: Does the double vision go away when you close either eye?
transliteration: doh-chee-rah-kah-noh meh-oh toh-jee-roo-toh, nee-joo-oo-nee mee-eh-roo-noh-gah oh-sah-mah-ree-mahs-kah
translation: どちらかの目を閉じると、二重に見えるのは治まりますか？

english: Do you see halos around lights?
transliteration: rye-toh-noh mah-wah-ree-nee wah-gah mee-eh-mahs-kah
translation: ライトの周りに輪が見えますか？

english: Is it harder to see at night?
transliteration: yoh-ree-nee mee-eh-nee-koo-koo nah-ree-mahs-kah
translation: 夜に見えにくくなりますか？

english: Does bright light bother your eyes?
transliteration: ah-kah-ree-ee hee-kah-ree-gah meh-nee hee-bee-khih-mahs-kah
translation: 明るい光が目に響きますか？

english: Do your eyes hurt?
transliteration: meh-gah ee-tah-mee-mahs-kah
translation: 目が痛みますか？

english: Where exactly does it hurt? Please point.
transliteration: doh-koh-gah ee-tah-moo-kah, seh-ee-kah-koo-nah bah-shoh-oh yoo-bee-deh shee-meh-shee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: どこが痛むか、正確な場所を指で示してください。

english: How severe is the pain from zero to ten?
transliteration: ee-tah-mee-wah reh-ee-kah-rah jyoo-noh oo-chee, doh-noh-koo-rah-ee-deh-soo-kah
translation: 痛みは0から10で、どのくらいですか？

english: Is the pain sharp, dull, or burning?
transliteration: ee-tah-mee-wah soo-ruh-doh-ee kahn-jeh-deh-soo-kah, nee-boo-ee kahn-jeh-deh-soo-kah, soh-reh-toh-moh yeh-kee-roo-yoh-oh-nah kahn-jeh-deh-soo-kah
translation: 痛みは鋭い感じですか、鈍い感じですか、それとも焼けるような感じですか？

english: Does the pain worsen when you move your eyes?
transliteration: meh-oh oh-goo-kah-soh-toh ee-tah-mee-gah tsuy-koo-nah-ree-mah-soo-kah
translation: 目を動かすと痛みが強くなりますか？

english: Do you have a headache or nausea?
transliteration: zoo-too-oh yah kee-moh-ee-gah ah-ree-mah-soo-kah
translation: 頭痛や吐き気はありますか？

english: Are your eyes red?
transliteration: meh-gah ah-kah-koo nah-tteh-ee-mah-soo-kah
translation: 目が赤くなっていますか？

english: Do your eyes itch?
transliteration: meh-gah kah-yoo-ee-deh-soo-kah
translation: 目がかゆいですか？

english: Do your eyes feel dry or gritty?
transliteration: meh-gah kah-wah-ee-tah-ree, goh-roh-goh-roh shee-tah-ree shee-mah-soo-kah
translation: 目が乾いたり、ゴロゴロしたりしますか？

english: Are your eyes watering?
transliteration: nah-mee-dah-gah deh-mah-soo-kah
translation: 涙が出ますか？

english: Is there sticky discharge or pus?
transliteration: meh-yah-nee yah nooh-noh yoh-oh-nah moh-noh-gah deh-mah-soo-kah
translation: 目やにや膿のようなものが出ますか？

english: Are your eyelids swollen or drooping?
transliteration: mah-boo-tah-gah hah-reh-tah-ree, tah-reh-sah-gah-tteh-ee-mah-soo-kah
translation: まぶたが腫れたり、垂れ下がったりしていますか？

english: Do you have pain around, above, or below the eye?
transliteration: meh-noh mah-wah-ree, oo-eh, mah-tah-wah shee-tah-nee ee-tah-mee-gah ah-ree-mah-soo-kah
translation: 目の周り、上、または下に痛みがありますか？

english: Did anything hit or scratch your eye?
transliteration: nah-nee-kah-gah meh-nee ah-tah-tah-ree, meh-oh kah-kee-mah-shee-tah-kah
translation: 何かが目に当たったり、目を引っかいたりしましたか？

english: Did something get into your eye?
transliteration: nah-nee-kah-gah meh-nee hah-ee-ree-mah-shee-tah-kah
translation: 何かが目に入りましたか？

english: Did any chemical splash into your eye?
transliteration: yah-koo-heen-gah meh-nee toh-bee-chih-ree-mah-shee-tah-kah
translation: 薬品が目に飛び散りましたか？

english: Have you rinsed your eye with water?
transliteration: meh-oh mee-zu-deh ah-rah-ee-nah-gah-shee-mah-shee-tah-kah
translation: 目を水で洗い流しましたか？

english: Do you wear contact lenses?
transliteration: kohn-tah-koo-toh rehhn-zu-oh tsu-kah-tteh-ee-mah-soo-kah
translation: コンタクトレンズを使っていますか？

english: Do you sleep while wearing contact lenses?
transliteration: kohn-tah-koo-toh rehhn-zu-oh tsu-kah-tah-mah-mah neh-mah-soo-kah
translation: コンタクトレンズをつけたまま寝ますか？

english: When did you last wear your contact lenses?
transliteration: sah-ee-goh-nee kohn-tah-koo-toh rehhn-zu-oh tsu-kah-tah-noh-wah ee-tsu-deh-soo-kah
translation: 最後にコンタクトレンズを使ったのはいつですか？

english: Do you swim or shower with contact lenses in?
transliteration: kohn-tah-koo-toh rehhn-zu-oh tsu-kah-tah-mah-mah oh-yoh-ee-dah-ree, shoh-wah-oh ah-bee-tah-ree shee-mah-soo-kah
translation: コンタクトレンズをつけたまま泳いだり、シャワーを浴びたりしますか？

english: Have you recently started any new eye drops?
transliteration: sah-ee-keen, ah-tah-rah-shee-ee meh-goo-soo-oh tsu-kah-ee-hah-jih-meh-mah-shee-tah-kah
translation: 最近、新しい目薬を使い始めましたか？

english: Do you wear glasses?
transliteration: meh-gah-neh-oh kah-keh-teh-ee-mah-soo-kah
translation: 眼鏡をかけていますか？

english: Have you recently changed your glasses prescription?
transliteration: sah-ee-keen, meh-gah-neh-noh doh-sow-oh kah-eh-mah-shee-tah-kah
translation: 最近、眼鏡の度数を変えましたか？

english: Have you had eye surgery or laser treatment?
transliteration: meh-noh shoo-joo-tsu-yah reh-ee-zah-tee-ryoh-oh oo-keh-tah-koh-toh-gah ah-ree-mah-soo-kah
translation: 目の手術やレーザー治療を受けたことがありますか？

english: Have you ever had this eye condition before?
transliteration: ee-zen-nee-moh koh-noh meh-noh shoh-joh-gah deh-tah-koh-toh-gah ah-ree-mah-soo-kah
translation: 以前にもこの目の症状が出たことがありますか？

english: Have you been told you have glaucoma (kala motia)?
transliteration: ryok-nai-shoh (kah-rah moh-tee-ah) toh ee-wah-reh-tah-koh-toh-gah ah-ree-mah-soo-kah
translation: 緑内障（カラ・モティア）と言われたことがありますか？

english: Have you been told you have cataracts (chitta motia)?
transliteration: hah-koo-nai-shoh (cheet-tah moh-tee-ah) toh ee-wah-reh-tah-koh-toh-gah ah-ree-mah-soo-kah
translation: 白内障（チッタ・モティア）と言われたことがありますか？

english: Does anyone in your family have glaucoma?
transliteration: goh-kah-zoh-koo-nee ryok-nai-shoh-noh kah-tah-wah ee-mah-soo-kah
translation: ご家族に緑内障の方はいますか？

english: Do you have diabetes or high blood pressure?
transliteration: toh-nyoh-byoh-yah koh-ket-see-ah-tsah wah ah-ree-mah-soo-kah
translation: 糖尿病や高血圧はありますか？

english: What medications or eye drops do you use?
transliteration: tsu-kah-tteh-ee-roo koo-soo-ree-yah meh-goo-soo-wah nahn-deh-soo-kah
translation: 使っている薬や目薬は何ですか？

english: Are you allergic to any medications?
transliteration: koo-soo-ree-deh ah-reh-ru-gee-gah deh-tah-koh-toh-gah ah-ree-mah-soo-kah
translation: 薬でアレルギーが出たことがありますか？

english: When was your last eye examination?
transliteration: sah-ee-goh-nee meh-noh keh-sahng-oh oo-keh-tah-noh-wah ee-tsu-deh-soo-kah
translation: 最後に目の検査を受けたのはいつですか？

english: Please show me which eye.
transliteration: doh-chee-rah-noh meh-kah oh shee-eh-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: どちらの目か教えてください。

english: Look here.
transliteration: koh-koh-oh mee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: ここを見てください。

english: Look straight ahead.
transliteration: maht-ssoo-guh mah-eh-oh mee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: まっすぐ前を見てください。

english: Open your eyes.
transliteration: meh-oh ah-keh-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 目を開けてください。

english: Close your eyes.
transliteration: meh-oh toh-jee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 目を閉じてください。

english: Keep both eyes open.
transliteration: ryoh-meh-oh ah-keh-tah mah-mah-nee shee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 両目を開けたままにしてください。

english: Put your glasses on.
transliteration: meh-gah-neh-oh kah-keh-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 眼鏡をかけてください。

english: Please remove your glasses.
transliteration: meh-gah-neh-oh hah-zoo-shee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 眼鏡を外してください。

english: Cover your left eye.
transliteration: hee-dah-ree-meh-oh kah-koo-shee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 左目を隠してください。

english: Cover your right eye.
transliteration: mee-gee-meh-oh kah-koo-shee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 右目を隠してください。

english: Read the smallest line you can see.
transliteration: mee-eh-roo nah-kah-deh ee-chee-bahn chee-sah-ee gyoh-oh yohn-deh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 見える中で一番小さい行を読んでください。

english: Look through this small hole.
transliteration: koh-noh chee-sah-ee ah-nah-oh toh-oh-shee-teh mee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: この小さな穴を通して見てください。

english: How many fingers do you see?
transliteration: yoo-bee-gah nahn-bon mee-eh-mah-soo-kah
translation: 指が何本見えますか？

english: Can you see my hand moving?
transliteration: wah-tah-shee-noh teh-gah oh-goo-ee-teh-ee-roo-noh-gah mee-eh-mah-soo-kah
translation: 私の手が動いているのが見えますか？

english: Can you see the light?
transliteration: hee-kah-ree-gah mee-eh-mah-soo-kah
translation: 光が見えますか？

english: I am going to shine a light into your eyes.
transliteration: meh-nee hee-kah-ree-oh ah-teh-mahs
translation: 目に光を当てます。

english: Please look at the wall behind me.
transliteration: wah-tah-shee-noh hah-ee-noh kah-beh-oh mee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 私の後ろの壁を見てください。

english: Do not look directly at the light.
transliteration: hee-kah-ree-oh dee-ree-chih mee-nah-ee-deh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 光を直接見ないでください。

english: Look at my finger without moving your head.
transliteration: ah-tah-mah-oh oh-goo-kah-sah-zoo-nee, wah-tah-shee-noh yuh-bee-oh mee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 頭を動かさずに、私の指を見てください。

english: Look up.
transliteration: oo-eh-oh mee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 上を見てください。

english: Look down.
transliteration: shee-tah-oh mee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 下を見てください。

english: Look left.
transliteration: hee-dah-ree-oh mee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 左を見てください。

english: Look right.
transliteration: mee-gee-oh mee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 右を見てください。

english: Is the double vision worse in this direction?
transliteration: koh-noh hoh-koh-oh mee-roo-toh, moh-noh-gah nee-joo-oo-nee mee-eh-roo shoh-joh-gah tsuy-koo-nah-ree-mah-soo-kah
translation: この方向を見ると、物が二重に見える症状が強くなりますか？

english: Raise your eyebrows.
transliteration: mee-mah-yoo-oh ah-geh-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 眉を上げてください。

english: Keep looking at my nose, not my hand.
transliteration: wah-tah-shee-noh teh-deh-wah nah-koo, hah-nah-oh mee-tsoo-zoo-keh-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 私の手ではなく、鼻を見続けてください。

english: Raise your hand when you see my fingers.
transliteration: wah-tah-shee-noh yuh-bee-gah mee-eh-tah-rah, teh-oh ah-geh-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 私の指が見えたら、手を上げてください。

english: Tell me when you see the light.
transliteration: hee-kah-ree-gah mee-eh-tah-rah shee-eh-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 光が見えたら教えてください。

english: Do you see the same on both sides?
transliteration: ryoh-soh-koo-deh oh-nah-jeh-yoh-nee mee-eh-mah-soo-kah
translation: 両側で同じように見えますか？

english: I am going to check the pressure in your eye.
transliteration: meh-noh ah-tsu-ryoh-oh hah-kah-ree-mahs
translation: 目の圧力を測ります。

english: You may feel a light touch on your eye.
transliteration: meh-nee kah-roo-koo tah-woo-eh-roo koh-toh-gah ah-ree-mahs
translation: 目に軽く触れることがあります。

english: Please keep still and try not to blink.
transliteration: oo-goo-kah-zoo-nee, deh-kee-roo-dah-keh mah-bah-tee-oh shee-nah-ee-deh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 動かずに、できるだけまばたきをしないでください。

english: Place your chin here and your forehead against the bar.
transliteration: ah-goo-oh koh-koh-nee oh-ee-teh, oh-deh-ko-oh bah-ah-nee tsu-keh-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: あごをここに置いて、おでこをバーにつけてください。

english: Open your eyes wide.
transliteration: meh-oh oh-khee-koo ah-keh-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 目を大きく開けてください。

english: Please do not pull your head back.
transliteration: ah-tah-mah-oh oh-shi-nee hee-kah-nah-ee-deh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 頭を後ろに引かないでください。

english: The light will be bright.
transliteration: hee-kah-ree-gah mah-boo-shee-koo nah-ree-mahs
translation: 光がまぶしくなります。

english: I am going to touch your eyelid.
transliteration: mah-boo-tah-nee tah-woo-eh-mahs
translation: まぶたに触れます。

english: Look at my ear.
transliteration: wah-tah-shee-noh mee-mee-oh mee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 私の耳を見てください。

english: I am going to put drops in your eyes.
transliteration: meh-goo-soo-oh sah-shee-mahs
translation: 目薬をさします。

english: These drops will numb your eye and may sting briefly.
transliteration: koh-noh meh-goo-soo-deh meh-noh kahn-kah-koo-gah nee-boo-koo nah-ree-mahs. soo-koh-shee shee-mee-roo koh-toh-gah ah-ree-mahs
translation: この目薬で目の感覚が鈍くなります。少ししみることがあります。

english: These drops will make your pupils bigger.
transliteration: koh-noh meh-goo-soo-deh doo-koh-gah oh-kee-koo nah-ree-mahs
translation: この目薬で瞳孔が大きくなります。

english: Your vision may be blurry for several hours.
transliteration: soo-oh-jih-kahn, shee-kai-gah boh-yah-keh-roo koh-toh-gah ah-ree-mahs
translation: 数時間、視界がぼやけることがあります。

english: Bright light may bother you after the drops.
transliteration: meh-goo-soo-oh sah-shee-tah ah-toh, tsuy-ee hee-kah-ree-gah kee-nee nah-roo koh-toh-gah ah-ree-mahs
translation: 目薬をさした後、強い光が気になることがあります。

english: Please do not rub your eyes.
transliteration: meh-oh koh-rah-sah-nah-ee-deh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 目をこすらないでください。

english: Please remove your contact lenses.
transliteration: kohn-tah-koo-toh rehhn-zu-oh hah-zoo-shee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: コンタクトレンズを外してください。

english: We are going to take photographs of the back of your eye.
transliteration: meh-noh oo-roo-oh sah-tsu-eh-shee-mahs
translation: 目の奥を撮影します。

english: We are going to do a scan of the back of your eye.
transliteration: meh-noh oo-roo-oh soo-kyahn shee-mahs
translation: 目の奥をスキャンします。

english: Have you had an eye ultrasound before?
transliteration: ee-zen-nee meh-noh choh-oh-nahm-pah keh-sahng-oh oo-keh-tah-koh-toh-gah ah-ree-mah-soo-kah
translation: 以前、目の超音波検査を受けたことがありますか？

english: Have you had an MRI scan of your eyes or head?
transliteration: meh-yah ah-tah-mah-noh MRI keh-sahng-oh oo-keh-tah-koh-toh-gah ah-ree-mah-soo-kah
translation: 目や頭のMRI検査を受けたことがありますか？

english: You will lie still inside a noisy scanner.
transliteration: oh-toh-noh oh-kee-nah soo-kyah-nah-noh nah-kah-deh, oo-goo-kah-zoo-nee yoh-kah-nee nah-tteh-ee-tah-dah-kee-mahs
translation: 音の大きいスキャナーの中で、動かずに横になっていただきます。

english: Please follow the light with your eyes.
transliteration: meh-deh hee-kah-ree-oh oh-ee-kah-keh-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 目で光を追ってください。

english: The examination is finished. Thank you.
transliteration: keh-sahng-wah oh-wah-ree-mah-shee-tah. ah-ree-gah-toh goh-zah-ee-mahs
translation: 検査は終わりました。ありがとうございます。

english: We need to arrange an appointment with an eye specialist.
transliteration: gahn-kah-noh seh-mon-ee-shah-noh yoh-yah-koo-oh toh-roo hee-tsuy-yooh-gah ah-ree-mahs
translation: 眼科の専門医の予約を取る必要があります。

english: I need to discuss your examination with another doctor.
transliteration: keh-sahng-nee tswee-teh, beh-tsu-noh ee-shee-toh soh-dahn-sroo hee-tsuy-yooh-gah ah-ree-mahs
translation: 検査について、別の医師と相談する必要があります。

english: We will use a professional interpreter to explain your results.
transliteration: keh-sahng-keh-kah-oh seh-tsu-meh-sroo tah-meh-nee, seh-mon-noh tsu-yoh-oh shee-mahs
translation: 検査結果を説明するために、専門の通訳を利用します。

english: If your vision suddenly worsens, seek urgent medical care.
transliteration: kyoo-nee mee-eh-nee-koo-koo nah-tah-bah-ee, soo-goo-nee ee-ryoh-kee-kahn-oh jyoo-sheen shee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 急に見えにくくなった場合は、すぐに医療機関を受診してください。

english: Do you have any questions?
transliteration: nah-nee-kah shee-tsoo-mon-wah ah-ree-mah-soo-kah
translation: 何か質問はありますか？

english: Hello, I am here to examine your ears, nose and throat.
transliteration: kohn-nee-chee-wah. mee-meh hah-nah noh-doh-oh sheen-sah-tsu shee-mahs
translation: こんにちは。耳、鼻、喉を診察します。

english: What problem brought you here today?
transliteration: kyoh-wah doh-noh-yoh-nah shoh-joh-deh koh-rah-reh-mah-shee-tah-kah
translation: 今日はどのような症状で来られましたか？

english: Please point to where you feel the problem.
transliteration: doh-koh-nee shoh-joh-gah ah-roo-kah, yoo-bee-deh shee-meh-shee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: どこに症状があるか、指で示してください。

english: Is it on the right, left, or both sides?
transliteration: mee-gee-gah-wah, hee-dah-ree-gah-wah, mah-tah-wah ryoh-gah-wah-noh doh-chee-rah-deh-soo-kah
translation: 右側、左側、または両側のどちらですか？

english: When did this start?
transliteration: ee-tsu hah-jih-mah-ree-mah-shee-tah-kah
translation: いつ始まりましたか？

english: Did it start suddenly or gradually?
transliteration: toh-tsu-zenn hah-jih-mah-ree-mah-shee-tah-kah, soh-reh-toh-moh joh-joh-nee hah-jih-mah-ree-mah-shee-tah-kah
translation: 突然始まりましたか、それとも徐々に始まりましたか？

english: How long has it been happening: hours, days, weeks, or months?
transliteration: ee-tsu-kah-rah tsoo-dzu-ee-teh-ee-mah-soo-kah? soo-oh-jih-kahn, soo-oh-nee-chee, soo-oh-shoo-kahn, soh-reh-toh-moh soo-oh-kah-tsu-deh-soo-kah
translation: いつから続いていますか？数時間、数日、数週間、それとも数か月ですか？

english: Is it getting better, worse, or staying the same?
transliteration: yoh-koo-nah-tteh-ee-mah-soo-kah, wah-roo-koo-nah-tteh-ee-mah-soo-kah, soh-reh-toh-moh kah-wah-ree-mah-sen-kah
translation: 良くなっていますか、悪くなっていますか、それとも変わりませんか？

english: Have you had this problem before?
transliteration: ee-zen-nee-moh oh-nah-jeh shoh-joh-gah ah-ree-mah-shee-tah-kah
translation: 以前にも同じ症状がありましたか？

english: Are you having trouble breathing or swallowing your saliva?
transliteration: ee-kee-oh shee-tah-ree, tsu-bah-oh noh-mee-kon-dah-ree-soo-roh-noh-gah meh-tah-deh-soo-kah
translation: 息をしたり、唾を飲み込んだりするのが難しいですか？

english: Are you having trouble hearing?
transliteration: kee-koh-eh-nee-koo-ee-deh-soo-kah
translation: 聞こえにくいですか？

english: Which ear is affected?
transliteration: doh-chee-rah-noh mee-mee-nee shoh-joh-gah ah-ree-mah-soo-kah
translation: どちらの耳に症状がありますか？

english: Did your hearing change suddenly?
transliteration: kee-koh-eh-kah-tah-gah kyoo-nee kah-wah-ree-mah-shee-tah-kah
translation: 聞こえ方が急に変わりましたか？

english: When was your hearing last normal?
transliteration: sah-ee-goh-nee foo-tsu-oo-nee kee-koh-eh-tah-noh-wah ee-tsu-deh-soo-kah
translation: 最後に普通に聞こえていたのはいつですか？

english: Is your hearing loss constant or does it come and go?
transliteration: kee-koh-eh-nee-koo-sah-wah zoo-ttoh tsoo-dzu-ee-teh-ee-mah-soo-kah, soh-reh-toh-moh yoh-koo-nah-tah-ree wah-roo-koo-nah-tah-ree shee-mah-soo-kah
translation: 聞こえにくさはずっと続いていますか、それとも良くなったり悪くなったりしますか？

english: Do you have trouble understanding speech, especially in noisy places?
transliteration: toh-koo-nee soo-gah-yah-kah-nah bah-shoh-deh, hee-toh-noh hah-nah-shee-gah kee-koh-toh-ree-nee-koo-ee-deh-soo-kah
translation: 特に騒がしい場所で、人の話が聞き取りにくいですか？

english: Do you use hearing aids?
transliteration: hoh-chee-khee-oh tsu-kah-tteh-ee-mah-soo-kah
translation: 補聴器を使っていますか？

english: Have you had a hearing test before?
transliteration: koh-reh-mah-deh-nee chee-ryoh-koo keh-sahng-oh oo-keh-tah-koh-toh-gah ah-ree-mah-soo-kah
translation: これまでに聴力検査を受けたことがありますか？

english: Have you been exposed to loud noise recently or at work?
transliteration: sah-ee-keen, mah-tah-wah shee-goh-toh-deh oh-kee-nah oh-toh-nee sah-rah-sheh-mah-shee-tah-kah
translation: 最近、または仕事で大きな音にさらされましたか？

english: Do you hear ringing, buzzing, or other sounds in your ears?
transliteration: mee-mee-nah-ree-yah boo-oon toh-ee-oo-oh-toh-nah-doh, mee-mee-noh nah-kah-deh oh-toh-gah kee-koh-eh-mah-soo-kah
translation: 耳鳴りやブーンという音など、耳の中で音が聞こえますか？

english: Is the sound in one ear or both ears?
transliteration: oh-toh-wah kah-tah-hoh-noh mee-mee-deh-soo-kah, soh-reh-toh-moh ryoh-hoh-noh mee-mee-deh-soo-kah
translation: 音は片方の耳ですか、それとも両方の耳ですか？

english: Is the sound constant or intermittent?
transliteration: oh-toh-wah zoo-ttoh tsoo-dzu-ee-teh-ee-mah-soo-kah, soh-reh-toh-moh toh-kee-doh-kee kee-koh-eh-mah-soo-kah
translation: 音はずっと続いていますか、それとも時々聞こえますか？

english: Does the sound beat in time with your heartbeat?
transliteration: soh-noh oh-toh-wah sheen-zoh-noh koh-doh-oh-nee ah-wah-seh-teh kee-koh-eh-mah-soo-kah
translation: その音は心臓の鼓動に合わせて聞こえますか？

english: Does the sound affect your sleep or daily activities?
transliteration: soh-noh oh-toh-deh neh-moo-ree-yah nee-chee-joh-seh-ee-kah-nee eh-kyoh-gah ah-ree-mah-soo-kah
translation: その音で眠りや日常生活に影響がありますか？

english: Does your ear feel blocked or under pressure?
transliteration: mee-mee-gah tsu-mah-tah kahn-jeh-yah, ah-tsu-pah-koo-sah-reh-roo kahn-jeh-gah ah-ree-mah-soo-kah
translation: 耳が詰まった感じや、圧迫される感じがありますか？

english: Does swallowing or yawning change the pressure?
transliteration: noh-mee-kon-dah-ree, ah-koo-bee-oh shee-tah-ree-soo-roh, ah-tsu-pah-koo-kahn-gah kah-wah-ree-mah-soo-kah
translation: 飲み込んだり、あくびをしたりすると、圧迫感が変わりますか？

english: Do you have ear pain?
transliteration: mee-mee-gah ee-tah-mee-mah-soo-kah
translation: 耳が痛みますか？

english: Does it hurt when you touch or pull your outer ear?
transliteration: mee-mee-noh soh-toh-gah-wah-nee tah-woo-eh-tah-ree, hee-pah-tah-ree-soo-roh, ee-tah-mee-mah-soo-kah
translation: 耳の外側に触れたり、引っ張ったりすると痛みますか？

english: Is fluid or pus coming out of your ear?
transliteration: mee-mee-kah-rah eh-kee-tah-ee-yah nooh-gah deh-teh-ee-mah-soo-kah
translation: 耳から液体や膿が出ていますか？

english: What colour is the discharge?
transliteration: deh-teh-ee-roo moh-noh-wah nah-nee-ee-roh-deh-soo-kah
translation: 出ているものは何色ですか？

english: Have you noticed blood coming from your ear?
transliteration: mee-mee-kah-rah chee-gah deh-tah koh-toh-nee kee-gah tsu-ee-tah-kah
translation: 耳から血が出たことに気づきましたか？

english: Do you have fever or swelling behind your ear?
transliteration: neh-tsu-gah ah-ree-mah-soo-kah? mee-mee-noh oo-shi-roh-gah hah-reh-teh-ee-mah-soo-kah
translation: 熱がありますか？耳の後ろが腫れていますか？

english: Have you recently been swimming or gotten water in your ear?
transliteration: sai-KIN, o-YON-da-ri, mi-mi-ni mi-zu-ga HA-it-ta-ri shi-MASH-ta-ka?
translation: 最近、泳いだり、耳に水が入ったりしましたか？

english: Do you use cotton swabs to clean your ears?
transliteration: mi-mi SOO-ji-ni MEN-bo-o tsu-KAT-te-i-MAS-ka?
translation: 耳掃除に綿棒を使っていますか？

english: Did anything get stuck in your ear?
transliteration: mi-mi-ni na-ni-ka-ga tsu-MA-ri-MASH-ta-ka?
translation: 耳に何かが詰まりましたか？

english: Have you had an injury or blow to your ear or head?
transliteration: mi-mi-ya a-ta-MA-o ke-ga-shi-ta-ri, bu-tsu-KAT-ta-ri shi-MASH-ta-ka?
translation: 耳や頭をけがしたり、ぶつけたりしましたか？

english: Do you feel dizzy or unsteady?
transliteration: me-MAI-ya, fu-ra-tsu-KI-ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: めまいや、ふらつきがありますか？

english: Does it feel as though you or the room is spinning?
transliteration: ji-BUN-ya ma-wa-ri-no he-YA-ga gu-ru-GU-ru MAWAT-te-i-ru yoo-ni kan-JI-MAS-ka?
translation: 自分や周りの部屋がぐるぐる回っているように感じますか？

english: How long does each episode last?
transliteration: me-MAI-wa i-KKAI-ni-tsu-ki, do-no-ku-RAI tsu-zu-KI-MAS-ka?
translation: めまいは一回につき、どのくらい続きますか？

english: Does turning your head or rolling over in bed trigger it?
transliteration: a-ta-MA-o u-GO-ka-shi-ta-ri, BED-do-de ne-GA-e-ri-o UT-ta-ri-su-ru-to, me-MAI-ga o-KI-MAS-ka?
translation: 頭を動かしたり、ベッドで寝返りを打ったりすると、めまいが起きますか？

english: Do you have nausea or vomiting with the dizziness?
transliteration: me-MAI-to is-SHO-ni ha-ki-KE-ya oo-TOO-ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: めまいと一緒に吐き気や嘔吐がありますか？

english: Do you also notice hearing loss, ringing, or ear fullness?
transliteration: ki-ko-e-ni-ku-sa, mi-MA-ri, mi-mi-ga tsu-MAT-ta kan-JI-mo a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 聞こえにくさ、耳鳴り、耳が詰まった感じもありますか？

english: Have you fainted, had weakness, double vision, or trouble speaking?
transliteration: KI-o u-shi-nat-ta-ri, chi-ka-ra-ga ha-i-ra-na-ku-nat-ta-ri, mo-no-ga NI-JUU-ni mi-e-ta-ri, ha-na-shi-ni-ku-ku-naT-ta-ri shi-MASH-ta-ka?
translation: 気を失ったり、力が入らなくなったり、物が二重に見えたり、話しにくくなったりしましたか？

english: Is your nose blocked or stuffy?
transliteration: ha-na-ga tsu-MAT-te-i-MAS-ka?
translation: 鼻が詰まっていますか？

english: Is one nostril blocked or both?
transliteration: ka-ta-HOO-no ha-na-no a-na-ga tsu-MAT-te-i-MAS-ka, so-re-to-mo RYOO-HOO des-ka?
translation: 片方の鼻の穴が詰まっていますか、それとも両方ですか？

english: Do you have a runny nose?
transliteration: ha-na-MI-zu-ga de-MAS-ka?
translation: 鼻水が出ますか？

english: What colour is the mucus?
transliteration: ha-na-MI-zu-wa na-ni-iro des-ka?
translation: 鼻水は何色ですか？

english: Do you have pain or pressure in your cheeks or forehead?
transliteration: ho-O ya hi-TI no i-ta-mi-ya a-TSU-kkan-ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 頬や額に痛みや圧迫感がありますか？

english: Does mucus drip down the back of your throat?
transliteration: ha-na-MI-zu-ga no-DO-no o-ku-ni na-ga-re-MAS-ka?
translation: 鼻水が喉の奥に流れますか？

english: Have you lost or noticed a change in your sense of smell?
transliteration: ni-o-i-ga wa-ka-ra-na-ku-nat-ta-ri, ka-NJI-ka-ta-ga ka-WAT-ta-ri shi-MASH-ta-ka?
translation: においが分からなくなったり、感じ方が変わったりしましたか？

english: Do you sneeze or have itchy, watery eyes?
transliteration: ku-sha-MI-ga de-ta-ri, ME-ga ka-yu-ku-nat-ta-ri, na-MI-da-ga de-ta-ri shi-MAS-ka?
translation: くしゃみが出たり、目がかゆくなったり、涙が出たりしますか？

english: Do you get sinus infections repeatedly?
transliteration: fu-ku-bi-KOO-en-o nan-DO-mo ku-ri-KAE-shi-te-i-MAS-ka?
translation: 副鼻腔炎を何度も繰り返していますか？

english: Have you had a recent cold or allergy symptoms?
transliteration: sai-KIN, ka-ZE-o hi-i-ta-ri, a-re-ru-GII-no shoo-JOO-ga de-ta-ri shi-MASH-ta-ka?
translation: 最近、風邪をひいたり、アレルギーの症状が出たりしましたか？

english: Have you had a nosebleed?
transliteration: ha-na-JI-ga de-MASH-ta-ka?
translation: 鼻血が出ましたか？

english: Which nostril is bleeding?
transliteration: do-chi-ra-no ha-na-no a-na-ka-ra chi-ga de-te-i-MAS-ka?
translation: どちらの鼻の穴から血が出ていますか？

english: How long does the bleeding usually last?
transliteration: ha-na-JI-wa i-tsu-mo do-no-ku-RAI tsu-zu-KI-MAS-ka?
translation: 鼻血はいつもどのくらい続きますか？

english: Is the bleeding heavy or difficult to stop?
transliteration: shuk-KET-su-wa oo-i des-ka? to-ma-ri-ni-ku-i des-ka?
translation: 出血は多いですか？止まりにくいですか？

english: Have you injured your nose recently?
transliteration: sai-KIN, ha-na-o ke-ga-shi-MASH-ta-ka?
translation: 最近、鼻をけがしましたか？

english: Are you taking blood thinners?
transliteration: chi-o sa-ra-SA-ra-ni su-ru ku-su-ri-o noN-de-i-MAS-ka?
translation: 血をサラサラにする薬を飲んでいますか？

english: Do you pick your nose or use nasal sprays?
transliteration: ha-na-o ho-ji-tat-ta-ri, TEN-bi-ya-ku-o tsu-KAT-ta-ri shi-MAS-ka?
translation: 鼻をほじったり、点鼻薬を使ったりしますか？

english: Do you have a sore throat?
transliteration: no-DO-ga i-TA-i des-ka?
translation: 喉が痛いですか？

english: Is swallowing painful?
transliteration: no-mi-KO-mu-to i-TA-i des-ka?
translation: 飲み込むと痛いですか？

english: Is it difficult to swallow solids, liquids, or both?
transliteration: KO-kei-bu-tsu-ya e-ki-tai, ma-ta-wa RYOO-HOO-o no-mi-KO-mi-ni-ku-i des-ka?
translation: 固形物や液体、または両方を飲み込みにくいですか？

english: Does food feel stuck in your throat?
transliteration: ta-be-MO-no-ga no-DO-ni tsu-MAT-ta kan-JI-ga shi-MAS-ka?
translation: 食べ物が喉に詰まった感じがしますか？

english: Do you cough or choke when eating or drinking?
transliteration: ta-be-ta-ri noN-da-ri-su-ru-to, se-ki-KO-n-da-ri, mu-se-ta-ri shi-MAS-ka?
translation: 食べたり飲んだりすると、せき込んだり、むせたりしますか？

english: Can you swallow your saliva?
transliteration: tsu-ba-o no-mi-KO-me-MAS-ka?
translation: 唾を飲み込めますか？

english: Do you have fever, swollen tonsils, or white patches in your throat?
transliteration: ne-tsu-ga a-ri-MAS-ka? hen-TOO-sen-ga ha-re-te-i-MAS-ka? no-DO-ni shi-ROI HAN-TEN-ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 熱がありますか？扁桃腺が腫れていますか？喉に白い斑点がありますか？

english: Have you had repeated tonsil infections?
transliteration: hen-TOO-sen-no kan-SEN-shoo-o nan-DO-mo ku-ri-KAE-shi-te-i-MAS-ka?
translation: 扁桃腺の感染症を何度も繰り返していますか？

english: Do you feel a lump or something stuck in your throat?
transliteration: no-DO-ni shi-KO-ri-ya, na-ni-ka-ga tsu-MAT-ta kan-JI-ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 喉にしこりや、何かが詰まった感じがありますか？

english: Has your voice become hoarse or changed?
transliteration: ko-e-ga ka-su-re-ta-ri, ka-WAT-ta-ri shi-MASH-ta-ka?
translation: 声がかすれたり、変わったりしましたか？

english: How long has your voice been different?
transliteration: ko-e-ga ka-WAT-te-ka-ra, do-no-ku-RAI ta-chi-MAS-ka?
translation: 声が変わってから、どのくらい経ちますか？

english: Have you completely lost your voice?
transliteration: mat-TAA-ku ko-e-ga de-na-ku-na-ri-MASH-ta-ka?
translation: まったく声が出なくなりましたか？

english: Do you have noisy breathing or difficulty breathing?
transliteration: ko-KYUU-su-ru-to o-TO-ga shi-ta-ri, i-ki-GU-ru-shi-kat-ta-ri shi-MAS-ka?
translation: 呼吸すると音がしたり、息苦しかったりしますか？

english: Do you snore loudly?
transliteration: oo-KI-na i-bi-ki-o ka-ki-MAS-ka?
translation: 大きないびきをかきますか？

english: Has anyone noticed you stop breathing during sleep?
transliteration: sui-MIN-chuu-ni ko-KYUU-ga to-MAT-te-i-ru-to, da-re-ka-ni i-wa-re-ta ko-to-ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 睡眠中に呼吸が止まっていると、誰かに言われたことがありますか？

english: Do you feel sleepy during the day?
transliteration: ni-CHUU-ni ne-mu-ku-na-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 日中に眠くなりますか？

english: Do you have persistent cough or acid reflux?
transliteration: se-ki-ga tsu-zu-i-ta-ri, i-san-ga gyak-RYUU-shi-ta-ri shi-MAS-ka?
translation: せきが続いたり、胃酸が逆流したりしますか？

english: Do you have pain or sores in your mouth?
transliteration: ku-chi-no na-ka-ni i-ta-mi-ya koo-NAI-en-ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 口の中に痛みや口内炎がありますか？

english: Do you have white or red patches in your mouth?
transliteration: ku-chi-no na-ka-ni shi-RO-ya a-ka-no HAN-TEN-ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 口の中に白や赤の斑点がありますか？

english: Do you have trouble opening your mouth?
transliteration: ku-chi-o a-ke-ni-ku-i des-ka?
translation: 口を開けにくいですか？

english: Do you have jaw pain or pain in front of your ear?
transliteration: a-go-ya mi-mi-no mae-ga i-ta-mi-MAS-ka?
translation: 顎や耳の前が痛みますか？

english: Does your jaw click or lock?
transliteration: a-go-o u-GO-ka-su-to o-TO-ga shi-ta-ri, u-GO-ka-na-ku-naT-ta-ri shi-MAS-ka?
translation: 顎を動かすと音がしたり、動かなくなったりしますか？

english: Does your mouth feel unusually dry?
transliteration: ku-chi-no na-ka-ga i-tsu-mo-yo-ri ka-wa-i-te-i-MAS-ka?
translation: 口の中がいつもより乾いていますか？

english: Do you have swelling under your jaw or near your ear?
transliteration: a-go-no shi-ta-ya mi-mi-no chi-ka-ku-ga ha-re-te-i-MAS-ka?
translation: 顎の下や耳の近くが腫れていますか？

english: Does the swelling or pain worsen when you eat?
transliteration: ta-be-ru-to ha-re-ya i-ta-mi-ga hi-do-ku-na-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 食べると腫れや痛みがひどくなりますか？

english: Have you noticed a change in your sense of taste?
transliteration: a-ji-no kan-JI-ka-ta-ga ka-WAT-ta ko-to-ni ki-zu-ki-MASH-ta-ka?
translation: 味の感じ方が変わったことに気づきましたか？

english: Have you noticed a lump or swelling in your neck?
transliteration: ku-bi-ni shi-KO-ri-ya ha-re-ga a-ru ko-to-ni ki-zu-ki-MASH-ta-ka?
translation: 首にしこりや腫れがあることに気づきましたか？

english: How long has the lump been there?
transliteration: so-no shi-KO-ri-wa i-tsu-ka-ra a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: そのしこりはいつからありますか？

english: Is the lump growing or painful?
transliteration: shi-KO-ri-wa oo-ki-ku-naT-te-i-MAS-ka? i-ta-mi-MAS-ka?
translation: しこりは大きくなっていますか？痛みますか？

english: Have you had unexplained weight loss or night sweats?
transliteration: gen-IN-no wa-ka-ra-na-i tai-JUU gen-SHOO-ya ne-a-se-ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 原因の分からない体重減少や寝汗がありますか？

english: Do you have persistent one-sided throat or ear pain?
transliteration: no-DO-ya mi-mi-no ka-ta-GA-wa-ni, i-ta-mi-ga tsu-zu-i-te-i-MAS-ka?
translation: 喉や耳の片側に、痛みが続いていますか？

english: Have you coughed up blood?
transliteration: se-ki-to is-SHO-ni chi-ga de-ta ko-to-ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: せきと一緒に血が出たことがありますか？

english: Do you smoke, vape, or use chewing tobacco?
transliteration: ta-BA-ko-o su-tat-ta-ri, den-SHI ta-BA-ko-o tsu-KAT-ta-ri, ka-mi ta-BA-ko-o tsu-KAT-ta-ri shi-MAS-ka?
translation: タバコを吸ったり、電子タバコを使ったり、噛みタバコを使ったりしますか？

english: Do you drink alcohol?
transliteration: o-SA-ke-o no-MI-MAS-ka?
translation: お酒を飲みますか？

english: Have you had ear, nose, or throat surgery?
transliteration: mi-mi, ha-na, no-DO-no shu-JUT-su-o u-ke-ta ko-to-ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 耳、鼻、喉の手術を受けたことがありますか？

english: Have you had ear infections or a perforated eardrum before?
transliteration: i-ZEN, mi-mi-no kan-SEN-shoo-ya ko-MA-ku-ni a-na-ga a-i-ta ko-to-ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 以前、耳の感染症や鼓膜に穴が開いたことがありますか？

english: Have you had your tonsils or adenoids removed?
transliteration: hen-TOO-sen-ya a-de-no-i-do-o to-ru shu-JUT-su-o u-ke-ta ko-to-ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 扁桃腺やアデノイドを取る手術を受けたことがありますか？

english: Have you had a CT scan, MRI, or hearing test?
transliteration: CT ken-SA, MRI ken-SA, ma-ta-wa choo-RYOKU ken-SA-o u-ke-ta ko-to-ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: CT検査、MRI検査、または聴力検査を受けたことがありますか？

english: What medications, drops, or sprays have you tried?
transliteration: ko-re-ma-de-ni don-na ku-su-ri-ya ten-JI-ya-ku, su-PU-RE-o ta-me-shi-MASH-ta-ka?
translation: これまでにどんな薬や点耳薬、スプレーを試しましたか？

english: How often and for how long have you used them?
transliteration: do-no-ku-RAI-no hin-DO-de, do-no-ku-RAI-no ki-KAN tsu-KAT-ta-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: どのくらいの頻度で、どのくらいの期間使いましたか？

english: Did the treatment help?
transliteration: chi-RYOO-wa ki-ki-MASH-ta-ka?
translation: 治療は効きましたか？

english: Are you allergic to any medications?
transliteration: ku-su-ri-de a-re-ru-GII-ga de-ta ko-to-ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 薬でアレルギーが出たことがありますか？

english: Is there a family history of hearing loss or head and neck cancer?
transliteration: go-ka-ZO-ku-ni nan-CHOO-ya too-KEI-bu-gan-ni nat-ta ka-ta-wa i-MAS-ka?
translation: ご家族に難聴や頭頸部がんになった方はいますか？

english: Please sit still. I am going to look inside your ear.
transliteration: u-GO-ka-zu-ni su-WAT-te-i-te-ku-da-sai. mi-mi-no na-ka-o mi-MAS.
translation: 動かずに座っていてください。耳の中を診ます。

english: Please remove your hearing aid.
transliteration: ho-choo-KI-o ha-zu-shi-te-ku-da-sai.
translation: 補聴器を外してください。

english: I will gently pull your ear to see inside.
transliteration: mi-mi-o sot-to hip-PAT-te, na-ka-o mi-MAS.
translation: 耳をそっと引っ張って、中を見ます。

english: Tell me if this hurts.
transliteration: i-ta-kat-ta-ra o-shi-e-te-ku-da-sai.
translation: 痛かったら教えてください。

english: I am going to check your hearing.
transliteration: choo-RYOKU-o shi-ra-be-MAS.
translation: 聴力を調べます。

english: Cover one ear and repeat the words you hear.
transliteration: ka-ta-HOO-no mi-mi-o fu-sai-de, ki-ko-e-ta ko-to-ba-o ku-ri-KAE-shi-te-ku-da-sai.
translation: 片方の耳をふさいで、聞こえた言葉を繰り返してください。

english: Tell me whether you hear the tuning fork on the left, right, or in the middle.
transliteration: on-SA-no o-TO-ga hi-DA-ri, mi-GI, maN-NA-ka-no do-ko-de ki-ko-e-ru-ka o-shi-e-te-ku-da-sai.
translation: 音叉の音が左、右、真ん中のどこで聞こえるか教えてください。

english: Tell me when you can no longer hear the sound.
transliteration: o-TO-ga ki-ko-e-na-ku-nat-ta-ra o-shi-e-te-ku-da-sai.
translation: 音が聞こえなくなったら教えてください。

english: I am going to examine your eardrum.
transliteration: ko-MA-ku-o shin-SATSU-shi-MAS.
translation: 鼓膜を診察します。

english: I am going to examine your nose.
transliteration: ha-na-o shin-SATSU-shi-MAS.
translation: 鼻を診察します。

english: Please breathe through your nose.
transliteration: ha-na-de ko-KYUU-shi-te-ku-da-sai.
translation: 鼻で呼吸してください。

english: Close one nostril and breathe through the other.
transliteration: ka-ta-HOO-no ha-na-no a-na-o o-sa-e-te, moo-KA-ta-de ko-KYUU-shi-te-ku-da-sai.
translation: 片方の鼻の穴を押さえて、もう片方で呼吸してください。

english: Open your mouth wide, please.
transliteration: ku-chi-o oo-ki-ku a-ke-te-ku-da-sai.
translation: 口を大きく開けてください。

english: Stick out your tongue, please.
transliteration: shi-TA-o da-shi-te-ku-da-sai.
translation: 舌を出してください。

english: Say “ah,” please.
transliteration: aA-to it-te-ku-da-sai.
translation: 「あー」と言ってください。

english: Move your tongue from side to side.
transliteration: shi-TA-o sa-YUU-ni u-GO-ka-shi-te-ku-da-sai.
translation: 舌を左右に動かしてください。

english: I am going to feel your neck for any lumps.
transliteration: ku-bi-ni shi-KO-ri-ga na-i-ka sa-wat-te ta-shi-ka-me-MAS.
translation: 首にしこりがないか触って確かめます。

english: Please swallow once.
transliteration: i-CHI-do tsu-ba-o no-mi-KO-n-de-ku-da-sai.
translation: 一度つばを飲み込んでください。

english: Turn your head to the left, then to the right.
transliteration: a-ta-MA-o hi-DA-ri-ni mu-ke-te-ka-ra, mi-GI-ni mu-ke-te-ku-da-sai.
translation: 頭を左に向けてから、右に向けてください。

english: We may need a formal hearing test.
transliteration: sei-SHI-ki-na choo-RYOKU ken-SA-ga hi-TSU-yoo-ni na-ru ba-AA-i-ga a-ri-MAS.
translation: 正式な聴力検査が必要になる場合があります。

english: We may need a camera examination of your nose or throat.
transliteration: ha-na-ya no-DO-o ka-me-RA-de shi-ra-be-ru ken-SA-ga hi-TSU-yoo-ni na-ru ba-AA-i-ga a-ri-MAS.
translation: 鼻や喉をカメラで調べる検査が必要になる場合があります。

english: I will gently pass a small flexible camera through your nose.
transliteration: ho-so-ku-te ya-wa-ra-ka-i ka-me-RA-o ha-na-ka-ra yu-kku-ri i-re-MAS.
translation: 細くて柔らかいカメラを鼻からゆっくり入れます。

english: You may feel pressure or discomfort, but tell me if it is painful.
transliteration: atsu-KAN-ya fu-ka-i-kan-ga a-ru-ka-mo shi-re-MAS-en-ga, i-ta-ka-re-ba o-shi-e-te-ku-da-sai.
translation: 圧迫感や不快感があるかもしれませんが、痛ければ教えてください。

english: We may need a CT scan or MRI to look more closely.
transliteration: ku-wa-shi-ku shi-ra-be-ru ta-me-ni, CT ken-SA-ya MRI ken-SA-ga hi-TSU-yoo-ni na-ru ba-AA-i-ga a-ri-MAS.
translation: 詳しく調べるために、CT検査やMRI検査が必要になる場合があります。

english: We may need to take a small sample of tissue for testing.
transliteration: ken-SA-no ta-me-ni, so-shi-KI-o su-ko-shi to-ru hi-TSU-yoo-ga a-ru ba-AA-i-ga a-ri-MAS.
translation: 検査のために、組織を少し採る必要がある場合があります。

english: I am going to remove some earwax if it is safe to do so.
transliteration: an-ZEN-ni de-ki-ru ba-AA-i-wa, mi-mi-a-ka-o to-ri-no-zo-KI-MAS.
translation: 安全にできる場合は、耳あかを取り除きます。

english: Please use the medicine exactly as prescribed.
transliteration: ku-su-ri-wa sho-HOO-sa-re-ta-too-ri-ni tsu-KAT-te-ku-da-sai.
translation: 薬は処方されたとおりに使ってください。

english: I will prescribe ear drops or a nasal spray if needed.
transliteration: hi-TSU-yoo-ni oo-ji-te, ten-JI-ya-ku-ka ha-na-no su-PU-RE-o sho-HOO-shi-MAS.
translation: 必要に応じて、点耳薬か鼻のスプレーを処方します。

english: Keep your ear dry until we tell you otherwise.
transliteration: be-tsu-no shi-JI-ga a-ru-ma-de, mi-mi-o nu-ra-sa-na-i-de-ku-da-sai.
translation: 別の指示があるまで、耳を濡らさないでください。

english: Do not put cotton swabs or other objects inside your ear.
transliteration: MEN-boo-na-do-o mi-mi-no na-ka-ni i-re-na-i-de-ku-da-sai.
translation: 綿棒などを耳の中に入れないでください。

english: If you have sudden hearing loss, seek urgent medical care.
transliteration: tootsu-ZEN ki-ko-e-ni-ku-ku-nat-ta ba-AA-i-wa, su-gu-ni i-RYOO-ki-kan-o ju-shin-shi-te-ku-da-sai.
translation: 突然聞こえにくくなった場合は、すぐに医療機関を受診してください。

english: If you have severe trouble breathing or cannot swallow saliva, seek emergency care.
transliteration: i-ki-o su-ru-no-ga hi-do-ku ku-ru-shi-i ba-AA-i-ya, tsu-ba-o no-mi-KO-me-na-i ba-AA-i-wa, kyuu-KYUU-o ju-shin-shi-te-ku-da-sai.
translation: 息をするのがひどく苦しい場合や、つばを飲み込めない場合は、救急を受診してください。

english: We will arrange an appointment with an ENT specialist.
transliteration: ji-bi-in-koo-KA-no sen-MON-i-no yo-ya-ku-o te-ha-i-shi-MAS.
translation: 耳鼻咽喉科の専門医の予約を手配します。

english: We will use a professional interpreter to discuss results and treatment.
transliteration: ken-SA-keK-ka-to chi-RYOO-ni-tsu-i-te ha-na-shi-a-u ta-me, sen-MON-no tsuu-YAKU-o te-ha-i-shi-MAS.
translation: 検査結果と治療について話し合うため、専門の通訳を手配します。

english: The examination is finished. Thank you.
transliteration: shin-SATSU-wa o-wa-ri-MASH-ta. a-ri-ga-too-go-ZAI-MASH-ta.
translation: 診察は終わりました。ありがとうございます。

english: I am going to examine your skin.
transliteration: hi-FU-o shin-SATSU-shi-MAS.
translation: 皮膚を診察します。

english: What brings you in today?
transliteration: kyoo-wa doo-sa-re-MASH-ta-ka?
translation: 今日はどうされましたか？

english: Please show me the affected area.
transliteration: ki-ni-na-ru bu-BUN-o mi-se-te-ku-da-sai.
translation: 気になる部分を見せてください。

english: May I examine this area?
transliteration: ko-no bu-BUN-o mi-te-mo yo-ro-shii des-ka?
translation: この部分を診てもよろしいですか？

english: Is it okay if I take a photograph for your medical record?
transliteration: shin-RYOO ki-RO-ku-yo-o-ni sha-SHIN-o tot-te-mo yo-ro-shii des-ka?
translation: 診療記録用に写真を撮ってもよろしいですか？

english: When did you first notice this skin problem?
transliteration: ko-no hi-FU-no shoo-JOO-ni sai-SHO-ni ki-zu-i-ta-no-wa i-tsu des-ka?
translation: この皮膚の症状に最初に気づいたのはいつですか？

english: How long have you had it?
transliteration: do-no-ku-RAI mae-ka-ra a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: どのくらい前からありますか？

english: Did it appear suddenly or gradually?
transliteration: kyuu-ni de-MASH-ta-ka, so-re-to-mo jo-JO-ni de-MASH-ta-ka?
translation: 急に出ましたか、それとも徐々に出ましたか？

english: Where did it first appear?
transliteration: sai-SHO-ni do-ko-ni de-MASH-ta-ka?
translation: 最初にどこに出ましたか？

english: Has it spread to other areas?
transliteration: ho-ka-no bu-BUN-ni-mo hi-ro-ga-ri-MASH-ta-ka?
translation: ほかの部分にも広がりましたか？

english: Is it getting better, worse, or staying the same?
transliteration: yo-ku-nat-te-i-MAS-ka, wa-ru-ku-nat-te-i-MAS-ka, so-re-to-mo ka-wa-ri-MAS-en-ka?
translation: 良くなっていますか、悪くなっていますか、それとも変わりませんか？

english: Does it come and go or stay all the time?
transliteration: de-ta-ri ki-e-ta-ri shi-MAS-ka, so-re-to-mo zuT-to tsu-zu-i-te-i-MAS-ka?
translation: 出たり消えたりしますか、それともずっと続いていますか？

english: Have you had this before?
transliteration: i-ZEN-ni-mo nat-ta ko-to-ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 以前にもなったことがありますか？

english: How long does each episode last?
transliteration: shoo-JOO-wa i-KKAI-ni-tsu-ki, do-no-ku-RAI tsu-zu-KI-MAS-ka?
translation: 症状は一回につき、どのくらい続きますか？

english: Is it happening more often now?
transliteration: sai-KIN, o-ko-ru hin-DO-ga fu-e-te-i-MAS-ka?
translation: 最近、起こる頻度が増えていますか？

english: Where on your body is the rash?
transliteration: hos-SHIN-wa ka-ra-DA-no do-ko-ni a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 発疹は体のどこにありますか？

english: Is it on one side or both sides?
transliteration: ka-ta-GA-wa-da-ke des-ka, so-re-to-mo RYOO-GA-WA des-ka?
translation: 片側だけですか、それとも両側ですか？

english: Is it on your face or scalp?
transliteration: ka-O-ya too-HI-ni-mo a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 顔や頭皮にもありますか？

english: Is it on your hands, palms, or between your fingers?
transliteration: TE-ya te-no-hi-ra, yu-bi-no a-i-da-ni-mo a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 手や手のひら、指の間にもありますか？

english: Is it on your feet, soles, or between your toes?
transliteration: a-shi-ya a-shi-no u-ra, a-shi-no yu-bi-no a-i-da-ni-mo a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 足や足の裏、足の指の間にもありますか？

english: Is it in your armpits or groin?
transliteration: wa-ki-no-shi-ta-ya ma-ta-ni-mo a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 脇の下や股にもありますか？

english: Is it around your genitals or anus?
transliteration: sei-KI-ya koo-MON-no ma-wa-ri-ni-mo a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 性器や肛門の周りにもありますか？

english: Are the spots flat or raised?
transliteration: hos-SHIN-wa tai-ra des-ka, so-re-to-mo mo-ri-a-gat-te-i-MAS-ka?
translation: 発疹は平らですか、それとも盛り上がっていますか？

english: Are there blisters or fluid-filled bumps?
transliteration: mi-zu-bu-ku-re-ya, e-ki-tai-no haiT-ta bu-tsu-bu-tsu-wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 水ぶくれや、液体の入ったぶつぶつはありますか？

english: Is there scaling, flaking, or crusting?
transliteration: hi-FU-ga u-ro-ko-JOO-ni nat-ta-ri, ka-wa-ga mu-ke-ta-ri, ka-sa-bu-ta-ga de-ki-ta-ri shi-te-i-MAS-ka?
translation: 皮膚がうろこ状になったり、皮がむけたり、かさぶたができたりしていますか？

english: Are the spots circular or ring-shaped?
transliteration: hos-SHIN-wa ma-ru-i ka-ta-chi-ya wa-no ka-ta-chi-o shi-te-i-MAS-ka?
translation: 発疹は丸い形や輪の形をしていますか？

english: Has the colour or size changed?
transliteration: i-ro-ya oo-ki-sa-ga ka-WAT-ta-ri shi-MASH-ta-ka?
translation: 色や大きさが変わりましたか？

english: Is the skin cracked or peeling?
transliteration: hi-FU-ni hi-bi-wa-re-ya ka-wa-mu-ke-ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 皮膚にひび割れや皮むけがありますか？

english: Does it itch?
transliteration: ka-yu-MI-ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: かゆみがありますか？

english: Where does it itch the most?
transliteration: do-ko-ga i-CHI-ban ka-yu-i des-ka?
translation: どこが一番かゆいですか？

english: Is the itching worse at night?
transliteration: yo-ru-ni ka-yu-MI-ga tsu-yo-ku-na-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 夜にかゆみが強くなりますか？

english: Does the itching wake you from sleep?
transliteration: ka-yu-MI-de me-ga sa-me-MAS-ka?
translation: かゆみで目が覚めますか？

english: Does scratching make it worse?
transliteration: ka-ku-to, hi-do-ku-na-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: かくと、ひどくなりますか？

english: Does anything relieve the itching?
transliteration: ka-yu-MI-o ya-wa-ra-ge-ru mo-no-wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: かゆみを和らげるものはありますか？

english: Is it painful, tender, or burning?
transliteration: i-ta-MI-ya sa-wa-ru-to i-ta-i kan-JI, hi-ri-hi-ri-su-ru kan-JI-wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 痛みや触ると痛い感じ、ヒリヒリする感じはありますか？

english: Does the skin feel hot to touch?
transliteration: sa-wa-ru-to hi-FU-ga a-ta-ta-ka-ku kan-JI-MAS-ka?
translation: 触ると皮膚が熱く感じますか？

english: How severe is the pain from zero to ten?
transliteration: i-ta-MI-wa ze-RO-ka-ra JUU-de, do-no-ku-RAI tsu-yo-i des-ka?
translation: 痛みは0から10で、どのくらい強いですか？

english: Is the pain only when touched or also at rest?
transliteration: i-ta-MI-wa sa-wat-ta-to-ki-da-ke des-ka, so-re-to-mo na-ni-mo shi-te-i-na-i-to-ki-mo a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 痛みは触ったときだけですか、それとも何もしていないときもありますか？

english: Do you have a fever or chills?
transliteration: ne-tsu-ya sa-mu-ke-wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 熱や寒気はありますか？

english: Is the redness spreading quickly?
transliteration: a-ka-mi-wa kyuu-ni hi-ro-gat-te-i-MAS-ka?
translation: 赤みは急に広がっていますか？

english: Is there pus, drainage, or a bad smell?
transliteration: u-mi-ya e-ki-ga de-ta-ri, iya-na ni-o-i-ga shi-ta-ri shi-MAS-ka?
translation: 膿や液が出たり、嫌なにおいがしたりしますか？

english: Are there painful blisters?
transliteration: i-ta-MI-no a-ru mi-zu-bu-ku-re-wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 痛みのある水ぶくれはありますか？

english: Do you feel generally unwell?
transliteration: zen-TAI-te-ki-ni tai-CHOO-ga wa-ru-i-to kan-JI-MAS-ka?
translation: 全体的に体調が悪いと感じますか？

english: Is the rash near your eye or affecting your vision?
transliteration: hos-SHIN-wa me-no chi-ka-ku-ni a-ri-MAS-ka, so-re-to-mo mi-e-ka-ta-ni ee-kyoo-shi-te-i-MAS-ka?
translation: 発疹は目の近くにありますか、それとも見え方に影響していますか？

english: Do you have sores inside your mouth or on your genitals?
transliteration: ku-chi-no na-ka-ya sei-KI-ni de-KI-mo-no-wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 口の中や性器にできものはありますか？

english: Are you having trouble breathing or swelling of your lips or tongue?
transliteration: i-ki-gu-ru-shi-sa-ya, ku-chi-bi-ru ma-ta-wa shi-TA-no ha-re-wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 息苦しさや、唇または舌の腫れはありますか？

english: Have you started any new medication recently?
transliteration: sai-KIN, a-ta-ra-shii ku-su-ri-o tsu-ka-i-ha-ji-me-MASH-ta-ka?
translation: 最近、新しい薬を使い始めましたか？

english: Have you used any new soap, detergent, cream, or cosmetic?
transliteration: a-ta-ra-shii se-KEN, sen-ZAI, KURII-mu, ke-shoo-HIN-o tsu-ka-i-MASH-ta-ka?
translation: 新しい石けん、洗剤、クリーム、化粧品を使いましたか？

english: Does it worsen after sun exposure?
transliteration: niK-KOO-ni a-taT-ta a-to-ni a-ku-AK-ka-shi-MAS-ka?
translation: 日光に当たった後に悪化しますか？

english: Does heat, sweating, or exercise make it worse?
transliteration: a-tsu-sa, a-se, un-DOO-de a-ku-AK-ka-shi-MAS-ka?
translation: 暑さ、汗、運動で悪化しますか？

english: Does cold weather or water trigger it?
transliteration: sa-mu-i ten-KOO-ya mi-zu-ga kiK-KA-ke-ni na-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 寒い天気や水がきっかけになりますか？

english: Does it happen after certain foods?
transliteration: to-ku-TEI-no ta-be-MO-no-o ta-be-ta a-to-ni o-ko-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 特定の食べ物を食べた後に起こりますか？

english: Have you travelled recently?
transliteration: sai-KIN, ryok-KOO-shi-MASH-ta-ka?
translation: 最近、旅行しましたか？

english: Have you been bitten by an insect or tick?
transliteration: mu-shi-ya da-ni-ni sa-sa-re-MASH-ta-ka?
translation: 虫やダニに刺されましたか？

english: Have you been around anyone with a similar rash or itching?
transliteration: ni-ta-yoo-na hos-SHIN-ya ka-yu-MI-no a-ru hi-to-to is-SHO-ni i-MASH-ta-ka?
translation: 似たような発疹やかゆみのある人と一緒にいましたか？

english: Are there pets or animals at home?
transliteration: ie-ni PET-to-ya doo-BU-tsu-wa i-MAS-ka?
translation: 家にペットや動物はいますか？

english: Are you exposed to chemicals or irritants at work?
transliteration: shi-GO-to-de ka-GA-ku bu-SSHITSU-ya shi-ge-ki-ni na-ru mo-no-ni fu-re-ru ko-to-ga a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 仕事で化学物質や刺激になるものに触れることがありますか？

english: How long have you had this mole?
transliteration: ko-no ho-ku-ro-wa i-tsu-ka-ra a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: このほくろは、いつからありますか？

english: Has this mole changed in size, shape, or colour?
transliteration: ko-no ho-ku-ro-no oo-ki-sa, ka-ta-chi, i-ro-ni heN-KA-wa a-ri-MASH-ta-ka?
translation: このほくろの大きさ、形、色に変化はありましたか？

english: Does the mole bleed, itch, or hurt?
transliteration: ho-ku-ro-ka-ra shuk-KET-su-shi-ta-ri, ka-yu-ku-nat-ta-ri, i-ta-ku-nat-ta-ri shi-MAS-ka?
translation: ほくろから出血したり、かゆくなったり、痛くなったりしますか？

english: Has the mole developed an irregular border?
transliteration: ho-ku-ro-no fu-CHI-ga fu-ki-soo-ni nat-te-ki-MASH-ta-ka?
translation: ほくろの縁が不規則になってきましたか？

english: Have you noticed a new or unusual mole?
transliteration: a-ta-ra-shii ho-ku-ro-ya, i-tsu-mo-to chi-ga-u ho-ku-ro-ni ki-zu-ki-MASH-ta-ka?
translation: 新しいほくろや、いつもと違うほくろに気づきましたか？

english: Have you ever had skin cancer or melanoma?
transliteration: hi-FU-gan-ya me-ra-NOO-ma-ni nat-ta ko-to-wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 皮膚がんやメラノーマになったことはありますか？

english: Has anyone in your family had melanoma or skin cancer?
transliteration: go-ka-ZO-ku-ni me-ra-NOO-ma-ya hi-FU-gan-ni nat-ta hi-to-wa i-MAS-ka?
translation: ご家族にメラノーマや皮膚がんになった人はいますか？

english: Have you had frequent sunburns, especially in childhood?
transliteration: to-ku-ni ko-do-mo-no ko-ro, hi-ya-ke-de ha-da-ga a-ka-ku-na-ru ko-to-ga nan-DO-mo a-ri-MASH-ta-ka?
translation: 特に子どもの頃、日焼けで肌が赤くなることが何度もありましたか？

english: Do you use sunscreen or protective clothing?
transliteration: hi-ya-ke-do-me-o tsu-KAT-ta-ri, ha-da-o ma-mo-ru fu-ku-o ki-ta-ri shi-te-i-MAS-ka?
translation: 日焼け止めを使ったり、肌を守る服を着たりしていますか？

english: Have you used tanning beds?
transliteration: hi-ya-ke ma-SHI-n-o tsu-KAT-ta ko-to-wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 日焼けマシンを使ったことはありますか？

english: Have you ever had eczema?
transliteration: shis-SHIN-ni nat-ta ko-to-wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 湿疹になったことはありますか？

english: Have you ever had psoriasis?
transliteration: kan-SEN-ni nat-ta ko-to-wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 乾癬になったことはありますか？

english: Have you had acne or pimples?
transliteration: ni-KI-bi-ya fu-ki-de-mo-no-ga de-ki-ta ko-to-wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: にきびや吹き出物ができたことはありますか？

english: Have you had hives or raised itchy welts?
transliteration: jin-MA-shin-ya, mo-ri-a-gat-ta ka-yu-i hos-SHIN-ga de-ta ko-to-wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: じんましんや、盛り上がったかゆい発疹が出たことはありますか？

english: Have you had a fungal skin infection?
transliteration: hi-FU-no shin-KIN-kan-SEN-shoo-ni nat-ta ko-to-wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 皮膚の真菌感染症になったことはありますか？

english: Have you had warts?
transliteration: i-bo-ga de-ki-ta ko-to-wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: いぼができたことはありますか？

english: Have you had shingles?
transliteration: tai-JOO-hoo-shin-ni nat-ta ko-to-wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 帯状疱疹になったことはありますか？

english: Have you had scabies?
transliteration: kai-SEN-ni nat-ta ko-to-wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 疥癬になったことはありますか？

english: Have you had head lice?
transliteration: a-ta-ma-ji-ra-mi-ni nat-ta ko-to-wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 頭じらみになったことはありますか？

english: Have you had cold sores around your lips?
transliteration: ku-chi-bi-ru-no ma-wa-ri-ni koo-shin heru-PESU-ga de-ki-ta ko-to-wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 唇の周りに口唇ヘルペスができたことはありますか？

english: Do you have very dry or sensitive skin?
transliteration: ha-da-ga to-te-mo kaN-soo-shi-ta-ri, bin-KAN-dat-ta-ri shi-MAS-ka?
translation: 肌がとても乾燥したり、敏感だったりしますか？

english: Have you noticed hair loss or thinning?
transliteration: ka-mi-ga nu-ke-ta-ri, u-su-ku-nat-ta-ri shi-ta ko-to-ni ki-zu-ki-MASH-ta-ka?
translation: 髪が抜けたり、薄くなったりしたことに気づきましたか？

english: Is the hair loss in patches or all over?
transliteration: ka-mi-wa bu-BUN-te-ki-ni nu-ke-te-i-MAS-ka, so-re-to-mo zen-TAI-te-ki-ni nu-ke-te-i-MAS-ka?
translation: 髪は部分的に抜けていますか、それとも全体的に抜けていますか？

english: Is your scalp itchy, painful, or flaky?
transliteration: too-HI-ni ka-yu-MI-ya i-ta-MI, FU-ke-wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 頭皮にかゆみや痛み、フケはありますか？

english: Have your nails changed colour or shape?
transliteration: tsu-me-no i-ro-ya ka-ta-chi-ni heN-KA-wa a-ri-MASH-ta-ka?
translation: 爪の色や形に変化はありましたか？

english: Are your nails thickened, brittle, or separating from the skin?
transliteration: tsu-me-ga a-tsu-ku-nat-ta-ri, mo-ro-ku-nat-ta-ri, hi-FU-ka-ra ha-ga-re-ta-ri shi-te-i-MAS-ka?
translation: 爪が厚くなったり、もろくなったり、皮膚からはがれたりしていますか？

english: Do you have any allergies?
transliteration: a-re-ru-GII-wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: アレルギーはありますか？

english: Do you have asthma or seasonal allergies?
transliteration: zen-so-ku-ya ki-SETSU-sei-no a-re-ru-GII-wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 喘息や季節性のアレルギーはありますか？

english: Do you have diabetes or a condition affecting your immune system?
transliteration: too-NYOO-byo-o-ya men-eki-ni ee-kyoo-su-ru byo-KI-wa a-ri-MAS-ka?
translation: 糖尿病や免疫に影響する病気はありますか？

english: Does anyone in your family have eczema, psoriasis, or similar skin problems?
transliteration: go-ka-ZO-ku-ni shis-SHIN, kan-SEN, ma-ta-wa ni-ta-yoo-na hi-FU-no mon-DAI-ga a-ru hi-to-wa i-MAS-ka?
translation: ご家族に湿疹、乾癬、または似たような皮膚の問題がある人はいますか？

english: Are you pregnant or breastfeeding?
transliteration: nin-SHIN-chuu des-ka, ma-ta-wa ju-NYUU-chuu des-ka?
translation: 妊娠中ですか、または授乳中ですか？

english: What medicines and supplements do you take?
transliteration: do-no-yoo-na ku-su-ri-ya sa-PU-ri-men-to-o non-de-i-MAS-ka?
translation: どのような薬やサプリメントを飲んでいますか？

english: Have you tried any treatment for this problem?
transliteration: ko-no shoo-JOO-ni na-ni-ka chi-RYOO-o ta-me-shi-MASH-ta-ka?
translation: この症状に何か治療を試しましたか？

english: What cream, lotion, or medicine have you used?
transliteration: do-no KURII-mu, ro-o-SHON, ku-su-ri-o tsu-ka-i-MASH-ta-ka?
translation: どのクリーム、ローション、薬を使いましたか？

english: How often do you apply it?
transliteration: do-no-ku-RAI-no hin-DO-de nuT-te-i-MAS-ka?
translation: どのくらいの頻度で塗っていますか？

english: How long have you been using it?
transliteration: do-no-ku-RAI-no ki-KAN tsu-KAT-te-i-MAS-ka?
translation: どのくらいの期間使っていますか？

english: When did you last use it?
transliteration: sai-GO-ni tsu-KAT-ta-no-wa i-tsu des-ka?
translation: 最後に使ったのはいつですか？

english: Did it help or make the problem worse?
transliteration: kee-kee-ma-shee-ta-ka, so-re-to-mo show-jow-ga ah-kah-koo-ka-shee-ma-shee-ta-ka
translation: 効きましたか、それとも症状が悪化しましたか？

english: Have you used a steroid or cortisone cream?
transliteration: ste-ro-i-do yah ko-ree-zon-no koo-ree-moo-o tsu-kat-ta ko-to-wah ah-ree-mah-ska
translation: ステロイドやコルチゾンのクリームを使ったことはありますか？

english: Did you stop any treatment? Why?
transliteration: chee-ryow-o yah-meh-ma-shee-ta-ka? ree-yoo-wah nahn-des-ka
translation: 治療をやめましたか？理由は何ですか？

english: Have you seen a dermatologist for this before?
transliteration: ee-zhen, ko-no show-jow-deh hee-fu-ka-o zhoo-shin-shi-ta ko-to-wah ah-ree-mah-ska
translation: 以前、この症状で皮膚科を受診したことはありますか？

english: Please roll up your sleeves.
transliteration: so-deh-o mah-kut-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 袖をまくってください。

english: Please turn around so I can examine your back.
transliteration: seh-nah-kah-o mee-mah-sno-deh, koh-cho-o moo-ee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 背中を診ますので、後ろを向いてください。

english: I am going to examine your scalp and nails.
transliteration: toh-hee-toh tsu-meh-o mee-mah-s
translation: 頭皮と爪を診ます。

english: I am going to look at this with a magnifying light.
transliteration: kah-koo-dye-kyow-no ts-ee-tah ree-gah-ee-deh, ko-ko-o mee-mah-s
translation: 拡大鏡のついたライトで、ここを見ます。

english: We may need to take a small skin sample (biopsy).
transliteration: heh-foo-no ee-chee-bo-o soo-khoo-shi-toot-teh shee-rah-beh-roo (see-ken) hee-ts-yo-ga ah-roo-kah-mo-sheh-reh-mah-sen
translation: 皮膚の一部を少し採って調べる（生検）必要があるかもしれません。

english: We may take a skin scraping to test for fungus.
transliteration: sheen-kin-gah ee-nigh-kah shee-rah-beh-roo tah-meh-nee, heh-foo-o soo-khoo-shi-too-roo ko-to-gah ah-ree-mah-s
translation: 真菌がいないか調べるために、皮膚を少しこすり取ることがあります。

english: We may take a sample from your nail.
transliteration: tsu-meh-no ee-chee-bo-o toh-roo ko-to-gah ah-ree-mah-s
translation: 爪の一部を採ることがあります。

english: I am going to clean the area first.
transliteration: mah-zoo, ko-no boo-bun-o show-dokoo-shee-ma-s
translation: まず、この部分を消毒します。

english: You may feel a small pinch.
transliteration: soo-koo-chee-koot-toh soo-roo-kah-mo-sheh-reh-mah-sen
translation: 少しチクッとするかもしれません。

english: I will prescribe a cream or ointment.
transliteration: koo-ree-moo-kah koh-nan-o show-hoo-shee-ma-s
translation: クリームか軟膏を処方します。

english: Apply a thin layer to the affected skin.
transliteration: show-jow-no ah-roo heh-foo-nee oo-skoo-noh-t-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 症状のある皮膚に薄く塗ってください。

english: How many times a day were you told to apply it?
transliteration: ee-chee-nee nahn-kye noo-roo-yoh-nee ee-wah-reh-ma-shee-ta-ka
translation: 1日に何回塗るように言われましたか？

english: For how many days were you told to use it?
transliteration: nahn-nee-chee-kan tsu-koo-yoh-nee ee-wah-reh-ma-shee-ta-ka
translation: 何日間使うように言われましたか？

english: Avoid scratching or picking the skin.
transliteration: heh-foo-o kah-ee-tah-ree, ee-zhit-tah-ree shee-nigh-deh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 皮膚をかいたり、いじったりしないでください。

english: Use a gentle, fragrance-free moisturizer.
transliteration: koh-ryow-no hah-ee-t-teh ee-nigh, hah-dah-nee yah-shee-ee ho-shits-za-ee-o tsu-kat-teh koo-dah-sigh
