translation: 香料の入っていない、肌にやさしい保湿剤を使ってください。

english: Keep the area clean and dry.
transliteration: kahn-bu-o seh-kee-tsu-nee tah-mot-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 患部を清潔で乾いた状態に保ってください。

english: Avoid the product that seems to trigger the rash.
transliteration: how-shin-no geh-ee-toh oh-moh-wah-reh-roo seh-ee-heen-wah tsu-kah-wah-nigh-deh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 発疹の原因と思われる製品は使わないでください。

english: Use sunscreen and protect your skin from the sun.
transliteration: hee-yah-keh-do-meh-o tsu-kah-ee, nee-koo-kah-rah hah-dah-o mah-mo-t-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 日焼け止めを使い、日光から肌を守ってください。

english: The examination is finished. Thank you.
transliteration: sheen-sah-wa oh-wah-ree-ma-shee-ta. ah-ree-gah-toh-go-zah-ee-ma-shee-ta
translation: 診察は終わりました。ありがとうございました。

english: We will arrange a follow-up appointment.
transliteration: ts-gee-kye-no shee-shin-no yo-yah-koo-o teh-ha-ee-shee-ma-s
translation: 次回の診察の予約を手配します。

english: Please return if the rash worsens or spreads.
transliteration: how-shin-gah ah-koo-nah-tah-ree, hee-roh-gah-tah-ree-shee-tah-rah, mah-tah zhoo-shin-shee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 発疹が悪化したり広がったりしたら、また受診してください。

english: Seek urgent medical care if you have trouble breathing or rapidly worsening symptoms.
transliteration: ee-kee-goo-roo-shee-sah-gah ah-roo bah-ee-yah, sho-jow-gah kyu-nee ah-koo-nah-tah bah-ee-yah, soo-goo-nee ee-ryow-kee-kan-o zhoo-shin-shee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 息苦しさがある場合や、症状が急に悪化した場合は、すぐに医療機関を受診してください。

english: We will use a professional interpreter to explain the results and treatment.
transliteration: keh-kah-toh chee-ryow-nee ts-ee-tee seh-mee-roo tah-meh, seh-mon-no tsu-yak-o ree-yoo-shee-ma-s
translation: 結果と治療について説明するため、専門の通訳を利用します。

english: What brings you in today?
transliteration: kyo-wah doh-sah-reh-ma-shee-ta-ka
translation: 今日はどうされましたか？

english: Where does it hurt? Please point to the area.
transliteration: doh-ko-gah ee-tah-mee-ma-ska? so-no bah-sho-o yoo-beh-deh shee-meh-shee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: どこが痛みますか？その場所を指で示してください。

english: Is the pain on the right, left, or both sides?
transliteration: ee-tah-mee-wa mee-gee-gah-wah, hee-dah-ree-gah-wah, so-reh-to-mo ryow-gah-wah-des-ka
translation: 痛むのは右側、左側、それとも両側ですか？

english: When did the pain start?
transliteration: ee-ts-kah-rah ee-tah-mee-hah-zheh-ma-shee-ta-ka
translation: いつから痛み始めましたか？

english: Did it start suddenly or gradually?
transliteration: toh-ts-zen hah-zheh-ma-shee-ta-ka, so-reh-to-mo joh-joe-nee hah-zheh-ma-shee-ta-ka
translation: 突然始まりましたか、それとも徐々に始まりましたか？

english: How long have you had this problem?
transliteration: ko-no show-jow-wah doh-no-koo-rah-ee ts-zoo-ee-teh ee-ma-ska
translation: この症状はどのくらい続いていますか？

english: Is the pain constant or does it come and go?
transliteration: ee-tah-mee-wah zoot-toh ts-zoo-ee-teh ee-ma-ska, so-reh-to-mo deh-tah-ree oh-sah-mah-tah-ree shee-ma-ska
translation: 痛みはずっと続いていますか、それとも出たり治まったりしますか？

english: Is the pain getting better or worse?
transliteration: ee-tah-mee-wah yoh-koo nah-t-teh ee-ma-ska, so-reh-to-mo wah-roo-koo nah-t-teh ee-ma-ska
translation: 痛みはよくなっていますか、それとも悪くなっていますか？

english: How severe is the pain from zero to ten?
transliteration: ee-tah-mee-no ts-yo-sah-o zero-kah-rah ten-deh ah-rah-wah-soo-toh, doh-no-koo-rah-ee-des-ka
translation: 痛みの強さを0から10で表すと、どのくらいですか？

english: Is the pain sharp, dull, burning, or throbbing?
transliteration: ee-tah-mee-wah s-too-ree-kee kahn-zheh, nee-booy-ee kahn-zheh, yah-keh-roo-yoh-nah kahn-zheh, myah-koo-oo kahn-zheh-no doh-reh-des-ka
translation: 痛みは鋭い感じ、鈍い感じ、焼けるような感じ、脈打つ感じのどれですか？

english: Does the pain spread anywhere else?
transliteration: ee-tah-mee-wah ho-kah-no bah-sho-nee-mo hee-roh-gah-ree-ma-ska
translation: 痛みはほかの場所にも広がりますか？

english: Have you had this pain before?
transliteration: ee-zen-nee-mo ko-no ee-tah-mee-gah ah-ree-ma-shee-ta-ka
translation: 以前にもこの痛みがありましたか？

english: Did you fall or have an accident?
transliteration: ko-ron-dah-ree, zhee-ko-nee ah-t-tah-ree-shee-ma-shee-ta-ka
translation: 転んだり、事故に遭ったりしましたか？

english: When did the injury happen?
transliteration: keh-gah-o shee-tah-no-wah ee-ts-des-ka
translation: けがをしたのはいつですか？

english: How did you injure yourself?
transliteration: doh-no-yoh-nee sheh-gah-o shee-ma-shee-ta-ka
translation: どのようにしてけがをしましたか？

english: Did you get hit directly in that area?
transliteration: so-no bah-sho-nee chee-koo-seh-ts nahn-kah-gah ah-tah-ree-ma-shee-ta-ka
translation: その場所に直接何かが当たりましたか？

english: Did you twist your ankle or knee?
transliteration: ah-shi-koo-bee-yah hee-zah-o nee-neh-ree-ma-shee-ta-ka
translation: 足首や膝をひねりましたか？

english: Did you fall onto an outstretched hand?
transliteration: teh-o noh-bah-shee-teh teh-o ts-koo-yoh-nee ko-ron-da-ree shee-ma-shee-ta-ka
translation: 手を伸ばして手をつくように転びましたか？

english: Did you hear or feel a pop or crack?
transliteration: po-kee-t-toh ee-oo oh-toh-gah kee-ko-eh-tah-ree, po-kee-t-toh shee-tah kahn-kah-koo-gah ah-ree-ma-shee-ta-ka
translation: ポキッという音が聞こえたり、ポキッとした感覚がありましたか？

english: Did the swelling start immediately?
transliteration: hah-reh-wah soo-goo-nee hah-zheh-ma-shee-ta-ka
translation: 腫れはすぐに始まりましたか？

english: Could you walk right after the injury?
transliteration: keh-gah-o shee-tah choo-goo-nee ah-roo-keh-ma-shee-ta-ka
translation: けがをした直後に歩けましたか？

english: Did you continue playing or working after the injury?
transliteration: keh-gah-o shee-tah ah-toh-mo, soo-por-ts oo yah shee-go-toh-o ts-zoo-keh-ma-shee-ta-ka
translation: けがをしたあとも、スポーツや仕事を続けましたか？

english: Was this related to sports, work, or lifting something heavy?
transliteration: soo-por-ts, shee-go-toh, mah-tah-wah oh-mo-ee mono-o moh-t-tah ko-to-gah kahn-kee sheh-ma-ska
translation: スポーツ、仕事、または重い物を持ったことが関係していますか？

english: Did you injure your head or neck as well?
transliteration: ah-tah-mah-yah k-oo-moh keh-gah-o shee-ma-shee-ta-ka
translation: 頭や首もけがをしましたか？

english: Does it hurt more when you move?
transliteration: oo-go-kah-soh-toh, mot-toh ee-tah-mee-ma-ska
translation: 動かすと、もっと痛みますか？

english: Does it hurt more when you walk or stand?
transliteration: ah-roo-ee-tah-ree tah-t-tah-ree-soh-toh, mot-toh ee-tah-mee-ma-ska
translation: 歩いたり立ったりすると、もっと痛みますか？

english: Does it hurt more when you sit or bend forward?
transliteration: sow-tah-ree mae-kah-gah-mee-nee nah-t-tah-ree-soh-toh, mot-toh ee-tah-mee-ma-ska
translation: 座ったり前かがみになったりすると、もっと痛みますか？

english: Does the pain improve with rest?
transliteration: yah-soo-moo-toh ee-tah-mee-wah kah-roo-koo nah-ree-ma-ska
translation: 休むと痛みは軽くなりますか？

english: Does the pain wake you up at night?
transliteration: ee-tah-mee-deh yoh-nah-koo-nee meh-gah sah-meh-ma-ska
translation: 痛みで夜中に目が覚めますか？

english: Do you have stiffness in the morning?
transliteration: ah-sah, kah-rah-dah-gah ko-wah-bah-ree-ma-ska
translation: 朝、体がこわばりますか？

english: How long does the morning stiffness last?
transliteration: ah-sah-no ko-wah-bah-ree-wah doh-no-koo-rah-ee ts-zoo-kee-ma-ska
translation: 朝のこわばりはどのくらい続きますか？

english: Can you do your usual daily activities?
transliteration: ee-ts-mo-no nee-chee-jow-see-kah-ts-o oh-koo-reh-ma-ska
translation: いつもの日常生活を送れますか？

english: Can you walk without assistance?
transliteration: kah-ee-joh-nah-shee-deh ah-roo-keh-ma-ska
translation: 介助なしで歩けますか？

english: How far can you walk before you need to stop?
transliteration: yah-soo-mah-zoo-nee doh-no-koo-rah-ee ah-roo-keh-ma-ska
translation: 休まずにどのくらい歩けますか？

english: Can you climb stairs?
transliteration: kye-dahn-o noh-reh-ma-ska
translation: 階段を上れますか？

english: Does the joint lock, catch, or give way?
transliteration: kahn-seh-ts-gah oo-go-kah-nah-koo-nah-tah-ree, hee-kah-kah-tah-ree, chah-kah-rah-gah noo-keh-tah-ree shee-ma-ska
translation: 関節が動かなくなったり、引っかかったり、力が抜けたりしますか？

english: Is the area swollen?
transliteration: so-no bah-sho-wah hah-reh-teh ee-ma-ska
translation: その場所は腫れていますか？

english: Is the area red or warm to touch?
transliteration: so-no bah-sho-wah ah-kah-koo nah-t-tah-ree-ma-ska? toh-roo-toh ah-ts-koo kahn-zheh-ma-ska
translation: その場所は赤くなっていますか？触ると熱く感じますか？

english: Do you have a fever or feel unwell?
transliteration: neh-ts-gah ah-ree-ma-ska, mah-tah-wah kah-rah-dah-no choh-shee-gah wah-ree-des-ka
translation: 熱がありますか、または体調が悪いですか？

english: Do you feel numbness or tingling?
transliteration: shee-bee-reh-yah pee-ree-pee-ree-soo-roo kahn-zheh-gah ah-ree-ma-ska
translation: しびれやピリピリする感じがありますか？

english: Do you have weakness in your arm or leg?
transliteration: oo-deh-yah ah-shi-nee chah-koo-gah hee-ree-nee-koo-ee-des-ka
translation: 腕や脚に力が入りにくいですか？

english: Can you feel me touching your fingers or toes?
transliteration: yoo-beh-yah ts-mah-see-knee toh-reh-teh-ee-roo-no-gah wah-ree-ma-ska
translation: 指やつま先に触れているのがわかりますか？

english: Have your fingers or toes become cold or pale?
transliteration: yoo-beh-yah ts-mah-see-gah ts-meh-tah-koo nah-tah-ree, ah-oh-zhee-roo-koo nah-tah-ree-shee-ma-shee-ta-ka
translation: 指やつま先が冷たくなったり、青白くなったりしましたか？

english: Do you have new difficulty controlling your urine or stool?
transliteration: sigh-kin, nyow-yah behn-o yoh-koo kon-tor-o-reh-nigh ko-to-gah ah-ree-ma-ska
translation: 最近、尿や便をうまくコントロールできないことがありますか？

english: Do you have numbness around your groin or between your legs?
transliteration: mah-tah-no mah-wah-ree-yah ah-shee-no ah-hee-dah-nee shee-bee-reh-gah ah-ree-ma-ska
translation: 股の周りや脚の間にしびれがありますか？

english: Have you had unexplained weight loss?
transliteration: gen-in-gah wah-kah-rah-nigh tai-zyu-geng-sho-gah ah-ree-ma-shee-ta-ka
translation: 原因がわからない体重減少がありましたか？

english: Does your neck hurt?
transliteration: koo-bee-gah ee-tah-mee-ma-ska
translation: 首が痛みますか？

english: Does your upper or lower back hurt?
transliteration: seh-nah-kah-no oo-eh-no hoh, mah-tah-wah shih-tah-no hoh-gah ee-tah-mee-ma-ska
translation: 背中の上のほう、または下のほうが痛みますか？

english: Does the pain travel down your arm?
transliteration: ee-tah-mee-gah oo-deh-nee soh-t-tah hee-roh-gah-ree-ma-ska
translation: 痛みが腕に沿って広がりますか？

english: Does the pain travel down your buttock or leg?
transliteration: ee-tah-mee-gah oh-shee-ree-yah ah-shee-nee soh-t-tah hee-roh-gah-ree-ma-ska
translation: 痛みがお尻や脚に沿って広がりますか？

english: Is the pain worse when you cough or sneeze?
transliteration: seh-kee-yah koo-shah-mee-o soo-roh-toh ee-tah-mee-gah ts-yo-koo nah-ree-ma-ska
translation: 咳やくしゃみをすると痛みが強くなりますか？

english: Is bending forward or backward painful?
transliteration: mae-kah-gah-mee-yah oh-shee-roh-nee so-oo gah-oh-goo-gee-deh ee-tah-mee-ma-ska
translation: 前かがみや後ろに反る動きで痛みますか？

english: Have you had a slipped or herniated disc before?
transliteration: ee-zen, ts-ee-kahn-ban her-nee-ah-nee nah-t-tah ko-to-gah ah-ree-ma-ska
translation: 以前、椎間板ヘルニアになったことがありますか？

english: Have you had back surgery before?
transliteration: ee-zen, seh-nah-kah-no shoo-zhoo-ts-o oo-keh-tah ko-to-gah ah-ree-ma-ska
translation: 以前、背中の手術を受けたことがありますか？

english: Does your shoulder hurt?
transliteration: kah-tah-gah ee-tah-mee-ma-ska
translation: 肩が痛みますか？

english: Can you lift your arm above your head?
transliteration: oo-deh-o ah-tah-mah-yah oo-eh-nee ah-geh-rah-reh-ma-ska
translation: 腕を頭より上に上げられますか？

english: Does your shoulder feel unstable or pop out?
transliteration: kah-tah-gah boo-ahn-teh-ee-nee kahn-zheh-tah-ree, hazoo-reh-tah-ree shee-ma-ska
translation: 肩が不安定に感じたり、外れたりしますか？

english: Does your elbow hurt?
transliteration: hee-zah-gah ee-tah-mee-ma-ska
translation: 肘が痛みますか？

english: Does your wrist hurt?
transliteration: teh-koo-bee-gah ee-tah-mee-ma-ska
translation: 手首が痛みますか？

english: Do you have pain or swelling in your fingers?
transliteration: yoo-beh-nee ee-tah-mee-yah hah-reh-gah ah-ree-ma-ska
translation: 指に痛みや腫れがありますか？

english: Can you make a fist?
transliteration: nee-gee-ree-ko-boo-shee-o ts-koo-reh-ma-ska
translation: 握りこぶしを作れますか？

english: Can you grip or hold objects normally?
transliteration: foo-dahn-doh-ree-nee mono-o neh-gee-tah-ree moh-t-tah-ree deh-kee-ma-ska
translation: 普段どおりに物を握ったり持ったりできますか？

english: Do your fingers become numb at night?
transliteration: yoh-roo, yoo-beh-gah shee-bee-reh-ma-ska
translation: 夜、指がしびれますか？

english: Does your hip or groin hurt?
transliteration: koh-kahn-seh-ts-yah ah-shi-no ts-kee-neh-gah ee-tah-mee-ma-ska
translation: 股関節や足の付け根が痛みますか？

english: Does your knee hurt?
transliteration: hee-zah-gah ee-tah-mee-ma-ska
translation: 膝が痛みますか？

english: Does your knee swell after activity?
transliteration: oo-gah-kah shih-tah ah-toh-nee hee-zah-gah hah-reh-ma-ska
translation: 運動したあとに膝が腫れますか？

english: Does your knee lock or give way?
transliteration: hee-zah-gah oo-go-kah-nah-koo-nah-tah-ree, chah-kah-rah-gah noo-keh-tah-ree shee-ma-ska
translation: 膝が動かなくなったり、力が抜けたりしますか？

english: Does your ankle hurt?
transliteration: ah-shi-koo-bee-gah ee-tah-mee-ma-ska
translation: 足首が痛みますか？

english: Does your foot or heel hurt?
transliteration: ah-shi-yah kah-kah-toh-gah ee-tah-mee-ma-ska
translation: 足やかかとが痛みますか？

english: Can you put weight on the injured leg?
transliteration: keh-gah-o shee-tah ah-shi-nee teh-tai-zyu-o kah-keh-rah-reh-ma-ska
translation: けがをした脚に体重をかけられますか？

english: Can you take four steps?
transliteration: yon-boh ah-roo-keh-ma-ska
translation: 4歩歩けますか？

english: Do you have pain in your calf?
transliteration: foo-koo-rah-hah-gah ee-tah-mee-ma-ska
translation: ふくらはぎが痛みますか？

english: Is one calf more swollen than the other?
transliteration: kah-tah-ho-no foo-koo-rah-hah-gah, moh-oo-kah-tah-ho-yoh-ree hah-reh-teh ee-ma-ska
translation: 片方のふくらはぎが、もう片方より腫れていますか？

english: Have you been diagnosed with arthritis?
transliteration: kahn-seh-ts-ee-en-toh sheen-dahn-sah-reh-tah ko-to-gah ah-ree-ma-ska
translation: 関節炎と診断されたことはありますか？

english: Have you been diagnosed with osteoarthritis?
transliteration: hen-keh-seh-ts-ee-en-toh-shee-ow-shee-toh sheen-dahn-sah-reh-tah ko-to-gah ah-ree-ma-ska
translation: 変形性関節症と診断されたことはありますか？

english: Have you been diagnosed with rheumatoid arthritis?
transliteration: kahn-seh-ts-ryoo-mah-chee-shee-ow-shee-toh sheen-dahn-sah-reh-tah ko-to-gah ah-ree-ma-ska
translation: 関節リウマチと診断されたことはありますか？

english: Have you been diagnosed with osteoporosis or weak bones?
transliteration: koh-ts-soh-show-sho-yah koh-ts-gah yow-ee toh ee-wah-reh-tah ko-to-gah ah-ree-ma-ska
translation: 骨粗しょう症や骨が弱いと言われたことはありますか？

english: Have you broken a bone before?
transliteration: ee-zen, koh-ts-seh-ts-shee-tah ko-to-gah ah-ree-ma-ska
translation: 以前、骨折したことはありますか？

english: Have you had a bone density test?
transliteration: koh-ts-mits-doh-ken-sah-o oo-keh-tah ko-to-gah ah-ree-ma-ska
translation: 骨密度検査を受けたことはありますか？

english: Do you have pain or swelling in several joints?
transliteration: ee-koo-ts-kah-no kahn-seh-ts-nee ee-tah-mee-yah hah-reh-gah ah-ree-ma-ska
translation: いくつかの関節に痛みや腫れがありますか？

english: Does anyone in your family have arthritis or osteoporosis?
transliteration: goh-kah-zook-nee kahn-seh-ts-ee-yah koh-ts-soh-show-sho-no kah-gah ee-ma-ska
translation: ご家族に関節炎や骨粗しょう症の方はいますか？

english: Have you had surgery on a bone or joint?
transliteration: koh-ts-yah kahn-seh-ts-no shoo-zhoo-ts-o oo-keh-tah ko-to-gah ah-ree-ma-ska
translation: 骨や関節の手術を受けたことはありますか？

english: Have you had a hip or knee replacement?
transliteration: koh-kahn-seh-ts-yah hee-zah-kahn-seh-ts-no zhin-kow-kahn-seh-ts-chee-zhoo-ts-o oo-keh-tah ko-to-gah ah-ree-ma-ska
translation: 股関節や膝関節の人工関節置換術を受けたことはありますか？

english: Have you ever had a cast or splint?
transliteration: gee-psoo-yah soh-eh-gee-o ts-kah-t-tah ko-to-gah ah-ree-ma-ska
translation: ギプスや添え木を使ったことはありますか？

english: Have you tried physiotherapy?
transliteration: ree-gah-koo-ryow-how-o oo-keh-tah ko-to-gah ah-ree-ma-ska
translation: 理学療法を受けたことはありますか？

english: What medicines have you taken for the pain?
transliteration: ee-tah-mee-do-meh-toh-shee-teh, donn-nah koo-sree-o noh-mee-ma-shee-ta-ka
translation: 痛み止めとして、どんな薬を飲みましたか？

english: Have you taken ibuprofen, naproxen, or diclofenac (Voltaren)?
transliteration: ee-boo-proh-fen, nah-proh-ksen, mah-tah-wah dee-klo-fenak (Vol-tah-ren) o noh-mee-ma-shee-ta-ka
translation: イブプロフェン、ナプロキセン、またはジクロフェナク（Voltaren）を飲んだことはありますか？

english: How much medicine do you take and how often?
transliteration: koo-sree-wah doh-no-koo-rah-ee-no ryow-o, doh-no-koo-rah-ee-no hee-zen-deh noh-mee-ma-ska
translation: 薬はどのくらいの量を、どのくらいの頻度で飲んでいますか？

english: How long have you been taking it?
transliteration: doh-no-koo-rah-ee-no kee-kahn, so-no koo-sree-o noh-mee-teh ee-ma-ska
translation: どのくらいの期間、その薬を飲んでいますか？

english: Has the medicine helped?
transliteration: koo-sree-wah kee-kee-ma-shee-ta-ka
translation: 薬は効きましたか？

english: Do you take blood thinners or steroid medicines?
transliteration: keh-ts-ee-o kah-tah-mah-ree-nee-koo-koo-soo-roo koo-sree-yah soo-teh-roy-do-yah-koo-o noh-mee-ma-ska
translation: 血液を固まりにくくする薬やステロイド薬を飲んでいますか？

english: Do you have any medication allergies?
transliteration: koo-sree-no ah-ler-gee-wah ah-ree-ma-ska
translation: 薬のアレルギーはありますか？

english: I am going to examine the painful area.
transliteration: ee-tah-mee-no ah-roo toh-koh-roh-o sheen-sah-shee-ma-s
translation: 痛むところを診察します。

english: Please tell me if anything hurts.
transliteration: ee-tah-ee toh-koh-roh-gah ah-reh-bah oh-shee-eh-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 痛いところがあれば教えてください。

english: Please stand up.
transliteration: tah-t-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 立ってください。

english: Please sit down.
transliteration: suwat-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 座ってください。

english: Please lie on your back.
transliteration: ah-oh-moo-keh-nee neh-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 仰向けに寝てください。

english: Please lie on your stomach.
transliteration: oo-ts-boo-seh-nee neh-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: うつ伏せに寝てください。

english: Please walk a few steps.
transliteration: soo-oo hoh ah-roo-ee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 数歩歩いてください。

english: Please walk on your toes.
transliteration: ts-mah-sah-kee-deh ah-roo-ee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: つま先で歩いてください。

english: Please walk on your heels.
transliteration: kah-kah-toh-deh ah-roo-ee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: かかとで歩いてください。

english: Bend forward, please.
transliteration: mae-kah-gah-mee-nee nah-t-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 前かがみになってください。

english: Bend your knee, please.
transliteration: hee-zah-o mah-geh-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 膝を曲げてください。

english: Straighten your knee, please.
transliteration: hee-zah-o noh-bah-shee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 膝を伸ばしてください。

english: Raise your arm, please.
transliteration: oo-deh-o ah-geh-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 腕を上げてください。

english: Make a fist and then open your hand.
transliteration: teh-o nee-gee-t-teh kah-rah, ah-ee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 手を握ってから、開いてください。

english: Spread your fingers apart.
transliteration: yoo-beh-o hee-roh-geh-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 指を広げてください。

english: Push against my hand.

translation: 私の手を引っ張るように力を入れてください。

english: Please relax your muscles.
transliteration: keen-nyoo-koo-no chah-kah-rah-o noo-ee-teh koo-dah-sigh

english: Tell me if you feel this touch.

translation: この触れた感じが分かるか教えてください。

english: I am going to examine your joints and muscles.
transliteration: kahn-seh-ts-toh keen-nyoo-koo-o sheen-sah-shee-ma-s

english: Please tell me if anything hurts during the examination.
transliteration: sheen-sah-chyoo-nee ee-tah-ee toh-koh-roh-gah ah-reh-bah oh-shee-eh-teh koo-dah-sigh

english: Please stand up straight.
transliteration: mah-ts-see-goh tah-t-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: まっすぐ立ってください。

english: Please walk across the room and come back.
transliteration: hey-ah-no moo-koo-mah-deh ah-roo-ee-teh, moh-doh-t-teh kee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 部屋の向こうまで歩いて、戻ってきてください。

english: Please walk on your heels.
transliteration: kah-kah-toh-deh ah-roo-ee-teh koo-dah-sigh

english: Please try walking in a straight line, heel to toe.

english: Please stand on one leg.
transliteration: kah-tah-ah-shee-deh tah-t-teh koo-dah-sigh

english: Please sit down and stand up without using your hands, if you can.

english: Can you put your full weight on this leg?

english: Please lie on your back.

english: Please lie on your stomach.

english: Please turn onto your side.

translation: 横向きになってください。

transliteration: ko-no ah-tah-ree-o yah-shee-koo oh-shee-ma-s

english: Does it hurt when I press here?

english: Is the pain in the muscle, bone, or joint?

translation: 痛みは筋肉、骨、関節のどこにありますか？

english: Please relax your muscles.
transliteration: keen-nyoo-koo-no chah-kah-rah-o noo-ee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 筋肉の力を抜いてください。

english: I will move your arm or leg for you; try to relax.
transliteration: oo-deh-kah ah-shi-o ko-chee-rah-deh oo-go-kah-snee koo-neh-deh, chah-kah-rah-o noo-ee-teh koo-dah-sigh

english: Please look down and bring your chin toward your chest.

english: Please look up toward the ceiling.
transliteration: teh-nyoo-no how-o mee-ah-geh-teh koo-dah-sigh

english: Please turn your head to the left and then to the right.
transliteration: ah-tah-mah-o hee-dah-ree-nee moo-ee-teh-kah-rah, mee-gee-nee moo-ee-teh koo-dah-sigh

english: Please tilt your ear toward your shoulder.

english: Please bend forward and try to touch your toes.

english: Please lean backward as far as is comfortable.

english: Please bend sideways to each side.
transliteration: sah-yoo-shoh-no ts-soh-ree-nee kah-rah-dah-o yoh-kah-nee mah-geh-teh koo-dah-sigh

english: Please twist your upper body to the left and right.
transliteration: zyow-hahn-shin-o sah-yoo-shoh-nee nee-neh-t-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 上半身を左右にひねってください。

english: I will raise your straight leg; tell me if pain travels down it.
