translation: 伸ばした脚を持ち上げます。痛みが脚に沿って下に広がるか教えてください。

english: Does this movement cause tingling or pain down your arm?
transliteration: ko-no oo-go-kee-deh, oo-deh-nee shee-bee-reh-yah ee-tah-mee-gah hash-ree-ma-ska
translation: この動きで、腕にしびれや痛みが走りますか？

english: Please lift your hips off the bed.
transliteration: kosh-ee-o beh-doo-kah-rah moh-chee-ah-geh-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 腰をベッドから持ち上げてください。

english: Please lift both arms straight in front of you.
transliteration: ryow-oo-deh-o mah-ts-see-go mae-nee ah-geh-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 両腕をまっすぐ前に上げてください。

english: Please raise both arms out to your sides.
transliteration: ryow-oo-deh-o yoh-kah-nee ah-geh-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 両腕を横に上げてください。

english: Please lift your arms above your head.
transliteration: ryow-oo-deh-o ah-tah-mah-no oo-eh-mah-deh ah-geh-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 両腕を頭の上まで上げてください。

english: Please reach behind your head.
transliteration: ah-tah-mah-no oo-shi-ro-nee teh-o mah-wah-shee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 頭の後ろに手を回してください。

english: Please reach behind your back.
transliteration: seh-nah-kah-nee teh-o mah-wah-shee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 背中に手を回してください。

english: Keep your elbow by your side and turn your hand outward.
transliteration: hee-zah-o kah-rah-dah-no yoh-kah-nee ts-keh-tah mah-mah, teh-o soh-toh-gah-nee moo-ee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 肘を体の横につけたまま、手を外側に向けてください。

english: Keep your elbow by your side and turn your hand inward.
transliteration: hee-zah-o kah-rah-dah-no yoh-kah-nee ts-keh-tah mah-mah, teh-o oo-chee-gah-nee moo-ee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 肘を体の横につけたまま、手を内側に向けてください。

english: Please push your arm upward against my hand.
transliteration: wah-tah-shee-no teh-nee sah-kah-rah-t-teh, oo-deh-o oo-eh-nee oh-shee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 私の手に逆らって、腕を上に押してください。

english: Please keep your arm up while I gently push down.
transliteration: wah-tah-shee-gah yah-shee-koo shih-tah-nee oh-soo-mah, oo-deh-o ah-geh-tah mah-mah-nee shee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 私が優しく下に押す間、腕を上げたままにしてください。

english: Please bring your arm across your chest.
transliteration: oo-deh-o moo-neh-no mae-nee moh-t-tay kee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 腕を胸の前に持ってきてください。

english: Please bend and straighten your elbow.
transliteration: hee-zah-o mah-geh-tah-ree noh-bah-shee-tah-ree shee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 肘を曲げたり伸ばしたりしてください。

english: Please turn your palm up, then down.
transliteration: teh-no hee-rah-o oo-eh-nee moo-ee-teh-kah-rah, shih-tah-nee moo-ee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 手のひらを上に向けてから、下に向けてください。

english: Please bend your wrist up and down.
transliteration: teh-koo-bee-o joh-geh-nee mah-geh-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 手首を上下に曲げてください。

english: Please move your wrist from side to side.
transliteration: teh-koo-bee-o sah-yoo-shoh-nee oo-go-kah-shee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 手首を左右に動かしてください。

english: Please make a fist.
transliteration: teh-o nee-gee-t-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 手を握ってください。

english: Please open your hand and spread your fingers.
transliteration: teh-o ah-ee-teh, yoo-beh-o hee-roh-geh-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 手を開いて、指を広げてください。

english: Please touch your thumb to each fingertip.
transliteration: oh-yoo-bee-o, soh-reh-zoh-reh-no yoo-beh-sah-kee-nee ts-keh-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 親指を、それぞれの指先につけてください。

english: Please squeeze my fingers as hard as you can.
transliteration: deh-kee-roo-dah-kee ts-yoo-koo, wah-tah-shee-no yoo-beh-o nee-gee-t-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: できるだけ強く、私の指を握ってください。

english: Please hold your fingers apart while I push them together.
transliteration: wah-tah-shee-gah yoo-beh-o oh-shee-ah-wah-seh-yoh-toh soo-roh ah-ee-dah, yoo-beh-o hee-roh-geh-tah mah-mah-nee shee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 私が指を押し合わせようとする間、指を開いたままにしてください。

english: Please straighten your fingers against my hand.
transliteration: wah-tah-shee-no teh-nee oh-shee-ah-teh-roh yoh-nee, yoo-beh-o noh-bah-shee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 私の手に押し当てるように、指を伸ばしてください。

english: Does tapping here cause tingling in your fingers?
transliteration: ko-ko-o kah-roo-koo tah-t-koo-toh, yoo-beh-gah shee-bee-reh-ma-ska
translation: ここを軽くたたくと、指がしびれますか？

english: Please bend both wrists and hold the backs of your hands together.
transliteration: ryow-teh-koo-bee-o mah-geh-teh, teh-no koh-oh-toh koh-oh-toh aw-wah-seh-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 両手首を曲げて、手の甲同士を合わせてください。

english: Please grip my fingers and do not let go.
transliteration: wah-tah-shee-no yoo-beh-o nee-gee-t-teh, hah-nah-sah-nigh-deh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 私の指を握って、離さないでください。

english: Please bring your knee toward your chest.
transliteration: hee-zah-o moo-neh-nee chih-kah-zeh-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 膝を胸に近づけてください。

english: Please move your leg out to the side.
transliteration: ah-shi-o yoh-kah-nee oo-go-kah-shee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 脚を横に動かしてください。

english: Please bring your leg back toward the middle.
transliteration: ah-shi-o mah-nah-kee nee moh-doh-shee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 脚を真ん中に戻してください。

english: I will gently rotate your hip; tell me if it hurts.
transliteration: koh-kahn-seh-ts-o yoh-koo-ree mah-wah-shee-ma-s. ee-tah-ee toh-kee wah oh-shee-eh-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 股関節をゆっくり回します。痛ければ教えてください。

english: Please bend your knee and let it fall outward.
transliteration: hee-zah-o mah-geh-teh, soh-toh-gah-nee tah-oh-shee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 膝を曲げて、外側に倒してください。

english: Please lift your straight leg off the bed.
transliteration: noh-bah-shee-tah ah-shi-o beh-doo-kah-rah moh-chee-ah-geh-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 伸ばした脚をベッドから持ち上げてください。

english: Please push your knee outward against my hand.
transliteration: wah-tah-shee-no teh-nee sah-kah-rah-t-teh, hee-zah-o soh-toh-gah-nee oh-shee-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 私の手に逆らって、膝を外側に押してください。

english: Please stand on one leg while I check your hips.
transliteration: koh-kahn-seh-ts-o kah-koo-nee-n soo-ah-ee, kah-tah-ah-shi-deh tah-t-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: 股関節を確認する間、片足で立ってください。

english: Please bend your knee as far as you can.
transliteration: deh-kee-roo-dah-kee fooka-koo hee-zah-o mah-geh-teh koo-dah-sigh
translation: できるだけ深く膝を曲げてください。

english: Please straighten your knee completely.
transliteration: hi-ZA o kan-ZEN ni no-ba-shi-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: 膝を完全に伸ばしてください。

english: Please tighten the muscles at the front of your thigh.
transliteration: fu-to-MO-mo no mae no kin-NI-ku ni chi-ka-ra o i-re-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: 太ももの前の筋肉に力を入れてください。

english: Please lift your straight leg while keeping your knee straight.
transliteration: hi-ZA o no-ba-shi-ta ma-ma, a-shi o mo-chi-a-ge-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: 膝を伸ばしたまま、脚を持ち上げてください。

english: I will gently move your kneecap.
transliteration: hi-ZA no o-sa-ra o so-tto u-go-ka-shi-MASU.
translation: 膝のお皿をそっと動かします。

english: I will gently test whether your knee feels stable.
transliteration: hi-ZA ga an-TEI shi-te i-ru ka, so-tto ta-shi-ka-me-MASU.
translation: 膝が安定しているか、そっと確かめます。

english: Does your knee click, catch, or lock when you move it?
transliteration: hi-ZA o u-go-ka-shi-ta to-ki ni, ka-ku-tto na-tta-ri, hi-kak-ka-tta-ri, u-go-ka-na-ku na-tta-ri shi-MASU ka?
translation: 膝を動かしたときに、カクッと鳴ったり、引っかかったり、動かなくなったりしますか？

english: Does your knee feel like it might give way?
transliteration: hi-ZA ga ga-kut-to ku-zu-re-so-u ni kan-ji-MASU ka?
translation: 膝がガクッと崩れそうに感じますか？

english: Please take a few steps and turn around.
transliteration: su-u-ho a-ru-i-te, mu-ki o ka-e-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: 数歩歩いて、向きを変えてください。

english: Please do a small squat if you feel safe doing so.
transliteration: an-ZEN ni de-ki-so-u de a-re-ba, ka-ru-ku sha-gan-de ku-da-SAI.
translation: 安全にできそうであれば、軽くしゃがんでください。

english: Please point your toes down.
transliteration: tsu-ma-SA-ki o shi-ta ni mu-ke-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: つま先を下に向けてください。

english: Please pull your toes up toward your head.
transliteration: tsu-ma-SA-ki o a-ta-ma no ho-u ni hi-ki-a-ge-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: つま先を頭のほうに引き上げてください。

english: Please turn the sole of your foot inward.
transliteration: a-shi no u-ra o u-chi-ga-wa ni mu-ke-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: 足の裏を内側に向けてください。

english: Please turn the sole of your foot outward.
transliteration: a-shi no u-ra o so-to-ga-wa ni mu-ke-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: 足の裏を外側に向けてください。

english: Please wiggle your toes.
transliteration: a-shi no yu-bi o u-go-ka-shi-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: 足の指を動かしてください。

english: Please stand on your tiptoes if you can.
transliteration: de-ki-re-ba, tsu-ma-SA-ki-da-chi o shi-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: できれば、つま先立ちをしてください。

english: Please try a single-leg heel raise if you feel safe.
transliteration: an-ZEN ni de-ki-so-u de a-re-ba, ka-ta-a-shi de ka-ka-to o a-ge-te mi-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: 安全にできそうであれば、片足でかかとを上げてみてください。

english: I will gently move your ankle to check its stability.
transliteration: a-shi-ku-bi no an-TEI-se-i o ka-ku-nin su-ru ta-me, so-tto u-go-ka-shi-MASU.
translation: 足首の安定性を確認するため、そっと動かします。

english: Does it hurt when I squeeze your lower leg here?
transliteration: ko-ko o o-su to, ka-TAI-bu ga i-ta-mi-MASU ka?
translation: ここを押すと、下腿が痛みますか？

english: Please show me exactly where your foot is tender.
transliteration: a-shi no do-ko ga i-ta-mu ka, se-i-ka-ku ni o-shi-e-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: 足のどこが痛むか、正確に教えてください。

english: Can you feel me touching your skin here?
transliteration: ko-ko de hi-fu ni fu-re-te i-ru no ga wa-ka-ri-MASU ka?
translation: ここで皮膚に触れているのが分かりますか？

english: Does it feel the same on both sides?
transliteration: sa-yu-u de o-na-ji yo-u ni kan-ji-MASU ka?
translation: 左右で同じように感じますか？

english: Please close your eyes while I check sensation.
transliteration: kan-KA-ku o ka-ku-nin su-ru a-i-da, me o to-ji-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: 感覚を確認する間、目を閉じてください。

english: Tell me whether this feels sharp or dull.
transliteration: ko-re ga su-ru-do-i kan-ji ka, ni-bu-i kan-ji ka o-shi-e-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: これが鋭い感じか、鈍い感じか教えてください。

english: Please push your foot down against my hand.
transliteration: wa-ta-shi no te ni mu-ka-tte, a-shi o shi-ta ni o-shi-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: 私の手に向かって、足を下に押してください。

english: Please pull your foot up against my hand.
transliteration: wa-ta-shi no te ni mu-ka-tte, a-shi o u-e ni hi-ki-a-ge-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: 私の手に向かって、足を上に引き上げてください。

english: Please straighten your knee against my hand.
transliteration: wa-ta-shi no te ni o-shi-ka-e-su yo-u ni, hi-ZA o no-ba-shi-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: 私の手に押し返すように、膝を伸ばしてください。

english: Please bend your knee against my hand.
transliteration: wa-ta-shi no te ni o-shi-ka-e-su yo-u ni, hi-ZA o ma-ge-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: 私の手に押し返すように、膝を曲げてください。

english: I am going to tap gently to check your reflexes.
transliteration: han-SHA o ka-ku-nin su-ru ta-me, ka-ru-ku ta-ta-ki-MASU.
translation: 反射を確認するため、軽くたたきます。

english: I am checking the pulse in your hand or foot.
transliteration: te ma-ta wa a-shi no mya-ku o ka-ku-nin shi-te i-MASU.
translation: 手または足の脈を確認しています。

english: I am checking the blood flow to your fingers or toes.
transliteration: yu-bi-sa-ki ma-ta wa a-shi no yu-bi-sa-ki e no ke-tsu-ryu-u o ka-ku-nin shi-te i-MASU.
translation: 指先または足の指先への血流を確認しています。

english: Do your fingers or toes feel cold or numb?
transliteration: yu-bi-sa-ki ya a-shi no yu-bi-sa-ki ga tsu-me-ta-i, ma-ta wa shi-bi-re-te i-MASU ka?
translation: 指先や足の指先が冷たい、またはしびれていますか？

english: Please tell me immediately if you feel severe pain.
transliteration: tsu-yo-i i-ta-mi o kan-ji-ta-ra, su-gu ni o-shi-e-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: 強い痛みを感じたら、すぐに教えてください。

english: We may need an X-ray to check for a broken bone.
transliteration: ko-setsu ga na-i ka ka-ku-nin su-ru ta-me, X-sen ken-sa ga hi-tsu-yo-u ni na-ru ka-mo shi-re-MASEN.
translation: 骨折がないか確認するため、X線検査が必要になるかもしれません。

english: We may need an ultrasound, CT scan, or MRI.
transliteration: cho-u-on-pa ken-sa, CT ken-sa, ma-ta wa MRI ken-sa ga hi-tsu-yo-u ni na-ru ka-mo shi-re-MASEN.
translation: 超音波検査、CT検査、またはMRI検査が必要になるかもしれません。

english: We may need to put your arm or leg in a splint.
transliteration: u-de ma-ta wa a-shi ni fu-ku-bo-ku o a-te-ru hi-tsu-yo-u ga a-ru ka-mo shi-re-MASEN.
translation: 腕または脚に副木を当てる必要があるかもしれません。

english: We may need to put on a cast.
transliteration: gi-pu-su o su-ru hi-tsu-yo-u ga a-ru ka-mo shi-re-MASEN.
translation: ギプスをする必要があるかもしれません。

english: We may need to take fluid from the joint with a needle.
transliteration: ha-ri o tsu-kat-te kan-SETSU ka-ra e-ki o nu-ku hi-tsu-yo-u ga a-ru ka-mo shi-re-MASEN.
translation: 針を使って関節から液を抜く必要があるかもしれません。

english: We may recommend physiotherapy.
transliteration: ri-ga-ku ryo-u-ho-u o o-su-su-me su-ru ko-to ga a-ri-MASU.
translation: 理学療法をおすすめすることがあります。

english: We will arrange an appointment with an orthopedic specialist.
transliteration: sei-KEI-ge-ka no sen-mon-i no shin-sa-tsu o te-ha-i shi-MASU.
translation: 整形外科の専門医の診察を手配します。

english: You may have a sprain, which means a ligament has been stretched or torn.
transliteration: ne-N-ZA ka-mo shi-re-MASEN. jin-TAI ga no-bi-ta-ri ki-re-ta-ri shi-ta jo-u-tai desu.
translation: 捻挫かもしれません。靭帯が伸びたり切れたりした状態です。

english: A fracture means a bone is broken or cracked.
transliteration: ko-setsu to wa, ho-ne ga o-re-ta-ri, hi-bi ga hai-tta-ri shi-ta jo-u-tai desu.
translation: 骨折とは、骨が折れたり、ひびが入ったりした状態です。

english: You may have inflammation of a tendon.
transliteration: ken ni en-sho-u ga o-ki-te i-ru ka-mo shi-re-MASEN.
translation: 腱に炎症が起きているかもしれません。

english: Please follow the weight-bearing instructions given to you.
transliteration: ta-i-ju-u o ka-ke-te yo-i han-I ni tsu-i-te, shi-ji sa-re-ta to-o-ri ni shi-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: 体重をかけてよい範囲について、指示されたとおりにしてください。

english: Use your crutches or walking aid as instructed.
transliteration: shi-ji sa-re-ta to-o-ri ni, ma-tsu-ba-zu-e ya ho-ko-u ho-jo-gu o tsu-kat-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: 指示されたとおりに、松葉杖や歩行補助具を使ってください。

english: Keep your cast or splint dry unless told otherwise.
transliteration: be-tsu no shi-ji ga na-i ka-gi-ri, gi-pu-su ya fu-ku-bo-ku o nu-ra-sa-na-i de ku-da-SAI.
translation: 別の指示がない限り、ギプスや副木を濡らさないでください。

english: Return urgently if you develop worsening pain, numbness, or cold fingers or toes.
transliteration: i-ta-mi ga tsu-yo-ku na-ru, shi-bi-re-ru, ma-ta wa yu-bi-sa-ki ya a-shi no yu-bi-sa-ki ga tsu-me-ta-ku na-tta ba-a-i wa, su-gu ni ju-shin shi-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: 痛みが強くなる、しびれる、または指先や足の指先が冷たくなった場合は、すぐに受診してください。

english: New bladder or bowel problems with back pain need emergency assessment.
transliteration: yo-u-tsu ni ku-wa-e-te, bo-u-ko-u ya cho-u no ha-ta-ra-ki ni a-ra-ta na mon-dai ga o-ki-ta ba-a-i wa, ky-u-ky-u de no shin-sa-tsu ga hi-tsu-yo-u desu.
translation: 腰痛に加えて、膀胱や腸の働きに新たな問題が起きた場合は、救急での診察が必要です。

english: We will discuss the results and treatment with a professional interpreter.
transliteration: sen-mon no tsu-u-ya-ku-sha o tsu-u-ji-te, ken-sa ke-kka to chi-ryo-u ni tsu-i-te o-ha-na-shi shi-MASU.
translation: 専門の通訳者を通じて、検査結果と治療についてお話しします。

english: When was the first day of your last period?
transliteration: sa-i-go no ge-k-ke-i ga ha-ji-ma-tta no wa nan-ga-tsu nan-ni-chi desu ka?
translation: 最後の月経が始まったのは何月何日ですか？

english: Are your periods regular?
transliteration: ge-k-ke-i wa ki-so-ku-te-ki desu ka?
translation: 月経は規則的ですか？

english: How many days are there between your periods?
transliteration: ge-k-ke-i to ge-k-ke-i no a-i-da wa nan-ni-chi a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: 月経と月経の間は何日ありますか？

english: How many days does your period last?
transliteration: ge-k-ke-i wa nan-ni-chi-kan tsu-zu-ki-MASU ka?
translation: 月経は何日間続きますか？

english: Have you missed a period?
transliteration: ge-k-ke-i ga ko-na-ka-tta ko-to wa a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: 月経が来なかったことはありますか？

english: Have your periods changed recently?
transliteration: sa-i-kin, ge-k-ke-i ni he-n-ka wa a-ri-MASHI-ta ka?
translation: 最近、月経に変化はありましたか？

english: Do you have painful cramps during your period?
transliteration: ge-k-ke-i-chu-u ni, i-ta-i ke-i-ren ga a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: 月経中に、痛いけいれんがありますか？

english: At what age did your periods start?
transliteration: ha-ji-me-te ge-k-ke-i ga a-tta no wa nan-sai no to-ki desu ka?
translation: 初めて月経があったのは何歳のときですか？

english: What brings you in today?
transliteration: kyo-u wa do-no yo-u na ko-to de rai-in sa-re-MASHI-ta ka?
translation: 今日はどのようなことで来院されましたか？

english: Is it okay if I ask some personal questions?
transliteration: ko-jin-te-ki na ko-to o i-ku-tsu ka o-ki-ki shi-te mo yo-ro-shi-i desu ka?
translation: 個人的なことをいくつかお聞きしてもよろしいですか？

english: Would you prefer a female clinician?
transliteration: jo-se-i no i-ryo-u ju-u-ji-sha o go-ki-bo-u desu ka?
translation: 女性の医療従事者をご希望ですか？

english: Would you like an interpreter?
transliteration: tsu-u-ya-ku o go-ki-bo-u desu ka?
translation: 通訳をご希望ですか？

english: Would you like a support person present?
transliteration: tsu-ki-so-i no ka-ta ni do-u-se-ki shi-te mo-ra-i-MASU ka?
translation: 付き添いの方に同席してもらいますか？

english: You can ask me to stop the examination at any time.
transliteration: shin-sa-tsu wa i-tsu de mo chu-u-shi su-ru yo-u o-tsu-ta-e i-ta-da-ke-MASU.
translation: 診察はいつでも中止するようお伝えいただけます。

english: Do I have your permission to continue?
transliteration: tsu-zu-ke-te mo yo-ro-shi-i desu ka?
translation: 続けてもよろしいですか？

english: What concerns you the most?
transliteration: na-ni ga i-chi-ban shi-n-pa-i desu ka?
translation: 何が一番心配ですか？

english: Are you bleeding more heavily than usual?
transliteration: i-tsu-mo yo-ri shu-kke-tsu-ryo-u ga o-o-i desu ka?
translation: いつもより出血量が多いですか？

english: How many pads or tampons do you use each day?
transliteration: i-chi-ni-chi ni na-pu-kin ya tan-po-n o nan-ko tsu-kai-MASU ka?
translation: 1日にナプキンやタンポンを何個使いますか？

english: Are you soaking through a pad in an hour?
transliteration: i-chi-ji-kan de na-pu-kin ka-ra chi ga mo-re-ru ho-do shu-kke-tsu shi-MASU ka?
translation: 1時間でナプキンから血が漏れるほど出血しますか？

english: Are you passing large blood clots?
transliteration: o-o-ki-na chi no ka-ta-ma-ri ga de-MASU ka?
translation: 大きな血の塊が出ますか？

english: Have you bled between periods?
transliteration: ge-k-ke-i to ge-k-ke-i no a-i-da ni shu-kke-tsu shi-ta ko-to wa a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: 月経と月経の間に出血したことはありますか？

english: Do you bleed after sex?
transliteration: sei-ko-u-i no a-to ni shu-kke-tsu shi-MASU ka?
translation: 性行為の後に出血しますか？

english: Have you had bleeding after menopause?
transliteration: hei-ke-i-go ni shu-kke-tsu shi-ta ko-to wa a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: 閉経後に出血したことはありますか？

english: Do you feel dizzy or faint when bleeding?
transliteration: shu-kke-tsu shi-te i-ru to-ki, me-ma-i ya ki ga to-o-ku na-ru kan-ji ga a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: 出血しているとき、めまいや気が遠くなる感じがありますか？

english: When did this bleeding begin?
transliteration: ko-no shu-kke-tsu wa i-tsu ha-ji-ma-ri-MASHI-ta ka?
translation: この出血はいつ始まりましたか？

english: Where is the pain?
transliteration: do-ko ga i-ta-mi-MASU ka?
translation: どこが痛みますか？

english: Is the pain on the right, left, or both sides?
transliteration: i-ta-mi wa mi-gi-ga-wa, hi-da-ri-ga-wa, so-re-to-mo ryo-u-ga-wa desu ka?
translation: 痛みは右側、左側、それとも両側ですか？

english: Did the pain start suddenly?
transliteration: i-ta-mi wa to-tsu-zen ha-ji-ma-ri-MASHI-ta ka?
translation: 痛みは突然始まりましたか？

english: Does the pain come and go or stay constant?
transliteration: i-ta-mi wa de-ta-ri ki-e-ta-ri shi-MASU ka, so-re-to-mo zu-tto tsu-zu-ki-MASU ka?
translation: 痛みは出たり消えたりしますか、それともずっと続きますか？

english: Does the pain spread to your back or groin?
transliteration: i-ta-mi wa se-na-ka ya so-ke-i-bu ni hi-ro-ga-ri-MASU ka?
translation: 痛みは背中や鼠径部に広がりますか？

english: Does the pain get worse during your period?
transliteration: ge-k-ke-i-chu-u ni i-ta-mi ga tsu-yo-ku na-ri-MASU ka?
translation: 月経中に痛みが強くなりますか？

english: Does it hurt during sex?
transliteration: sei-ko-u-i no to-ki ni i-ta-mi-MASU ka?
translation: 性行為のときに痛みますか？

english: Do you have unusual vaginal discharge?
transliteration: i-tsu-mo to chi-ga-u o-ri-mo-no ga a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: いつもと違うおりものがありますか？

english: Does the discharge have an unusual smell?
transliteration: o-ri-mo-no ni i-tsu-mo to chi-ga-u ni-o-i ga a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: おりものにいつもと違うにおいがありますか？

english: Do you have itching or burning around the vagina?
transliteration: chi-tsu no ma-wa-ri ni ka-yu-mi ya hi-ri-hi-ri su-ru kan-ji ga a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: 膣の周りにかゆみやヒリヒリする感じがありますか？

english: Do you have pain or burning when you urinate?
transliteration: ha-i-nyo-u-ji ni i-ta-mi ya hi-ri-hi-ri su-ru kan-ji ga a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: 排尿時に痛みやヒリヒリする感じがありますか？

english: Are you currently sexually active?
transliteration: gen-zai, sei-ko-u-i o shi-te i-MASU ka?
translation: 現在、性行為をしていますか？

english: Do you have sex with men, women, or people of other genders?
transliteration: dan-sei, jo-sei, ma-ta wa so-no-ta no sei-be-tsu no ka-ta to sei-ko-u-i o shi-MASU ka?
translation: 男性、女性、またはその他の性別の方と性行為をしますか？

english: Do you use condoms?
transliteration: kon-do-mu o tsu-kai-MASU ka?
translation: コンドームを使いますか？

english: Have you had a new sexual partner recently?
transliteration: sa-i-kin, a-ta-ra-shi-i sei-ko-u-i no a-i-te ga de-ki-MASHI-ta ka?
translation: 最近、新しい性行為の相手ができましたか？

english: Have you ever had a sexually transmitted infection?
transliteration: sei-kan-sen-sho-u ni ka-ka-tta ko-to wa a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: 性感染症にかかったことはありますか？

english: Would you like testing for sexually transmitted infections?
transliteration: sei-kan-sen-sho-u no ken-sa o go-ki-bo-u desu ka?
translation: 性感染症の検査をご希望ですか？

english: Has a partner told you they have an infection?
transliteration: pa-a-to-na-a ka-ra, kan-sen-sho-u ni ka-ka-tta to ki-i-ta ko-to ga a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: パートナーから、感染症にかかったと聞いたことがありますか？

english: Do you feel safe in your relationship?
transliteration: pa-a-to-na-a to-no kan-ke-i de, an-zen da to kan-ji-te i-MASU ka?
translation: パートナーとの関係で、安全だと感じていますか？

english: Are you using any birth control?
transliteration: gen-zai, hi-nin o shi-te i-MASU ka?
translation: 現在、避妊をしていますか？

english: Which method of contraception do you use?
transliteration: do-no hi-nin ho-u-ho-u o tsu-kat-te i-MASU ka?
translation: どの避妊方法を使っていますか？

english: Do you take birth control pills?
transliteration: ke-i-ko-u hi-nin-ya-ku o non-de i-MASU ka?
translation: 経口避妊薬を飲んでいますか？

english: Do you have an intrauterine device or IUD?
transliteration: shi-kyu-u-na-i hi-nin-gu (IUD) o tsu-kat-te i-MASU ka?
translation: 子宮内避妊具（IUD）を使っていますか？

english: Have you missed any birth control pills?
transliteration: hi-nin-ya-ku o no-mi-wa-su-re-ta ko-to wa a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: 避妊薬を飲み忘れたことはありますか？

english: Are you hoping to become pregnant?
transliteration: nin-shin o ki-bo-u shi-te i-MASU ka?
translation: 妊娠を希望していますか？

english: Would you like to discuss contraception options?
transliteration: hi-nin ho-u-ho-u ni tsu-i-te so-u-dan shi-ta-i desu ka?
translation: 避妊方法について相談したいですか？

english: Have you used emergency contraception recently?
transliteration: sa-i-kin, kin-kyu-u hi-nin-ya-ku o tsu-kai-MASHI-ta ka?
translation: 最近、緊急避妊薬を使いましたか？

english: Is there any chance you could be pregnant?
transliteration: nin-shin shi-te i-ru ka-no-u-se-i wa a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: 妊娠している可能性はありますか？

english: Have you taken a pregnancy test?
transliteration: nin-shin ken-sa o u-ke-MASHI-ta ka?
translation: 妊娠検査を受けましたか？

english: Was your pregnancy test positive?
transliteration: nin-shin ken-sa no ke-kka wa yo-u-se-i desu ka?
translation: 妊娠検査の結果は陽性でしたか？

english: How many weeks pregnant are you?
transliteration: nin-shin nan-shu-u desu ka?
translation: 妊娠何週ですか？

english: Do you know your expected due date?
transliteration: shu-ssan yo-te-i-bi o go-zon-ji desu ka?
translation: 出産予定日をご存じですか？

english: Have you had an ultrasound during this pregnancy?
transliteration: kon-ka-i no nin-shin-chu-u ni cho-u-on-pa ken-sa o u-ke-MASHI-ta ka?
translation: 今回の妊娠中に超音波検査を受けましたか？

english: Was this pregnancy planned?
transliteration: kon-ka-i no nin-shin wa ke-i-ka-ku shi-te i-ta mo-no desu ka?
translation: 今回の妊娠は計画していたものですか？

english: How are you feeling about this pregnancy?
transliteration: kon-ka-i no nin-shin ni tsu-i-te, do-no yo-u ni kan-ji-te i-MASU ka?
translation: 今回の妊娠について、どのように感じていますか？

english: How many times have you been pregnant?
transliteration: ko-re ma-de ni nan-ka-i nin-shin shi-MASHI-ta ka?
translation: これまでに何回妊娠しましたか？

english: How many children have you given birth to?
transliteration: ko-re ma-de ni nan-nin no o-ko-san o shu-ssan shi-MASHI-ta ka?
translation: これまでに何人のお子さんを出産しましたか？

english: Have you had a vaginal delivery before?
transliteration: ko-re ma-de ni kei-chi-tsu bun-ben o shi-ta ko-to ga a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: これまでに経腟分娩をしたことがありますか？

english: Have you had a cesarean section before?
transliteration: ko-re ma-de ni te-i-o-u se-k-kai o u-ke-ta ko-to ga a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: これまでに帝王切開を受けたことがありますか？

english: Have you ever had a miscarriage?
transliteration: ko-re ma-de ni ryu-u-zan shi-ta ko-to ga a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: これまでに流産したことがありますか？

english: Have you ever had an abortion?
transliteration: ko-re ma-de ni chu-u-ze-tsu shi-ta ko-to ga a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: これまでに中絶したことがありますか？

english: Have you ever had an ectopic pregnancy?
transliteration: ko-re ma-de ni shi-kyu-u-gai nin-shin o shi-ta ko-to ga a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: これまでに子宮外妊娠をしたことがありますか？

english: Have you had a premature birth?
transliteration: so-u-zan o shi-ta ko-to ga a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: 早産をしたことがありますか？

english: Did you have any complications in a previous pregnancy?
transliteration: i-zeN no nin-shin de na-ni-ka ga-p-pei-sho-u ga a-ri-MASHI-ta ka?
translation: 以前の妊娠で何か合併症がありましたか？

english: Have you had nausea or vomiting?
transliteration: ha-ki-ke ya o-u-to-u wa a-ri-MASHI-ta ka?
translation: 吐き気や嘔吐はありましたか？

english: Are you able to keep food and water down?
transliteration: ta-be-mo-no ya mi-zu o ha-ka-zu ni in-sho-ku de-ki-MASU ka?
translation: 食べ物や水を吐かずに飲食できますか？

english: Have you noticed swelling in your hands or face?
transliteration: te ya kao no mu-ku-mi ni ki-zu-ki-MASHI-ta ka?
translation: 手や顔のむくみに気づきましたか？

english: Have you had headaches or changes in your vision?
transliteration: zu-tsu-u ya mi-e-ka-ta no he-n-ka wa a-ri-MASHI-ta ka?
translation: 頭痛や見え方の変化はありましたか？

english: Do you have pain in the upper right part of your abdomen?
transliteration: o-na-ka no mi-gi-u-e no a-ta-ri ni i-ta-mi ga a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: お腹の右上のあたりに痛みがありますか？

english: Have you felt the baby move today?
transliteration: kyo-u wa a-ka-chan ga u-go-ku no o kan-ji-MASHI-ta ka?
translation: 今日は赤ちゃんが動くのを感じましたか？

english: Is the baby moving less than usual?
transliteration: a-ka-chan no u-go-ki wa i-tsu-mo yo-ri su-ku-na-i desu ka?
translation: 赤ちゃんの動きはいつもより少ないですか？

english: Have you had any vaginal bleeding during pregnancy?
transliteration: nin-shin-chu-u ni sei-ki ka-ra shu-kke-tsu shi-ta ko-to ga a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: 妊娠中に性器から出血したことがありますか？

english: Have you been taking prenatal vitamins or folic acid?
transliteration: nin-pu-yo-u bi-ta-min-za-i ya yo-u-san o non-de i-MASU ka?
translation: 妊婦用ビタミン剤や葉酸を飲んでいますか？

english: Have you been told you have gestational diabetes?
transliteration: nin-shin-to-u-nyo-u-byo-u to shin-dan sa-re-ta to i-wa-re-ta ko-to ga a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: 妊娠糖尿病と診断されたと言われたことがありますか？

english: Are you having contractions?
transliteration: jin-tsu-u ga a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: 陣痛がありますか？

english: How far apart are the contractions?
transliteration: jin-tsu-u wa nan-pun o-ki ni ki-MASU ka?
translation: 陣痛は何分おきに来ますか？

english: How long does each contraction last?
transliteration: jin-tsu-u wa ik-kai ni tsu-ki do-no ku-ra-i tsu-zu-ki-MASU ka?
translation: 陣痛は一回につきどのくらい続きますか？

english: Has your water broken?
transliteration: ha-su-i shi-MASHI-ta ka?
translation: 破水しましたか？

english: What time did the fluid start leaking?
transliteration: e-ki-tai ga mo-re-ha-ji-me-ta no wa nan-ji desu ka?
translation: 液体が漏れ始めたのは何時ですか？

english: What colour is the fluid?
transliteration: so-no e-ki-tai wa na-ni-i-ro desu ka?
translation: その液体は何色ですか？

english: Do you feel pressure or an urge to push?
transliteration: at-su-pa-ku-kan ya, i-ki-mi-ta-i kan-ji ga a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: 圧迫感や、いきみたい感じがありますか？

english: Would you like to discuss pain relief options?
transliteration: i-ta-mi o ya-wa-ra-ge-ru ho-u-ho-u ni tsu-i-te so-u-dan shi-ta-i desu ka?
translation: 痛みを和らげる方法について相談したいですか？

english: We will monitor your baby’s heartbeat.
transliteration: a-ka-chan no shin-pa-ku o ka-ku-nin shi-MASU.
translation: 赤ちゃんの心拍を確認します。

english: When did you give birth?
transliteration: shu-ssan shi-ta no wa i-tsu desu ka?
translation: 出産したのはいつですか？

english: How much bleeding have you had since delivery?
transliteration: shu-ssan-go, do-no ku-ra-i shu-kke-tsu shi-MASHI-ta ka?
translation: 出産後、どのくらい出血しましたか？

english: Have you had a fever since delivery?
transliteration: shu-ssan-go ni ne-tsu ga de-MASHI-ta ka?
translation: 出産後に熱が出ましたか？

english: Do you have pain or redness around your incision or stitches?
transliteration: se-k-kai shi-ta to-ko-ro ya nu-i-tta to-ko-ro no ma-wa-ri ni i-ta-mi ya a-ka-mi ga a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: 切開したところや縫ったところの周りに痛みや赤みがありますか？

english: Are you breastfeeding or chestfeeding?
transliteration: bo-nyu-u ma-ta wa mu-ne ka-ra ju-nyu-u shi-te i-MASU ka?
translation: 母乳または胸から授乳していますか？

english: Is feeding painful?
transliteration: ju-nyu-u su-ru to i-ta-mi-MASU ka?
translation: 授乳すると痛みますか？

english: Have you noticed breast redness or fever?
transliteration: mu-ne no a-ka-mi ya hatsu-ne-tsu ni ki-zu-ki-MASHI-ta ka?
translation: 胸の赤みや発熱に気づきましたか？

english: How has your mood been since delivery?
transliteration: shu-ssan-go, ki-bun wa i-ka-ga desu ka?
translation: 出産後、気分はいかがですか？

english: Have you had thoughts of harming yourself or your baby?
transliteration: ji-bun ya a-ka-chan o ki-zu-tsu-ke-ta-i to om-tta ko-to ga a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: 自分や赤ちゃんを傷つけたいと思ったことがありますか？

english: Have your periods stopped completely?
transliteration: se-i-ri wa kan-zen ni to-ma-ri-MASHI-ta ka?
translation: 生理は完全に止まりましたか？

english: When was your last period?
transliteration: sa-i-go no se-i-ri wa i-tsu deshi-ta ka?
translation: 最後の生理はいつでしたか？

english: Do you have hot flashes?
transliteration: ho-te-ri ga a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: ほてりがありますか？

english: Do you have night sweats?
transliteration: ne-a-se o ka-ki-MASU ka?
translation: 寝汗をかきますか？

english: Have you noticed vaginal dryness?
transliteration: chi-tsu no kan-so-u ni ki-zu-ki-MASHI-ta ka?
translation: 膣の乾燥に気づきましたか？

english: Have you noticed changes in your sleep or mood?
transliteration: su-i-min ya ki-bun no he-n-ka ni ki-zu-ki-MASHI-ta ka?
translation: 睡眠や気分の変化に気づきましたか？

english: Are you using hormone therapy?
transliteration: ho-ru-mon ryo-u-ho-u o u-ke-te i-MASU ka?
translation: ホルモン療法を受けていますか？

english: How long have you been trying to become pregnant?
transliteration: nin-shin o ko-ko-ro-mi-te do-no ku-ra-i ni na-ri-MASU ka?
translation: 妊娠を試みてどのくらいになりますか？

english: Have you had any fertility tests or treatment?
transliteration: nin-shin shi-ya-su-sa ni tsu-i-te ken-sa ya chi-ryo-u o u-ke-ta ko-to ga a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: 妊娠しやすさについて検査や治療を受けたことがありますか？

english: Have you been diagnosed with endometriosis?
transliteration: shi-kyu-u-na-i-ma-ku-sho-u to shin-dan sa-re-ta ko-to ga a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: 子宮内膜症と診断されたことがありますか？

english: Have you been diagnosed with polycystic ovary syndrome?
transliteration: ta-no-u-ho-u-sei-ran-so-u-sho-u-ko-u-gun to shin-dan sa-re-ta ko-to ga a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: 多嚢胞性卵巣症候群と診断されたことがありますか？

english: Have you ever had ovarian cysts or fibroids?
transliteration: ran-so-u-no-u-ho-u ya shi-kyu-u-kin-shu ga de-ki-ta ko-to ga a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: 卵巣嚢胞や子宮筋腫ができたことがありますか？

english: Have you had surgery on your uterus or ovaries?
transliteration: shi-kyu-u ya ran-so-u no shu-ju-tsu o u-ke-ta ko-to ga a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: 子宮や卵巣の手術を受けたことがありますか？

english: Has anyone in your family had breast or ovarian cancer?
transliteration: go-ka-zo-ku ni nyu-u-gan ya ran-so-u-gan ni na-tta ka-ta wa i-MASU ka?
translation: ご家族に乳がんや卵巣がんになった方はいますか？

english: Are you having severe or sudden abdominal pain?
transliteration: tsu-yo-i fu-ku-tsu-u ya to-tsu-zen no fu-ku-tsu-u ga a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: 強い腹痛や突然の腹痛がありますか？

english: Have you fainted or nearly fainted?
transliteration: shi-sshin shi-ta-ri, shi-sshin shi-so-u ni na-tta-ri shi-MASHI-ta ka?
translation: 失神したり、失神しそうになったりしましたか？

english: Are you bleeding heavily right now?
transliteration: i-ma, shu-kke-tsu ga o-o-i desu ka?
translation: 今、出血が多いですか？

english: Do you have shoulder-tip pain with abdominal pain?
transliteration: o-na-ka no i-ta-mi to is-sho ni ka-ta-sa-ki no i-ta-mi ga a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: お腹の痛みと一緒に肩先の痛みがありますか？

english: Do you have a severe headache or blurred vision during pregnancy?
transliteration: nin-shin-chu-u ni hi-do-i zu-tsu-u ya shi-ka-i no bo-ya-ke ga a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: 妊娠中にひどい頭痛や視界のぼやけがありますか？

english: Have you had a seizure?
transliteration: ke-i-ren o o-ko-shi-ta ko-to ga a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: けいれんを起こしたことがありますか？

english: Do you have chest pain or sudden shortness of breath?
transliteration: mu-ne no i-ta-mi ya to-tsu-zen no i-ki-gi-re ga a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: 胸の痛みや突然の息切れがありますか？

english: Do you have a fever with severe pelvic pain?
transliteration: tsu-yo-i ko-tsu-ban no i-ta-mi to to-mo ni ne-tsu ga a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: 強い骨盤の痛みとともに熱がありますか？

english: We need to assess you urgently.
transliteration: i-so-i-de shin-sa-tsu su-ru hi-tsu-yo-u ga a-ri-MASU.
translation: 急いで診察する必要があります。

english: I would like to examine your abdomen. Is that okay?
transliteration: o-na-ka o shin-sa-tsu shi-ta-i no desu ga, yo-ro-shi-i desu ka?
translation: お腹を診察したいのですが、よろしいですか？

english: Please lie on your back.
transliteration: a-o-mu-ke ni ne-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: 仰向けに寝てください。

english: Please tell me if anything hurts.
transliteration: i-ta-i to-ko-ro ga a-re-ba o-shi-e-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: 痛いところがあれば教えてください。

english: A pelvic examination may help us understand your symptoms.
transliteration: sho-u-jo-u o ri-ka-i su-ru ta-me ni, ko-tsu-ban no shin-sa-tsu ga ya-ku-da-tsu ko-to ga a-ri-MASU.
translation: 症状を理解するために、骨盤の診察が役立つことがあります。

english: Would you consent to an internal pelvic examination?
transliteration: na-i-shin o u-ke-te i-ta-da-ke-MASU ka?
translation: 内診を受けていただけますか？

english: A chaperone can be present during the examination.
transliteration: shin-sa-tsu-chu-u ni tsu-ki-so-i no hi-to ga do-u-se-ki de-ki-MASU.
translation: 診察中に付き添いの人が同席できます。

english: I will explain each step before I do it.
transliteration: o-ko-na-u ma-e ni, so-re-zo-re no te-ju-n o setsu-me-i shi-MASU.
translation: 行う前に、それぞれの手順を説明します。

english: Please bend your knees and relax your legs.
transliteration: hi-ZA o ma-ge-te, a-shi no chi-ka-ra o nu-i-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: 膝を曲げて、脚の力を抜いてください。

english: I will use a speculum to look at the cervix.
transliteration: chi-tsu-kyo-u o tsu-kat-te shi-kyu-u-KEI-bu o mi-MASU.
translation: 腟鏡を使って子宮頸部を見ます。

english: Would you like me to stop?
transliteration: chu-u-shi shi-ma-sho-u ka?
translation: 中止しましょうか？

english: We will do a urine pregnancy test.
transliteration: nyo-u de nin-shin ken-sa o shi-MASU.
translation: 尿で妊娠検査をします。

english: We may need a blood test.
transliteration: ke-tsu-e-ki ken-sa ga hi-tsu-yo-u ni na-ru ko-to ga a-ri-MASU.
translation: 血液検査が必要になることがあります。

english: We will check your blood count.
transliteration: kek-kyu-u-su-u o shi-ra-be-MASU.
translation: 血球数を調べます。

english: We may recommend a pelvic ultrasound.
transliteration: ko-tsu-ban no cho-u-on-pa ken-sa o o-su-su-me su-ru ko-to ga a-ri-MASU.
translation: 骨盤の超音波検査をおすすめすることがあります。

english: The ultrasound may be done over the abdomen or through the vagina.
transliteration: cho-u-on-pa ken-sa wa, o-na-ka no u-e ka-ra, ma-ta wa chi-tsu ka-ra o-ko-na-u ko-to ga a-ri-MASU.
translation: 超音波検査は、お腹の上から、または膣から行うことがあります。

english: Have you had a Pap test or cervical screening before?
transliteration: ko-re ma-de ni pap-pu tesu-to ya shi-kyu-u-KEI gan ken-shin o u-ke-ta ko-to ga a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: これまでにパップテストや子宮頸がん検診を受けたことがありますか？

english: We can test for sexually transmitted infections.
transliteration: sei-kan-sen-sho-u no ken-sa ga de-ki-MASU.
translation: 性感染症の検査ができます。

english: We may take a vaginal swab.
transliteration: chi-tsu ka-ra ken-tai o sa-i-shu su-ru ko-to ga a-ri-MASU.
translation: 膣から検体を採取することがあります。

english: We may recommend a biopsy to test a small tissue sample.
transliteration: chi-i-sa-na so-shi-ki no san-pu-ru o tot-te shi-ra-be-ru sei-KE-n o o-su-su-me su-ru ko-to ga a-ri-MASU.
translation: 小さな組織のサンプルを採って調べる生検をおすすめすることがあります。

english: Let us discuss the treatment options together.
transliteration: chi-ryo-u no sen-ta-ku-shi ni tsu-i-te is-sho ni so-u-dan shi-ma-sho-u.
translation: 治療の選択肢について一緒に相談しましょう。

english: Do you have any concerns about taking this medication?
transliteration: ko-no ku-su-ri o no-mu ko-to ni tsu-i-te, shi-n-pa-i na ko-to wa a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: この薬を飲むことについて、心配なことはありますか？

english: Have you taken hormone treatment before?
transliteration: ko-re ma-de ni ho-ru-mon chi-ryo-u o u-ke-ta ko-to ga a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: これまでにホルモン治療を受けたことがありますか？

english: How long have you been taking this medication?
transliteration: ko-no ku-su-ri o no-mi-ha-ji-me-te do-no ku-ra-i ni na-ri-MASU ka?
translation: この薬を飲み始めてどのくらいになりますか？

english: We can arrange a follow-up appointment.
transliteration: sa-i-shin no yo-ya-ku o to-ru ko-to ga de-ki-MASU.
translation: 再診の予約を取ることができます。

english: Please seek urgent care if you have severe pain, heavy bleeding, or fainting.
transliteration: tsu-yo-i i-ta-mi, ta-ryo-u no shu-kke-tsu, ma-ta wa shi-sshin ga a-re-ba, su-gu ni i-ryo-u ki-kan o ju-shin shi-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: 強い痛み、多量の出血、または失神があれば、すぐに医療機関を受診してください。

english: What questions do you have?
transliteration: na-ni-ka shi-tsu-mon wa a-ri-MASU ka?
translation: 何か質問はありますか？

english: Hello, I am part of the surgical team.
transliteration: kon-ni-chi-wa, wa-ta-shi wa ge-ka chi-i-mu no i-chi-in desu.
translation: こんにちは、私は外科チームの一員です。

english: What brings you to the hospital today?
transliteration: kyo-u wa do-u sa-re-MASHI-ta ka?
translation: 今日はどうされましたか？

english: Can you tell me what is troubling you most?
transliteration: i-chi-ban o-ko-ma-ri no ko-to o o-shi-e-te i-ta-da-ke-MASU ka?
translation: いちばんお困りのことを教えていただけますか？

english: May I ask you some questions about your symptoms?
transliteration: sho-u-jo-u ni tsu-i-te i-ku-tsu-ka shi-tsu-mon shi-te mo yo-ro-shi-i desu ka?
translation: 症状についていくつか質問してもよろしいですか？

english: Is it okay if I examine you?
transliteration: shin-sa-tsu shi-te mo yo-ro-shi-i desu ka?
translation: 診察してもよろしいですか？

english: Please tell me if anything hurts during the examination.
transliteration: shin-sa-tsu-chu-u ni i-ta-i to-ko-ro ga a-re-ba o-shi-e-te ku-da-SAI.
translation: 診察中に痛いところがあれば教えてください。

english: Would you like a chaperone present for the examination?
transliteration: sheen-sah-tsu no toh-kee, tsook-ee-saw-ee no hee-toh nee doh-seh-kee shee-teh moh-rah-ee-mahs kah?
translation: 診察のとき、付き添いの人に同席してもらいますか？

english: When did the pain start?
transliteration: ee-tah-mee wah ee-tsu hah-jah-ree-mah-shee-tah kah?
translation: 痛みはいつ始まりましたか？

english: Where is the pain the worst?
transliteration: doh-koh gah ee-chee-bahn ee-tah-ee deh-soo kah?
translation: どこが一番痛いですか？

english: Can you point to where it hurts?
transliteration: ee-tah-ee toh-koh-roh oh yoo-bee deh shee-meh-teh moh-rah-eh-mahs kah?
translation: 痛いところを指で示してもらえますか？

english: Did the pain start suddenly or gradually?
transliteration: ee-tah-mee wah toh-tsu-zahn hah-jah-ree-mah-shee-tah kah, soh-reh toh-moh yook-oo-joh nee hah-jah-ree-mah-shee-tah kah?
translation: 痛みは突然始まりましたか、それとも徐々に始まりましたか？

english: Is the pain constant or does it come and go?
transliteration: ee-tah-mee wah zooht-toh tsu-zoo-ee-teh ee-mahs kah, soh-reh toh-moh deh-tah-ree oh-sah-maht-tah-ree shee-mahs kah?
translation: 痛みはずっと続いていますか、それとも出たり治まったりしますか？

english: Does the pain move anywhere else?
transliteration: ee-tah-mee wah hoh-kah no toh-koh-roh nee hee-roh-gah-ree-mahs kah?
translation: 痛みはほかのところに広がりますか？

english: Does the pain move toward your belly button?
transliteration: ee-tah-mee wah oh-heh-soh no hoh-oh nee hee-roh-gah-ree-mahs kah?
translation: 痛みはおへそのほうに広がりますか？

english: Does the pain move toward your back?
transliteration: ee-tah-mee wah seh-nah-kah no hoh-oh nee hee-roh-gah-ree-mahs kah?
translation: 痛みは背中のほうに広がりますか？

english: Does eating make the pain worse?
transliteration: tah-beh-roo toh ee-tah-mee gah tsuy-oo-koo nah-ree-mahs kah?
translation: 食べると痛みが強くなりますか？

english: Does moving or coughing make the pain worse?
transliteration: oo-go-ee-tah-ree, seh-kee oh shee-tah-ree soo-roo toh ee-tah-mee gah tsuy-oo-koo nah-ree-mahs kah?
translation: 動いたり、せきをしたりすると痛みが強くなりますか？

english: How severe is the pain from zero to ten?
transliteration: ee-tah-mee no tsuy-sah oh zay-roh kah-rah joo-oh deh ah-rah-soo toh, doh-noh koo-rah-ee deh-soo kah?
translation: 痛みの強さを0から10で表すと、どのくらいですか？

english: Have you been feeling nauseated?
transliteration: hah-kee-keh wah ah-ree-mahs kah?
translation: 吐き気はありますか？

english: Have you vomited?
transliteration: hah-kee-mah-shee-tah kah?
translation: 吐きましたか？

english: Have you vomited blood?
transliteration: chee oh hah-kee-mah-shee-tah kah?
translation: 血を吐きましたか？

english: Is your abdomen swollen or bloated?
transliteration: oh-nah-kah gah hah-tteh ee-mahs kah?
translation: お腹が張っていますか？

english: When did you last pass stool?
transliteration: sah-ee-goh nee behn gah deh-tah no wah ee-tsu deh-soo kah?
translation: 最後に便が出たのはいつですか？

english: Are you able to pass gas?
transliteration: oh-nah-rah wah deh-mahs kah?
translation: おならは出ますか？

english: Have you had diarrhea or constipation?
transliteration: geh-ree yah behn-pee wah ah-ree-mah-shee-tah kah?
translation: 下痢や便秘はありましたか？

english: Have you noticed blood in your stool?
transliteration: beh-n nee chee gah mah-jeet-teh ee-roo koh-toh nee kee-zoo-kee-mah-shee-tah kah?
translation: 便に血が混じっていることに気づきましたか？

english: Have your stools been black or tar-like?
transliteration: beh-n gah koo-roh-koo nah-ht-tah-ree, tah-roo noh yoh-oh nee nah-ht-tah-ree shee-mah-shee-tah kah?
translation: 便が黒くなったり、タールのようになったりしましたか？

english: Have you lost your appetite?
transliteration: shoh-koo-yookoo gah nah-koo nah-ree-mah-shee-tah kah?
translation: 食欲がなくなりましたか？

english: Have you lost weight without trying?
transliteration: took-nee nah-nee moh shee-teh ee-nah-ee noh nee tah-ee-joo-oo gah heh-ree-mah-shee-tah kah?
translation: 特に何もしていないのに体重が減りましたか？

english: Does it hurt in the upper right part of your abdomen?
transliteration: oh-nah-kah no mee-gee oo-eh no ah-tah-ree gah ee-tah-mee-mah-soo kah?
translation: お腹の右上のあたりが痛みますか？

english: Does the pain get worse after fatty meals?
transliteration: ah-brah-koh-ee shoh-koo-jee no ah-toh nee ee-tah-mee gah tsuy-oo-koo nah-ree-mahs kah?
translation: 脂っこい食事のあとに痛みが強くなりますか？

english: Have you ever had gallstones?
transliteration: tah-n-seh-kee gah deh-kee-tah koh-toh wah ah-ree-mahs kah?
translation: 胆石ができたことはありますか？

english: Have you had your gallbladder removed?
transliteration: tah-n-noh-oh oh teh-kee-shoo-tsee-tah koh-toh ah-ree-mahs kah?
translation: 胆のうを摘出したことがありますか？

english: Have your eyes or skin turned yellow?
transliteration: meh yah hah-dah gah kee-ee-roh-koo nah-ree-mah-shee-tah kah?
translation: 目や皮膚が黄色くなりましたか？

english: Has your urine become dark?
transliteration: nee-oh no ee-roh gah koh-ee-koo nah-ree-mah-shee-tah kah?
translation: 尿の色が濃くなりましたか？

english: Have your stools become unusually pale?
transliteration: beh-n no ee-roh gah ee-tsu-moh yoh-ree kah-nah-ree oo-sookoo nah-ree-mah-shee-tah kah?
translation: 便の色がいつもよりかなり薄くなりましたか？

english: Have you ever had pancreatitis?
transliteration: swee-ehn nee nah-ht-tah koh-toh ah-ree-mahs kah?
translation: 膵炎になったことがありますか？

english: When did you first notice the lump?
transliteration: shee-koh-ree nee sah-ee-shoh nee kee-zoo-ee-tah no wah ee-tsu deh-soo kah?
translation: しこりに最初に気づいたのはいつですか？

english: Has the lump grown larger?
transliteration: shee-koh-ree wah oh-oh-kee-koo nah-ree-mah-shee-tah kah?
translation: しこりは大きくなりましたか？

english: Is the lump painful?
transliteration: shee-koh-ree wah ee-tah-mee-mahs kah?
translation: しこりは痛みますか？

english: Is the lump red or warm?
transliteration: shee-koh-ree no toh-koh-roh gah ah-kah-koo nah-ht-tah-ree, neh-tsu oh moh-ht-tah-ree shee-teh ee-mahs kah?
translation: しこりのところが赤くなったり、熱を持ったりしていますか？

english: Is any pus or fluid coming out of the lump?
transliteration: shee-koh-ree kah-rah oo-myee yah eh-kee-tah-ee gah deh-teh ee-mahs kah?
translation: しこりから膿や液体が出ていますか？

english: Does the lump get bigger when you cough or strain?
transliteration: seh-kee oh shee-tah-ree, chah-kah-rah oh ee-reh-tah-ree soo-roo toh, shee-koh-ree gah oh-oh-kee-koo nah-ree-mahs kah?
translation: せきをしたり、力を入れたりすると、しこりが大きくなりますか？

english: Does the lump disappear when you lie down?
transliteration: yoh-kah nee nah-roo toh, shee-koh-ree wah keh-shee-mahs kah?
translation: 横になると、しこりは消えますか？

english: Can you gently push the lump back in?
transliteration: shee-koh-ree oh soh-ht-toh oh-shee-teh moh-doh-seh-mahs kah?
translation: しこりをそっと押して戻せますか？

english: Have you had a hernia before?
transliteration: ee-zahn, heh-roo-nee-ah nee nah-ht-tah koh-toh ah-ree-mahs kah?
translation: 以前、ヘルニアになったことがありますか？

english: Have you ever had a cyst or abscess drained?
transliteration: noh-oh-hoh yah noh-yoh-soh no oo-myee oh dah-soo shee-choo oh oo-keh-tah koh-toh ah-ree-mahs kah?
translation: 嚢胞や膿瘍の膿を出す処置を受けたことがありますか？

english: Have you noticed a lump in your breast?
transliteration: nyoo-boh-oo nee shee-koh-ree gah ah-roo koh-toh nee kee-zoo-kee-mah-shee-tah kah?
translation: 乳房にしこりがあることに気づきましたか？

english: Have you noticed any change in breast size or shape?
transliteration: nyoo-boh-oo no oh-oh-kee-sah yah kah-tah-chee nee hehn-kah gah ah-ree-mah-shee-tah kah?
translation: 乳房の大きさや形に変化がありましたか？

english: Have you noticed any discharge from your nipple?
transliteration: chee-koo-bee kah-rah buhn-pee-too-boo gah deh-roo koh-toh nee kee-zoo-kee-mah-shee-tah kah?
translation: 乳首から分泌物が出ることに気づきましたか？

english: Is there blood in the nipple discharge?
transliteration: chee-koo-bee kah-rah no buhn-pee-too-boo nee chee gah mah-jeet-teh ee-mahs kah?
translation: 乳首からの分泌物に血が混じっていますか？

english: Have you noticed any skin changes on your breast?
transliteration: nyoo-boh-oo no hah-dah nee hehn-kah gah ah-ree-mah-shee-tah kah?
translation: 乳房の皮膚に変化がありましたか？

english: Has anyone in your family had breast cancer?
transliteration: goh-kah-zook-kee nee nyoo-gahn nee nah-ht-tah kah-tah wah ee-mahs kah?
translation: ご家族に乳がんになった方はいますか？

english: Have you had a mammogram or breast ultrasound?
transliteration: mahn-moh-grah-fee yah nyoo-boh-oo no choh-oh-ehn-pah-kee keh-sah oh oo-keh-tah koh-toh ah-ree-mahs kah?
translation: マンモグラフィーや乳房の超音波検査を受けたことがありますか？

english: Do you have pain around your anus?
transliteration: koh-mohn no mah-wah-ree gah ee-tah-mee-mahs kah?
translation: 肛門の周りが痛みますか？

english: Does it hurt when you pass stool?
transliteration: beh-n oh soo-roo toh-kee nee ee-tah-mee-mahs kah?
translation: 便をするときに痛みますか？

english: Have you noticed blood on the toilet paper?
transliteration: toh-ee-reht-toh peh-pah nee chee gah tsoo-ee-teh ee-roo koh-toh nee kee-zoo-kee-mah-shee-tah kah?
translation: トイレットペーパーに血がついていることに気づきましたか？

english: Have you noticed a lump near your anus?
transliteration: koh-mohn no chee-kah-koo nee shee-koh-ree gah ah-roo koh-toh nee kee-zoo-kee-mah-shee-tah kah?
translation: 肛門の近くにしこりがあることに気づきましたか？

english: Is there any discharge or pus near your anus?
transliteration: koh-mohn no chee-kah-koo kah-rah buhn-pee-too-boo yah oo-myee gah deh-teh ee-mahs kah?
translation: 肛門の近くから分泌物や膿が出ていますか？

english: Have you ever had hemorrhoids or piles?
transliteration: jee nee nah-ht-tah koh-toh ah-ree-mahs kah?
translation: 痔になったことがありますか？

english: Have you ever had an anal fissure?
transliteration: koh-mohn reh-shoh-oh nee nah-ht-tah koh-toh ah-ree-mahs kah?
translation: 肛門裂傷になったことがありますか？

english: Have you had surgery before?
transliteration: shoo-jootsoo oh oo-keh-tah koh-toh ah-ree-mahs kah?
translation: 手術を受けたことがありますか？

english: What operation did you have?
transliteration: doh-noh yoh-oh nah shoo-jootsoo oh oo-keh-mah-shee-tah kah?
translation: どのような手術を受けましたか？

english: When was your last operation?
transliteration: sah-ee-goh nee shoo-jootsoo oh oo-keh-tah no wah ee-tsu deh-soo kah?
translation: 最後に手術を受けたのはいつですか？

english: Have you had surgery on your abdomen?
transliteration: oh-nah-kah no shoo-jootsoo oh oo-keh-tah koh-toh ah-ree-mahs kah?
translation: お腹の手術を受けたことがありますか？

english: Have you had your appendix removed?
transliteration: chuu-soh oh see-chee-joo-tah koh-toh ah-ree-mahs kah?
translation: 虫垂を切除したことがありますか？

english: Have you ever had problems after surgery?
transliteration: shoo-jootsoo no ah-toh nee moh-ndah-ee gah oh-kee-tah koh-toh ah-ree-mahs kah?
translation: 手術のあとに問題が起きたことがありますか？

english: Have you ever had trouble with anesthesia?
transliteration: mah-soo-ee deh moh-ndah-ee gah oh-kee-tah koh-toh ah-ree-mahs kah?
translation: 麻酔で問題が起きたことがありますか？

english: Do you have diabetes, heart disease, or lung disease?
transliteration: toh-oh-nyoh-byoh, sheen-zoh-byoh, mah-tah wah hee-noh byoh-kee gah ah-ree-mahs kah?
translation: 糖尿病、心臓病、または肺の病気がありますか？

english: Have you ever been diagnosed with cancer?
transliteration: gahn toh sheen-dahn sah-reh-tah koh-toh ah-ree-mahs kah?
translation: がんと診断されたことがありますか？

english: Have you ever had an organ transplant?
transliteration: zoh-kee ee-shyokoo oh oo-keh-tah koh-toh ah-ree-mahs kah?
translation: 臓器移植を受けたことがありますか？

english: What medicines do you take regularly?
transliteration: foo-dahn, doh-noh yoh-oh nah soo-ree oh noh-n-deh ee-mahs kah?
translation: 普段、どのような薬を飲んでいますか？

english: Do you take blood thinners?
transliteration: kee-eh-ketsu oh kah-tah-mah-ree-nee-koo-koo soo-roo soo-ree oh noh-n-deh ee-mahs kah?
translation: 血液を固まりにくくする薬を飲んでいますか？

english: Do you take aspirin?
transliteration: ah-soo-pee-ree-n oh noh-n-deh ee-mahs kah?
translation: アスピリンを飲んでいますか？

english: Do you take steroids or medicines that suppress your immune system?
transliteration: steh-roh-ee-doh yah mee-nehn oh oh-sah-eh-roo soo-ree oh noh-n-deh ee-mahs kah?
translation: ステロイドや免疫を抑える薬を飲んでいますか？

english: Are you allergic to any medicines?
transliteration: soo-ree deh ah-reh-ree-ghee gah deh-tah koh-toh wah ah-ree-mahs kah?
translation: 薬でアレルギーが出たことはありますか？

english: Have you ever had excessive bleeding after surgery?
transliteration: shoo-jootsoo no ah-toh nee shee-ketsu gah oh-oh-koo tsu-zoo-ee-tah koh-toh ah-ree-mahs kah?
translation: 手術のあとに出血が多く続いたことがありますか？

english: Do you smoke or vape?
transliteration: tah-bah-koh oh soot-tah-ree, dehn-shee tah-bah-koh oh tsuk-ah-ht-tah-ree shee-mahs kah?
translation: たばこを吸ったり、電子たばこを使ったりしますか？

english: Do you drink alcohol?
transliteration: oh-sah-kay oh noh-mee-mahs kah?
translation: お酒を飲みますか？

english: Please lie down on the examination bed.
transliteration: shee-nah-tee dah-ee nee yoh-kah nee nah-ht-teh koo-dah-sah-ee.
translation: 診察台に横になってください。

english: Please bend your knees slightly.
transliteration: hee-zah oh soo-koo-shi mah-geh-teh koo-dah-sah-ee.
translation: 膝を少し曲げてください。

english: I am going to examine your abdomen.
transliteration: koh-reh kah-rah oh-nah-kah oh sheen-sah-tsu shee-mahs.
translation: これからお腹を診察します。

english: I will gently press on your abdomen.
transliteration: oh-nah-kah oh soh-ht-toh oh-shee-mahs.
translation: お腹をそっと押します。

english: Tell me if this is painful.
transliteration: ee-tah-kah-ht-tah-rah oh-shee-eh-teh koo-dah-sah-ee.
translation: 痛かったら教えてください。

english: Does it hurt more when I release the pressure?
transliteration: oh-shee-tah ah-toh nee hah-nah-soo toh, moh-ht-toh ee-tah-mee-mahs kah?
translation: 押したあとに離すと、もっと痛みますか？

english: Please take a deep breath.
transliteration: foo-kah-koo ee-kee oh soo-ht-teh koo-dah-sah-ee.
translation: 深く息を吸ってください。

english: Please cough once.
transliteration: ee-chee-doh seh-kee oh shee-teh koo-dah-sah-ee.
translation: 一度せきをしてください。

english: May I examine the lump?
transliteration: shee-koh-ree oh mee-teh moh yoh-roh-shee-ee deh-soo kah?
translation: しこりを診てもよろしいですか？

english: May I examine your surgical scar?
transliteration: shoo-jootsoo no kee-zoo-ah-toh oh mee-teh moh yoh-roh-shee-ee deh-soo kah?
translation: 手術の傷あとを診てもよろしいですか？

english: I would like to examine your breast, if you agree.
transliteration: yoh-roh-shee-keh-reh-bah, nyoo-boh-oo oh sheen-sah-tsu sah-seh-teh koo-dah-sah-ee.
translation: よろしければ、乳房を診察させてください。

english: We can have a chaperone present during the examination.
transliteration: sheen-sah-tsu no ah-ee-dah, tsuk-ee-saw-ee no hee-toh nee doh-seh-kee shee-teh moh-rah-oo koh-toh gah deh-kee-mahs.
translation: 診察の間、付き添いの人に同席してもらうことができます。

english: I need to examine the area around your anus.
transliteration: koh-mohn no mah-wah-ree oh sheen-sah-tsu soo-roo hee-tsuy-oh gah ah-ree-mahs.
translation: 肛門の周りを診察する必要があります。

english: A rectal examination involves gently placing a gloved finger into the rectum.
transliteration: chee-choo-shin deh wah, teh-boo-kuroh oh shee-tah yoo-bee oh soh-ht-toh chee-choo nee ee-reh-mahs.
translation: 直腸診では、手袋をした指をそっと直腸に入れます。

english: Do I have your permission to perform this examination?
transliteration: koh-noh sheen-sah-tsu oh shee-teh moh yoh-roh-shee-ee deh-soo kah?
translation: この診察をしてもよろしいですか？

english: Please tell me if you want me to stop at any time.
transliteration: ee-tsu-deh-moh chuu-shee-teh hoh-shee-ee toh-kee wah, oh-shee-eh-teh koo-dah-sah-ee.
translation: いつでも中止してほしいときは、教えてください。

english: We need to take a blood sample.
transliteration: keh-tsu-eh-kee keh-sah noh tah-meh nee sah-kee-tsu shee-mahs.
translation: 血液検査のために採血します。

english: We would like to do an ultrasound scan.
transliteration: choh-oh-ehn-pah-kee keh-sah oh shee-tah-ee toh moh-ee-mahs.
translation: 超音波検査をしたいと思います。

english: We may need a CT scan of your abdomen.
transliteration: oh-nah-kah no see-tee keh-sah gah hee-tsuy-oh nee nah-roo koh-toh gah ah-ree-mahs.
translation: お腹のCT検査が必要になることがあります。

english: Have you had a CT scan before?
transliteration: koh-reh mah-deh nee see-tee keh-sah oh oo-keh-tah koh-toh ah-ree-mahs kah?
translation: これまでにCT検査を受けたことがありますか？

english: We may need an MRI scan.
transliteration: eh-m-ah-ree keh-sah gah hee-tsuy-oh nee nah-roo koh-toh gah ah-ree-mahs.
translation: MRI検査が必要になることがあります。

english: We would like to take a small tissue sample for testing.
transliteration: keh-sah noh tah-meh nee, shoh-oh-ryoh noh soh-shee-kee oh sah-ee-shoo shee-tah-ee toh moh-ee-mahs.
translation: 検査のために、少量の組織を採取したいと思います。

english: This is called a biopsy.
transliteration: koh-reh wah see-kehn toh ee-ee-mahs.
translation: これは生検といいます。

english: We may need to look inside your bowel with a camera.
transliteration: kah-meh-rah deh choh-oh noh nah-kah oh mee-roo hee-tsuy-oh gah ah-roo kah moh shee-reh-mah-sehn.
translation: カメラで腸の中を見る必要があるかもしれません。

english: You may need an operation.
transliteration: shoo-jootsoo gah hee-tsuy-oh nee nah-roo koh-toh gah ah-ree-mahs.
translation: 手術が必要になることがあります。

english: We will explain the benefits and risks of surgery.
transliteration: shoo-jootsoo noh ree-tehn toh ree-sookoo nee tsu-ee-teh seh-tsu-meh-ee-mahs.
translation: 手術の利点とリスクについて説明します。

english: There may be alternatives to surgery.
transliteration: shoo-jootsoo ee-gah-ee noh hoh-hoh moh ah-roo kah moh shee-reh-mah-sehn.
translation: 手術以外の方法もあるかもしれません。

english: Do you have any questions about the operation?
transliteration: shoo-jootsoo nee tsu-ee-teh nah-nee kah shee-tsu-mohn wah ah-ree-mahs kah?
translation: 手術について何か質問はありますか？

english: You may need general anesthesia, which makes you unconscious during surgery.
transliteration: shoo-jootsoo-chuu nee ee-shee-kee gah nah-koo nah-roo zehn-shin mah-soo-ee gah hee-tsuy-oh nee nah-roo koh-toh gah ah-ree-mahs.
translation: 手術中に意識がなくなる全身麻酔が必要になることがあります。

english: Local anesthesia numbs only the area being treated.
transliteration: kyoh-koh-koo mah-soo-ee wah, chee-ryoh soo-roo boo-boon dah-keh no kahn-kah-koo oh nah-koo-shee-mahs.
translation: 局所麻酔は、治療する部分だけの感覚をなくします。

english: We may need to make a small cut in the skin.
transliteration: hah-dah oh soo-koo-shi kee-roo hee-tsuy-oh gah ah-roo kah moh shee-reh-mah-sehn.
translation: 皮膚を少し切る必要があるかもしれません。

english: We may need to place a drain to remove fluid.
transliteration: eh-kee oh toh-ree-noh-zoo tah-meh nee, doh-rehn oh ee-reh-roo hee-tsuy-oh gah ah-roo kah moh shee-reh-mah-sehn.
translation: 液を取り除くために、ドレーンを入れる必要があるかもしれません。

english: We may need to close the wound with stitches.
transliteration: kee-zoo oh noo-oo hee-tsuy-oh gah ah-roo kah moh shee-reh-mah-sehn.
translation: 傷を縫う必要があるかもしれません。

english: When did you last eat or drink anything?
transliteration: sah-ee-goh nee nah-nee kah oh tah-beh-tah-ree noh-n-dah-ree shee-tah no wah ee-tsu deh-soo kah?
translation: 最後に何かを食べたり飲んだりしたのはいつですか？

english: Please do not eat or drink until the team tells you it is safe.
transliteration: suh-tah-ffu kah-rah ahn-zehn dah toh ee-wah-reh-roo mah-deh, tah-beh-tah-ree noh-n-dah-ree shee-nah-ee-deh koo-dah-sah-ee.
translation: スタッフから安全だと言われるまで、食べたり飲んだりしないでください。

english: Have you spoken with the anesthesiologist?
transliteration: mah-soo-ee-kah ee-shoh toh hah-nah-shee-mah-shee-tah kah?
translation: 麻酔科医と話しましたか？

english: Is there any chance you could be pregnant?
transliteration: nee-n-shin shee-teh ee-roo kah-noh-seh-ee wah ah-ree-mahs kah?
translation: 妊娠している可能性はありますか？

english: We will check your blood pressure and pulse.
transliteration: keh-tsu-ah-tsu toh myah-koo-hah-koo oh kah-koo-neh-mahs.
translation: 血圧と脈拍を確認します。

english: We may give you fluids through a vein.
transliteration: tehn-teh-kee deh see-bun oh hoh-kyoo soo-roo koh-toh gah ah-ree-mahs.
translation: 点滴で水分を補給することがあります。

english: I am going to check your wound.
transliteration: kee-zoo oh kah-koo-neh-mahs.
translation: 傷を確認します。

english: Is the wound more painful than before?
transliteration: kee-zoo no ee-tah-mee wah mah-eh yoh-ree tsuy-oo-koo nah-ht-teh ee-mahs kah?
translation: 傷の痛みは前より強くなっていますか？

english: Have you noticed redness or swelling around the wound?
transliteration: kee-zoo no mah-wah-ree gah ah-kah-koo nah-ht-tah-ree, hah-reh-tah-ree shee-teh ee-mahs kah?
translation: 傷の周りが赤くなったり、腫れたりしていますか？

english: Is any pus coming from the wound?
transliteration: kee-zoo kah-rah oo-myee gah deh-teh ee-mahs kah?
translation: 傷から膿が出ていますか？

english: We will change the dressing.
transliteration: hoh-tah-ee oh koh-kahn shee-mahs.
translation: 包帯を交換します。

english: Please keep the dressing clean and dry.
transliteration: hoh-tah-ee oh seh-keh-tsu deh kah-wah-ee-tah joh-tah-ee nee tah-mot-teh koo-dah-sah-ee.
translation: 包帯を清潔で乾いた状態に保ってください。

english: We will remove the stitches when the wound has healed enough.
transliteration: kee-zoo gah joo-buhn nee nah-oh-ht-tah-rah, bee-shee oh shee-mahs.
translation: 傷が十分に治ったら、抜糸します。

english: Is the drain collecting fluid?
transliteration: doh-rehn nee eh-kee gah tah-mah-ht-teh ee-mahs kah?
translation: ドレーンに液がたまっていますか？

english: How is your pain since the operation?
transliteration: shoo-jootsoo-goh no ee-tah-mee wah doh deh-soo kah?
translation: 手術後の痛みはどうですか？

english: Have you been able to eat or drink?
transliteration: tah-beh-tah-ree noh-n-dah-ree deh-kee-teh ee-mahs kah?
translation: 食べたり飲んだりできていますか？

english: Have you felt nauseated or vomited?
transliteration: hah-kee-keh gah shee-tah-ree, hah-kee-tah-ree shee-mah-shee-tah kah?
translation: 吐き気がしたり、吐いたりしましたか？

english: Have you passed gas since surgery?
transliteration: shoo-jootsoo-goh, oh-nah-rah wah deh-mah-shee-tah kah?
translation: 手術後、おならは出ましたか？

english: Have you passed stool since surgery?
transliteration: shoo-jootsoo-goh, beh-n wah deh-mah-shee-tah kah?
translation: 手術後、便は出ましたか？

english: Have you been able to get out of bed and walk?
transliteration: beh-ht-doh kah-rah oh-kee-teh ah-roo-koo koh-toh wah deh-kee-mah-shee-tah kah?
translation: ベッドから起きて歩くことはできましたか？

english: Have you had any trouble passing urine?
transliteration: nee-yoh oh dah-soo toh-kee nee koh-mah-ht-tah koh-toh wah ah-ree-mah-shee-tah kah?
translation: 尿を出すときに困ったことはありましたか？

english: Please ask for help before getting up if you feel dizzy.
transliteration: meh-ma-ee gah soo-roo bah-ee wah, oh-kee-ah-gah-roo mah-eh nee tah-soo-keh oh moh-toh-meh-teh koo-dah-sah-ee.
translation: めまいがする場合は、起き上がる前に助けを求めてください。

english: Do you have severe or worsening abdominal pain?
transliteration: oh-nah-kah nee tsuy-oo-ee ee-tah-mee gah ah-ree-mahs kah? soh-reh toh-moh ee-tah-mee gah hee-doh-koo nah-ht-teh ee-mahs kah?
translation: お腹に強い痛みがありますか？それとも痛みがひどくなっていますか？

english: Have you been vomiting repeatedly?
transliteration: nah-ndoh moh hah-kee-teh ee-mahs kah?
translation: 何度も吐いていますか？

english: Are you unable to pass gas or stool?
transliteration: oh-nah-rah yah beh-n gah deh-mah-sehn kah?
translation: おならや便が出ませんか？

english: Do you have a fever or chills?
transliteration: neh-tsu yah sah-moo-keh gah ah-ree-mahs kah?
translation: 熱や寒気がありますか？

english: Is the wound bleeding heavily?
transliteration: kee-zoo kah-rah tah-ee-ryoh nee shee-ketsu shee-teh ee-mahs kah?
translation: 傷から大量に出血していますか？

english: Do you have chest pain or trouble breathing?
transliteration: muh-neh no ee-tah-mee yah ee-kee-goo-roh-sah gah ah-ree-mahs kah?
translation: 胸の痛みや息苦しさがありますか？

english: Have you fainted or felt very dizzy?
transliteration: kee oh oo-shee-nah-ht-tah-ree, hee-doh-ee meh-ma-ee gah shee-tah-ree shee-mah-shee-tah kah?
translation: 気を失ったり、ひどいめまいがしたりしましたか？

english: If these symptoms occur, seek emergency medical care.
transliteration: koh-reh-rah no shoh-joh gah deh-tah bah-ah-ee wah, kyoo-kyoo ee-ryoh oh oo-keh-teh koo-dah-sah-ee.
translation: これらの症状が出た場合は、救急医療を受けてください。

english: We will arrange a follow-up appointment with the surgical team.
transliteration: geh-kah chee-moo no sheen-sah-tsu no yoh-yah-koo oh teh-hah-ee shee-mahs.
translation: 外科チームの診察の予約を手配します。

english: We may refer you to a cancer specialist.
transliteration: gahn no seh-mohn-ee oh shoh-kah-ee soo-roo koh-toh gah ah-ree-mahs.
translation: がんの専門医を紹介することがあります。

english: Please come back if the wound becomes red, swollen, or painful.
transliteration: kee-zoo gah ah-kah-koo nah-ht-tah-ree, hah-reh-tah-ree, ee-tah-koo nah-ht-tah-ree shee-tah-rah, mah-tah jyoo-sheen shee-teh koo-dah-sah-ee.
translation: 傷が赤くなったり、腫れたり、痛くなったりしたら、また受診してください。

english: Do you have any questions?
transliteration: nah-nee kah shee-tsu-mohn wah ah-ree-mahs kah?
translation: 何か質問はありますか？

english: Can you explain how you will care for the wound at home?
transliteration: jee-tah-koo deh kee-zoo oh doh-noh yoh-oh nee teh-ah-teh soo-roo kah, seh-tsu-meh-ee-teh ee-tah-dah-keh-mahs kah?
translation: 自宅で傷をどのように手当てするか、説明していただけますか？

english: Thank you for speaking with me today.
transliteration: kyoh-oh wah oh-hah-nah-shee ee-tah-dah-kee, ah-ree-gah-toh-oh goh-zah-ee-mah-shee-tah.
translation: 今日はお話しいただき、ありがとうございました。
